title: Portfolio Revenue Director - Food & Beverage - Singapore
description:
**Introduction**

Take the lead in shaping Food and Beverage revenue strategy and performance across a diverse portfolio of hotels and outlets throughout EAPAC. This is an opportunity to influence senior stakeholders, develop regional capability and turn commercial insights into practical actions that improve revenue and profitability. You will also help expand the reach of Food and Beverage Revenue Services while leading a team committed to strong performance and continuous improvement.

**Your day to day**

* Lead Food and Beverage revenue strategy across a portfolio of hotels, restaurants, bars, spas and other ancillary revenue streams.
* Use demand, capacity, pricing, menu mix, promotional and customer data to identify opportunities that improve revenue and profitability.
* Lead performance, forecasting, budgeting and strategy reviews, working with hotel leaders and regional Commercial, Finance, Marketing, Sales, Digital and Operations teams.
* Expand the Food and Beverage Revenue Services portfolio by building strong business cases, engaging senior stakeholders and supporting the successful onboarding of new hotels.
* Lead, coach and develop the regional team while improving reporting, data quality, productivity and the use of automation, artificial intelligence and analytics.

**What we need from you**

* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience in Hospitality, Revenue Management, Business or a related discipline.
* At least 10 years of progressive experience in hospitality, revenue management, commercial strategy or Food and Beverage leadership.
* Experience leading complex Food and Beverage revenue strategies within a hotel, cluster, portfolio or regional environment.
* Strong knowledge of forecasting, capacity optimisation, pricing, menu engineering, financial analysis and profitability.
* Proven ability to lead and develop teams, influence senior stakeholders and communicate complex commercial insights clearly.

#LI-SN1

Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.

title: Director of Business Development Acquisitions and Integration
description:
The opportunity
  
  
LinkEdge is a Singapore distribution business serving consumer brands across retail and trade channels. We plan to expand into Malaysia and explore company acquisitions in Singapore and Malaysia. This role will establish and develop those initiatives while leading the commercial and operational performance of our existing Singapore business.
  
  
Reporting to the CEO, you will develop new principal partnerships, evaluate market entry and acquisition opportunities, and plan the integration of approved businesses and portfolios. You will also remain accountable for Singapore revenue, margins, operating profit, working capital and service, working closely with Finance, HR and specialist advisers.
  
  
Business development acquisitions and integration
  
  
·
  
  
Develop regional business.
  
  
Develop opportunities for new principal partnerships, distribution mandates, categories and channels. Build the Malaysia market entry strategy, assess routes to market and potential partners, and recommend a phased plan to the CEO.
  
  
·
  
  
Build an acquisition pipeline.
  
  
Establish acquisition criteria and identify potential companies in Singapore and Malaysia. Assess strategic fit, commercial potential and operating capability, and prepare initial recommendations for further evaluation.
  
  
·
  
  
Evaluate opportunities.
  
  
Coordinate commercial and operational due diligence with Finance, legal and other advisers. Assess valuation assumptions, working capital, investment needs, risks and potential benefits. Support negotiations and prepare business cases for the company's investment approval process.
  
  
·
  
  
Plan and lead integration.
  
  
Create onboarding plans for new principal portfolios and integration plans for proposed acquisitions. Lead implementation after the necessary approvals and transaction completion, covering people, customers, stock, systems, supply chain and service continuity.
  
  
·
  
  
Strengthen partnerships.
  
  
Lead joint plans and business reviews with principals and key customers. Work with the CEO on strategic relationships and major negotiations, and translate approved commitments into disciplined execution.
  
  
Commercial and operational leadership
  
  
·
  
  
Own Singapore business performance.
  
  
Lead annual plans, budgets and reviews for existing and new Singapore portfolios. Manage revenue, margins, operating costs and profitability, and take timely corrective action.
  
  
·
  
  
Deliver reliable execution.
  
  
Lead commercial, trade marketing, retail operations, supply chain and IT/data teams. Improve forecasting, inventory availability, order fulfilment, warehousing and delivery performance through coordinated planning.
  
  
·
  
  
Build a scalable organisation.
  
  
Develop accountable leaders and clear decision rights. Create repeatable onboarding processes and shared capabilities so new portfolios can be added efficiently, with dedicated resources where commercially necessary.
  
  
·
  
  
Improve decisions and productivity.
  
  
Use business analytics, dashboards, process simplification and automation to improve visibility and reduce cost to serve. Partner with Finance on working capital, controls and business performance, and with HR on capability, succession and workforce planning.
  
  
·
  
  
Maintain commercial discipline.
  
  
Protect confidential information and manage competing portfolio interests. Maintain governance, safety and service standards. Keep commercial commitments within delegated authority; acquisition and investment decisions require the relevant CEO or Board approvals.
  
  
Experience and capabilities
  
  

* At least 15 years of relevant experience in FMCG, FMEG, consumer products or distribution, including at least 5 years in senior leadership with profit and loss accountability and responsibility across multiple functions.
* A record of profitable growth, developing principal or customer partnerships, and launching or integrating new portfolios. Experience evaluating acquisitions, coordinating due diligence or integrating acquired businesses is an advantage.
* Strong understanding of Singapore distribution channels and practical supply chain and retail execution experience. Knowledge of Malaysia distribution markets and market entry planning is an advantage.
* Sound commercial judgement and financial capability, including margins, trade investment, budgeting, inventory, receivables and working capital.
* Clear leadership communication, effective negotiation and the ability to develop managers, align teams and lead change in a growing business.
* A degree in business, management or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

What success looks like
  
  
Profitable Singapore performance; a credible Malaysia expansion plan; a qualified opportunity pipeline and sound investment recommendations; successful launches and integration of approved opportunities; dependable service; and stronger teams, working capital and productivity.
  
  
Please apply through MyCareersFuture with your CV and examples of relevant business development, operational leadership and integration experience.
  
  
LinkEdge International Pte Ltd
  
  
Where FMCG and FMEG careers accelerate.
  
  
LinkEdge International is one of Singapore's fastest-growing Go-To-Market distribution companies. We partner with world-class global FMCG and FMEG brands to deliver end-to-end distribution — retail sales, e-commerce, warehousing, transportation, merchandising and trade marketing — across 2,300+ outlets in five channels: Modern Trade, General Trade, Food Service, Specialty and eCommerce.
  
  
Founded in 2018 and led by veterans of leading multinationals, we combine MNC-grade discipline with entrepreneurial speed. Our data-driven approach to retail execution sets us apart in the market — and our people are the ones who bring it to life every day.
  
  
Why join LinkEdge?
  
  
Work with iconic brands.
  
  
Represent some of the world's most trusted FMCG and FMEG names in one of Asia's most competitive markets.
  
  
Grow faster.
  
  
In a lean, high-performance team of 130+, you'll take real ownership early — no waiting years for responsibility.
  
  
Learn from the best.
  
  
Our leadership brings decades of experience from top global companies, and we invest in developing every team member.
  
  
Be part of the growth story.
  
  
We're scaling rapidly, adding new brands, channels and capabilities — and creating new opportunities for our people as we grow.
  
  
If you're ambitious, hands-on and passionate about winning at retail, we want to hear from you.
  
  
Join us. Let's build the future of Go-To-Market distribution together.

title: Director of PS Commercial Compute, Greater Asia
description:
Director of PS Commercial Compute, Greater Asia

**Description -**

**Director of Commercial Category, PS Greater Asia**
----------------------------------------------------

  

### **Job Summary**

The Director of Commercial Category is responsible for leading the strategy, performance, and execution of the Commercial Personal Systems category across Greater Asia. This role brings together category management, go-to-market strategy, financial management, and cross-functional execution to drive sustainable growth and strengthen market competitiveness.

The role partners closely with sales, marketing, product, supply chain, and other key stakeholders to translate broader business priorities into effective regional category strategies. It requires strong commercial judgment, market understanding, and the ability to lead and influence across a complex, multi-market environment.

  

### **Responsibilities**

* Leads the overall strategy and business performance of the Commercial Personal Systems category across Greater Asia.
* Manages key commercial and financial aspects of the category, with a focus on revenue growth, profitability, market share, and portfolio performance.
* Develops short- and mid-term category plans aligned with business and market priorities.
* Leads go-to-market planning and execution in partnership with sales, marketing, and other key stakeholders.
* Identifies new product, portfolio, and market opportunities based on customer needs, competitive dynamics, and emerging industry trends.
* Develops category and product positioning strategies to strengthen competitiveness and support business growth.
* Drives portfolio and product lifecycle management, including product mix, pricing, positioning, and lifecycle transitions.
* Monitors market trends, competitive activity, customer insights, and technology developments to inform category strategy and decision-making.
* Leads business planning, forecasting, and regular performance reviews, identifying opportunities and actions to improve business outcomes.
* Partners with sales and channel teams to drive category performance across commercial customer segments and routes to market.
* Collaborates with supply chain, operations, and other functions to support effective demand planning, inventory management, and product availability.
* Engages with senior leadership and key stakeholders to communicate category performance, strategic priorities, and business plans.
* Builds strong cross-functional relationships across regional and global teams to ensure alignment and effective execution.
* Identifies business and operational risks and develops appropriate mitigation plans.
* Establishes and monitors key category performance indicators, using data and insights to support decision-making and continuous improvement.
* Provides leadership and direction to the category organization, building strong commercial capabilities and developing talent.
* Ensures adherence to organizational policies, applicable regulations, and ethical standards.
Continuously evaluates and improves category strategies, processes, and ways of working to remain competitive in a dynamic market.  

  

### **Education & Experience Recommended**

* Four-year or graduate degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Finance, or another relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Typically 12+ years of relevant experience in category management, product management, commercial strategy, sales, business management, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience managing business performance and commercial outcomes within a complex organization.
* Experience working across multiple countries or markets, preferably within a regional environment.
* Strong understanding of technology markets, product lifecycle management, pricing, go-to-market strategy, and channel dynamics.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to use market and business data to inform decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate with senior stakeholders across a matrixed organization.
* Strong strategic thinking, analytical, communication, and execution capabilities.

**Reports To:** Executive Director, International Business (US Headquarters)
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
This role is responsible for driving regional growth, operational excellence,and strategic alignment with corporate objectives. The RBD will manage andmentor General Managers in each country, ensuring strong performance andcollaboration across the region.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Strategic Leadership

* Identify growth opportunities in life sciences markets across the region.
* Drive regional initiatives to strengthen market presence and customerengagement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Qualifications
  
  
**Education:**

**Experience:**

New England Biolabs – putting science first
  
  
Created "by scientists for scientists", NEB is renowned for consistently providing exceptional product quality and unsurpassed technical support. For over four decades, NEB has been shaping the landscape of bioscience research by discovering, developing and supporting superior research reagents. From our founding principles – placing the advancement of science and the stewardship of the environment as our highest priorities – to our unique corporate culture, NEB’s philosophy can be distilled down to three core values: passion, humility and being genuine.

title: Client Program Director
description:
**Opportunity**

Maersk is a global leader in integrated logistics and have been industry pioneers for over a century. Through innovation and transformation, we are redefining the boundaries of possibility, continuously setting new standards for efficiency, sustainability, and excellence.

At Maersk, we believe in the power of diversity, collaboration, and continuous learning and we work hard to ensure that the people in our organisation reflect and understand the customers we exist to serve.

With over 100,000 employees across 130 countries, we work together to shape the future of global trade and logistics.

  

**Purpose of the Role**

The Client Program Director is the senior programme leader responsible for connecting customer strategy, operational execution, performance governance and account growth. Working across customer and company leadership, Commercial, Product, Operations, Technology and Finance, this role develops and delivers a joint programme roadmap that strengthens service continuity, supply chain visibility and measurable value creation.

  

The role requires a trusted advisor who can translate complex supply chain priorities into actionable plans and lead global, cross-functional teams through influence. Experience supporting a technology OEM, Tier 1 supplier or manufacturing-led supply chain is strongly preferred.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Strategy and Growth**
--------------------------------

* Partner with customer and company leadership to develop the account strategy, programme roadmap and growth priorities.
* Build trusted relationships across supply chain, logistics, procurement, manufacturing, technology, finance and senior leadership.
* Translate customer requirements and market developments into integrated logistics solutions and improvement opportunities.
Support new business development, solution design and value-creation initiatives.  

  

**Operational and Programme Leadership**
----------------------------------------

* Establish and govern operational KPIs, ensuring accurate reporting, clear ownership and timely corrective action.
* Lead regional and global governance forums covering performance, risks, root causes, decisions and action closure.
* Manage production-critical risks, supplier escalations, inventory concerns, transport disruptions and service failures.
* Own the programme plan and project pipeline, including scope, governance, resources, milestones, dependencies and executive reporting.
Lead the transition of new business from implementation into stable operations.  

  

**Performance and Continuous Improvement**
------------------------------------------

* Drive structured exception management, root-cause analysis and continuous improvement across the operating model.
* Identify and deliver measurable improvements in cost, productivity, service, resilience and supply chain visibility.
* Maintain customer satisfaction and strengthen internal stakeholder engagement.
Ensure Standard Operating Procedures, billing processes and operational documentation remain accurate and controlled.  

  

**Executive Governance, Risk and Compliance**
---------------------------------------------

* Prepare monthly executive updates and lead Quarterly Business Reviews and strategic customer sessions.
* Maintain clear visibility of account performance, projects, customer sentiment, risks and value creation.
* Establish controls that minimise operational, commercial, compliance, trade-control and HSSE exposure.
Escalate material risks with clear impact assessments, ownership and mitigation plans.  

  

**Team and Community Leadership**
---------------------------------

* Support team onboarding, capability development and succession planning.
* Contribute to objective setting, coaching, recognition and performance management.
Share best practices across local, regional and global programme-management communities.  

  

**What we are looking for**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering or a related discipline.
* At least 10 years of experience in logistics, supply chain, programme management, customer operations or operational leadership.
* Proven experience leading complex customer programmes and cross-functional initiatives across multiple geographies.
* Strong capabilities in operational governance, KPI management, continuous improvement, risk mitigation and value creation.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and deliver results within a global matrix organisation.
* Excellent relationship-management, communication, negotiation, facilitation and executive-presentation skills.
Working knowledge of Lean or business-improvement methodologies.  

  

Preferred Experience

* Experience within a technology OEM, Tier 1 supplier or manufacturing supply chain.
* Understanding of JIT/JIS operations, supplier management, production planning and plant logistics.
* Experience with production-critical logistics, multi-tier supplier networks and operational disruption management.
* Knowledge of inbound, outbound, aftermarket and supplier logistics.
* Experience in Lead Logistics, LLP/4PL, control tower or integrated supply chain environments.
* Familiarity with supply chain measures such as on-time delivery, ASN performance, supplier compliance, transit performance and inventory health.
* PMP, APICS CSCP/CLTD or Lean Six Sigma certification would be advantageous.

title: clinic director
company: BLESSED CARE MEDICAL CLINIC PTE. LTD.
description:
We are seeking a proactive and organised Business Operations Director to assist the Business Owner with clinic operations, administrative coordination, marketing and business performance reporting. The role also includes hands-on social media content production, basic financial record-keeping and daily front-desk duties.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Assist the Business Owner in developing and implementing operational and marketing plans, and monitor work progress, budgets and business targets.
  
  
Coordinate clinic operation (including Western clinic and TCM clinic ) , including administrative workflows, staff scheduling, training arrangements and communication between clinic teams. purchasing and ordering Western Medicine and TCM Medicine.
  
  
Undertake daily front-desk duties, including answering and transferring telephone calls, responding to general service and fee enquiries, arranging and confirming appointments, registering patients, collecting payments and issuing receipts.
  
  
Plan and produce business publicity materials, including social media posts, short videos, brand introductions and event materials. Participate in scripting, filming, editing and publishing.
  
  
Manage business social media accounts, maintain content calendars and review engagement, customer enquiries and campaign results.
  
  
Coordinate publicity for clinic events, community activities and business development projects, and liaise with external media and service providers. Ensure clinical content is reviewed by the relevant practitioner before publication.
  
  
Maintain records of business receipts, expenditure, procurement costs and marketing expenses. Assist with account reconciliation and basic management reports, working with the personnel responsible for accounting.
  
  
Follow up on customer feedback and coordinate with practitioners, therapists and front-desk staff to improve service processes.
  
  
Requirements
  
  

* A qualification in Business Administration, Marketing, Accounting or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
* Relevant experience in business operations, administrative coordination or customer service, together with practical social media management and digital content production skills.
* Ability to plan, film, edit and publish short videos. Applicants should provide examples of work they have personally helped produce.
* Basic accounting and cost management knowledge, with the ability to organise transaction records, procurement expenses and business data.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and familiarity with accounting or business management software.
* English proficiency for business correspondence, reporting and general customer enquiries. Chinese writing and Mandarin communication skills are advantage . knowledge of western medicine and TCM medicine is advantage.
* Good telephone communication, reception and organisational skills, with the ability to balance operational coordination, marketing activities and daily front-desk responsibilities.
* Initiative, accountability and a willingness to learn, with the ability to prioritise tasks and follow clinic procedures and patient confidentiality requirements.

Preferred Qualifications and Experience
  
  

* An MBA or other relevant postgraduate business qualification.
* Experience managing multiple business social media accounts.
* Experience in a service-based business.
* Familiarity with QuickBooks, Sage 300 or comparable accounting software.

Working Arrangements
  
  
Full-time, Monday to Saturday, 9:00 am to 9 pm, with scheduled meal and rest breaks.
  
  
Sunday is the weekly rest day.
  
  
Salary
  
  
**Fixed monthly salary:** S$7000–S$9990, depending on qualifications and relevant experience.
  
  
Application
  
  
Please apply through MyCareersFuture with your CV and relevant publicity materials, short videos or social media portfolio links. Please describe your contribution to each example.
  
  
Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete brief, job-related assessments covering content planning, basic business data organisation and customer communication.
  
  
Applications will be assessed on relevant qualifications, skills, experience and demonstrated ability to perform the role.

title: GENERAL DIRECTOR
description:

The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing business strategies, improving operational efficiency, enhancing service standards and profitability, and ensuring sustainable business growth.

监督经营绩效,分析营业收入、成本结构及市场趋势,制定改善方案。

评估业务发展机会,推动品牌推广、市场拓展及长期业务增长。
  
  
Evaluate business development opportunities and drive brand promotion, market expansion and long-term business growth.

制定及监督餐厅运营预算,管理营业收入、采购成本、人力成本及日常营运开支。

监督供应商合作及采购管理,确保采购成本合理、供应稳定及产品质量符合要求。

Lead and manage front-of-house and kitchen teams, establishing clear responsibilities and performance standards.

了解新加坡餐饮行业相关法规、食品卫生标准及工作场所安全要求。

能够独立制定经营计划、监督执行进度,并对整体经营表现负责。

title: CEO
description:
About Cloudwise
  
  
Cloudwise is a cloud services and software company that specialises in IT Service Management (ITSM), observability and AIOps. We help enterprises run complex, hybrid IT environments more reliably and efficiently. We have teams in Singapore, Hong Kong, Mainland China and the Middle East, and Singapore is our regional hub for growth across Asia Pacific and beyond.
  
  
The Role
  
  
We are looking for a Chief Executive Officer to lead our Singapore entity and drive regional growth. Reporting to the Board / Group Management, the CEO is fully accountable for the strategy, commercial results, operations and organisational development of the Singapore business. You will turn the Group’s vision into a clear regional plan, build strong client and partner relationships, and lead a lean, high-performing multinational team.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Strategy & Business Leadership
  
  
Set and carry out the business strategy and annual operating plan for Singapore and the markets it covers, in line with Group direction.
  
  
Own full P&L responsibility, including revenue, gross margin, operating costs and cash flow.
  
  
Find and prioritise growth opportunities across industries such as financial services, telecommunications, government and large enterprises.
  
  
Commercial & Market Development
  
  
Lead the go-to-market strategy for our ITSM, observability and AIOps solutions, covering direct sales, channel partners and alliances with cloud providers.
  
  
Build and maintain relationships with key clients, strategic partners, industry bodies and government agencies.
  
  
Personally lead major deals, strategic accounts and important negotiations.
  
  
Operations & Governance
  
  
Make sure the Singapore entity complies with all corporate governance, regulatory, data protection (PDPA) and contractual requirements.
  
  
Set up sound management systems, KPIs and reporting to the Board, and present regular business reviews and forecasts.
  
  
Work with Finance, Legal and HR to manage risk, budgets and internal controls.
  
  
People & Organisation
  
  
Build, lead and develop a multi-functional team spanning sales, pre-sales, delivery, customer success and support functions.
  
  
Encourage a culture of customer focus, accountability, innovation and collaboration across offices.
  
  
Plan for key roles and develop the next generation of leaders.
  
  
Cross-regional Collaboration
  
  
Work closely with Group HQ and the regional offices in Hong Kong, China and the Middle East to align product roadmaps, share resources and deliver to clients.
  
  
Bring local market insights and customer needs back to the Group’s product and R&D teams.
  
  
Requirements
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. An MBA or other relevant postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
  
  
At least 15 years of professional experience in enterprise software, SaaS, cloud or IT services, including at least 5 years in a General Manager, Country Manager, Managing Director or equivalent senior leadership role with full P&L responsibility.
  
  
Strong understanding of enterprise IT operations. Domain knowledge in ITSM, observability, APM, monitoring or AIOps is highly preferred.
  
  
Proven track record of growing revenue in the Asia Pacific B2B enterprise market and building channel and partner ecosystems.
  
  
Experience leading teams across countries, and working effectively in a matrix organisation with an overseas headquarters.
  
  
Strong business sense, executive presence, and communication and negotiation skills, including at C-level.
  
  
Excellent command of English. Proficiency in Mandarin is required, because the role works closely with Group HQ, colleagues and clients in Mainland China and Hong Kong.
  
  
Willing to travel regionally as business needs require.
  
  
What We Offer
  
  
Competitive base salary plus performance-based incentives
  
  
【Long-term incentive / equity scheme, if applicable】
  
  
Annual leave, medical and insurance benefits
  
  
The chance to shape and scale a fast-growing AIOps business across the region
  
  
Interested candidates, please click “Apply Now” and submit your updated resume. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.
  
  
Cloudwise is a pioneer vendor that provides high quality digital operation products and solutions on ITOM and ITSM. We assist in monitoring and improving business operations based on the original business service logic, and help optimize user experience.

title: Strategy & Corporate Development Manager
description:
About Peak Energy
  
  
Headquartered in Singapore, Peak Energy develops, owns, and operates renewable assets across Asia Pacific (APAC). With over 300 MW of operating assets and 1 GW of projects in development, our portfolio spans Japan, Korea, Australia, Taiwan, the Philippines, Thailand, Singapore and Indonesia. With activities encompassing the full range of renewable energy business models - including utility-scale development, off-site PPAs, onsite PPAs, and energy storage applications – Peak Energy is a one-stop partner for corporates seeking to decarbonize their operations in APAC. We believe in establishing long-term partnerships with our corporate customers, to accompany them in their decarbonization journey, through cleaner, cheaper energy. Peak Energy is wholly owned by Stonepeak, a leading alternative investment firm specializing in infrastructure and real assets with approximatively USD 84 billion of assets under management.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and high‑performing Strategy Manager to join our Strategy & Corporate Development team. This is a pivotal role responsible for shaping Peak Energy’s strategic direction, supporting major investment decisions, and partnering closely with senior leadership across multiple markets.
  
  
The Strategy Manager will lead critical workstreams, manage interns or associates, contribute to Peak’s medium‑term strategy, and support corporate development and capital‑related initiatives across Asia.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Strategic Planning and Market intelligence
  
  
Lead the development of Peak Energy’s medium‑term business plan, portfolio strategy, and strategic priorities across markets.
  
  
Build and maintain a data‑driven market intelligence capability to support strategic decision‑making across the organization.
  
  
Own market, policy, regulatory, and competitive intelligence across multiple geographies.
  
  
Synthesize complex qualitative and quantitative insights into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership.
  
  
Partner with regional teams to assess market attractiveness, entry strategies, and growth opportunities.
  
  
2. Growth Capital & Investor insights
  
  
Analyze investor trends, capital flows, and transaction activity across renewable energy and infrastructure markets.
  
  
Generate forward‑looking intelligence on funding structures, risk appetite, and cost of capital.
  
  
Engage with investors, lenders, advisors, and other market participants to maintain a strong understanding of market dynamics.
  
  
Translate market engagement into strategic insights to inform capital strategy and deployment decisions.
  
  
Prepare high‑quality capital‑related materials, including investment narratives, strategy decks, and briefing papers.
  
  
3. Investment Decision Support & Corporate Development
  
  
Support Investment Committee (IC) processes, including commercial evaluation, risk analysis, and structuring of materials for investment approvals.
  
  
Review and challenge financial models, stress‑test assumptions, and ensure consistency with Peak Energy’s investment framework.
  
  
Support M&A, partnerships, joint ventures, and other corporate development initiatives, from initial assessment through execution.
  
  
Contribute strategic perspectives to investment theses and transaction structuring discussions.
  
  
4. Investor & Stakeholder Relations
  
  
Prepare high‑quality IC materials, Board summaries, and investor‑facing presentations.
  
  
Maintain clear, consistent, and professional communication with shareholders, ensuring timely sharing of updates and key information.
  
  
Project manage the preparation and delivery of quarterly reports to shareholders and associated financial models, ensuring accuracy and on‑time contributions from all teams.
  
  
Support the preparation and coordination of quarterly Board of Director meetings, including materials, briefings, and follow‑ups.
  
  
Ensure key communications and decisions are clearly conveyed to internal teams in a structured and effective manner.
  
  
5. Organisational & Operational Improvement
  
  
Identify and implement process, reporting, and organisational improvements to enhance decision‑making quality and speed.
  
  
Support the CEO, COO, and senior leadership with ad hoc strategic analysis and problem‑solving.
  
  
Establish best‑practice frameworks, processes, and templates across strategy, planning, and investment activities.
  
  
Assess the organisation’s requirements for artificial intelligence and advanced analytics, and develop a roadmap for adoption, integration, and value creation.
  
  
Lead or support strategic initiatives focused on sales excellence, operational efficiency, and cross‑functional collaboration to unlock growth opportunities.
  
  
Qualifications & Experience
  
  
MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred.
  
  
Experience in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, investment banking, private equity, infrastructure project finance, or a high‑growth operating environment.
  
  
Proven track record of leading strategic projects end to end and influencing senior stakeholders.
  
  
**Strong commercial and financial acumen, including:**  
Understanding of IRR, cash flow statements, valuation methodologies, and project finance structures
  
  
Proficiency in financial modelling and analysis
  
  
Excellent problem‑solving and communication skills; ability to independently structure and solve complex problems.
  
  
Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Power BI or similar tools is advantageous.
  
  
Passion for the energy transition and strong interest in renewables, energy storage, and infrastructure.
  
  
What We Offer
  
  
High‑visibility role with direct exposure to senior leadership and investors.
  
  
Opportunity to shape strategy for a fast‑growing, pan‑Asian renewable energy platform.
  
  
A collaborative, mission‑driven culture with significant scope for ownership, impact, and career growth.
  
  
Peak Energy is a renewable energy platform with a focus on developing solar, wind and battery projects across Asia. As the region's consumption of energy rises, Peak Energy is dedicated to meeting these demands while contributing to carbon neutrality. We accomplish this by developing large utility-scale projects. These include some of the largest solar and wind farms in Korea and Japan.
  
  
Peak Energy is the renewable arm of Stonepeak Infrastructure Partners; a leading global infrastructure investment firm with +USD 57 Bn in assets under management. Our portfolio includes the offshore wind farm in Taiwan with plans to develop a further +5 GWp.
  
  
Our team has decades of experience and long-standing relationships. This combination of knowledge and relationships, combined with expertise in design and supply chains enables Peak Energy to deliver high performing, robust alternative energy systems on time and under budget.
  
  
At Peak Energy, you'll collaborate with passionate individuals, drive meaningful impact, and be at the forefront of Asia’s transition to renewable energy. We believe everyone is needed for carbon neutrality. Therefore, fresh ideas are always welcomed. Are you excited about disrupting traditional energy sources and developing a sustainable future? Come join our team and be a part of the energy revolution with Peak Energy!

title: [Travel Retail APAC] - Head of Retail, Aesop
description:
Role Purpose
  
  
The Head of Retail, Travel Retail APAC leads the Retail and Education functions across the region, with the ambition to elevate retail performance while protecting and strengthening the distinctive Aesop experience.
  
  
The role translates regional commercial and brand priorities into exceptional execution at the store level—building capable teams, strengthening retail productivity, and ensuring every customer encounter reflects Aesop’s approach to consultation, hospitality and product knowledge.
  
  
Reporting to the Brand Business Development & Marketing Director, you will partner closely with regional teams, retail partners, and cross-functional stakeholders to curate a consistent yet locally inspired luxury retail experience across a fast-evolving Travel Retail landscape.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Retail Strategy & Performance
* Define and lead the APAC Travel Retail strategy for retail excellence, aligned with regional business and brand priorities.
* Drive sustainable retail performance across the network, with clear focus on productivity, conversion, average transaction value, recruitment and customer engagement.
* Establish retail KPIs and routines to identify opportunities and translate insights into actionable improvement plans.
* Partner with Commercial teams and retailers to elevate store and counter performance.
* Support new openings, renovations and strategic retail projects, ensuring operational readiness and strong execution.
* Identify opportunities to simplify ways of working and improve retail effectiveness across markets.
* Retail Experience & Excellence
* Champion a distinctive and consistent Aesop retail experience across Travel Retail APAC.
* Translate Aesop’s service philosophy into practical retail standards appropriate to the travel environment.
* Elevate consultation quality, storytelling and sensorial experience to build meaningful and lasting customer connections.
* Balance global brand principles with local and traveller relevance.
* Education & Capability Building
* Lead TRAPAC Retail Education team for Aesop and define the regional education strategy.
* Build scalable learning programs that strengthen product knowledge, consultation capability, confidence and leadership skills.
* Evolve education from training delivery towards a strategic capability-building function directly connected to retail performance.
* Establish clear learning journeys for Retail Consultants, Store Managers and field leadership.
* Develop and coach market trainers and retail leaders, creating strong capability within local teams.
* Measure the effectiveness of education through both capability and business outcomes.
* People Leadership
* Lead, inspire and develop the regional Retail and Education teams.
* Build a high-performing community of retail leaders across APAC, encouraging exchange of best practices and collective problem solving.
* Coach teams combine strong commercial acumen with considered customer experience.
* Foster a culture of accountability, curiosity, collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Cross-functional & Partner Leadership
* Act as the regional voice of Retail, bringing frontline and customer perspectives into commercial, marketing and business decisions.
* Partner closely with Business Development, Marketing, Visual Merchandising, Operations and market teams to ensure integrated execution.
* Connect regional priorities with global Retail and Education direction while representing APAC Travel Retail needs and opportunities.
* Financial Stewardship & Resource Management
* A&P Governance: Oversee Retail & Education and Retail A&P budgets, ensuring strategic allocation of resources across training, stock, promoters, and incentives.
* Commercial Review: Partner with leadership on strategic financial reviews to maximize return on investment.

What We Are Looking For
  

* Significant leadership experience in Retail, Retail Excellence, Education or Commercial functions within luxury, beauty or premium consumer brands.
* Strong understanding of multi-market retail environments; Travel Retail experience is highly valued.
* Proven ability to lead both retail performance and people capability agendas.
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate KPIs and consumer insights into practical retail actions.
* Demonstrated experience building and developing high-performing teams across different markets and cultures.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing capability, including experience working with external retail partners.
* Able to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
* Passionate about customer experience, service, education and developing people.
* Comfortable navigating complexity and building simple, scalable solutions across a diverse regional network.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
Success in this role means creating a Travel Retail organization where Retail and Education operate as one engine: stronger people create stronger experiences, and stronger experiences translate into sustainable commercial performance.
  
  
The Head of Retail will ultimately ensure that wherever travellers encounter Aesop across APAC, they experience the same depth of knowledge, generosity of consultation and distinctive sense of place that define the brand.

title: Director, Field Operations, SEA
description:
**Who we are:**

Build your best future with the Johnson Controls team.

As a global leader in smart, healthy and sustainable buildings, our mission is to reimagine the performance of buildings to serve people, places and the planet. Join a winning team that enables you to build your best future! Our teams are uniquely positioned to support a multitude of industries across the globe. You will have the opportunity to develop yourself through meaningful work projects and learning opportunities. We strive to provide our employees with an experience focused on supporting their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing. Become a member of the Johnson Controls family and thrive in an empowering company culture where your voice and ideas will be heard – your next great opportunity is just a few clicks away!

**What you will do:**

As the Director, Field Operations, SEA, you will lead operational performance, execution excellence, and field operations transformation across Southeast Asia, driving predictable delivery, productivity improvement, risk mitigation, and improved operational profitability across Systems and Services operations. You will oversee regional forecasting, project and service performance, cost optimization, and operational productivity while establishing consistent standards for execution, governance, and performance management across markets.

**How you will do it:**

**Field Operations Leadership**

* Own and drive Systems and Services operational performance through effective management of leading and lagging indicators across Southeast Asia.
* Oversee and consolidate Systems forecasting through Project Controllers and Services forecasting through Service Enablement teams, ensuring alignment with country business plans and regional objectives.
* Partner closely with Country Leadership teams to improve forecast accuracy, resource planning, revenue predictability, and operational execution.
* Drive improvements in cost management, schedule performance, project controls, service productivity, and operational risk management across the region.
* Lead field operations cost optimization initiatives, ensuring savings opportunities and productivity improvements are identified, tracked, and delivered as part of transformation objectives.
* Drive consistent Services performance and installed-base management across SEA, strengthening data quality, operational visibility and insights to support service growth.
* Partner with the Senior Manager, Performance and Transformation, to strengthen analytics and early insights, enabling proactive intervention and optimization of Systems and Services execution.

title: Commercial Excellence Director
description:
**Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.**

**Our Point of Care diagnostic portfolio spans key heath and therapeutic areas, including infections disease, cardiometabolic, informatics and toxicology.**

**Working at Abbott**

  

* At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self and live a full life. You will have access to:
* Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
* A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
* A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as a best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

**The Opportunity**

As the **Commercial Excellence Director**, you will be responsible for driving sustainable revenue growth, forecasting accuracy, commercial performance, and business intelligence across the Diagnostics business. This role partners closely with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, and Commercial Operations to optimize demand planning, revenue recognition, funnel management, pricing strategy, tender excellence, distribution management, and sales force effectiveness (SFE). The position serves as the commercial data and analytics leader and champion for disciplined execution to achieve growth plans and maximize business performance.

**What You’ll Do**

**Demand Planning & Revenue Management**

* Lead the end-to-end demand planning process to ensure accurate forecasting and alignment with business objectives
* Drive monthly and quarterly sales forecast reviews with commercial and finance teams.
* Establish forecast accuracy metrics and continuously improve demand planning capabilities.
* Ensure robust revenue recognition governance and compliance with corporate and financial policies.
* Identify business risks and opportunities affecting revenue delivery and implement mitigation plans.

**Funnel & Opportunity Management**

* Own commercial funnel management processes across all markets and business segments.
* Implement standardized sales pipeline governance, ensuring funnel quality, visibility, and predictability.
* Monitor conversion rates, opportunity progression, and sales cycle effectiveness.
* Drive opportunity reviews and commercial performance discussions with regional and country teams.
* Develop actionable insights to improve win rates and accelerate revenue realization.

**Sales Force Effectiveness (SFE) & KPI Excellence**

  

* Establish and monitor key commercial performance indicators across the region.
* Design and continuously improve SFE frameworks, dashboards, and performance tracking tools.
* Measure productivity, territory effectiveness, customer coverage, and sales execution quality.
* Partner with sales leadership to identify performance gaps and develop corrective actions.
* Lead initiatives that improve commercial productivity and overall business performance.

**Sales Analytics & Business Intelligence**

* Build advanced analytical capabilities to support strategic decision-making.
* Develop and maintain commercial dashboards, reports, and performance scorecards.
* Transform data into actionable business insights to identify growth opportunities and operational improvements.
* Lead market analysis, customer segmentation, and profitability assessments.
* Support leadership teams with scenario planning and business performance reviews.
* Pricing Strategy & Tender Management
* Develop and implement pricing strategies that maximize profitability while maintaining market competitiveness.
* Establish pricing governance frameworks and approval processes.
* Lead tender excellence initiatives, including bid evaluation, pricing recommendations, and margin optimization.
* Analyze tender performance, win/loss trends, and pricing effectiveness.
* Collaborate with sales, finance, and legal teams to ensure compliant and profitable tender submissions.
* Commercial Governance & Process Excellence
* Standardize commercial excellence processes across markets.
* Drive adoption of CRM and commercial performance management tools.
* Lead commercial operating reviews and business performance governance.
* Ensure data quality, process compliance, and reporting accuracy across the organization.
* Champion continuous improvement and digital transformation initiatives.

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience in Commercial Excellence, Sales Operations, Business Analytics, Commercial Planning, or related commercial leadership roles.  
  Strong commercial understanding preferably in diagnostics.
* Proven track record in leading commercial excellence functions within the Pharmaceutical, Diagnostics, Medical Devices, or Healthcare industries.
* Strong experience in demand planning, forecasting, revenue management, and commercial analytics.
* Demonstrated success in pipeline/funnel management and sales force effectiveness programs.
* Extensive experience in commercial governance.
* Experience leading regional or multi-country, multi-culture commercial operations is highly preferred.
* Strong preference for candidates from the pharmaceutical industry, diagnostics, or Point of Care.
* Good understanding of the Diagnostics industry, including laboratory workflows, diagnostic testing markets, healthcare procurement processes, and tender-driven business models.
* Understanding point of care diagnostics is a big plus.
* Advanced commercial analytics and business intelligence capabilities.
* Strong knowledge of CRM systems (Salesforce, Dynamics, or similar).
* Proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, or other data visualization tools.
* Strong forecasting and demand planning methodologies.
* Commercial acumen with understanding of commercial business model including both direct & distribution model.
* Advanced Excel and data modeling capabilities.
* Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.
* Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Strong communication and executive presentation capabilities.
* Proven ability to drive change and lead cross-functional initiatives.

title: Director of Food & Beverage
description:
We are in the luxury hotel business in central Singapore; offering business and leisure travelers contemporary rooms and suites filled with opulent amenities and elegant furnishings, alongside first-rate facilities, exquisite French and local cuisines in our all-day dining restaurant, bar and a huge convention space with meeting rooms and 2 ballrooms to cater to corporate, meeting guests as well as leisure function events including weddings & dinner & dances. We represent the renowned French living and Sofitel hospitality in Singapore.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities:**  
Ensuring guest and employee satisfaction, while maintaining market competitiveness and exceptional financial performance.
  
  
Ensuring appropriate hiring, training, motivating, coaching, and developing of department’s team members.
  
  
Responsible for ensuring the smooth daily operation of the Food and Beverage Department.
  
  
Develop and administer the F&B budget, action plan and promotional activities of the department to stimulate sales and profit while controlling operating expenses.
  
  
Surveying, reviewing and analyzing competition, market trends, customer needs and comments in order to be proactive and adapt with business intelligence.
  
  
Evaluating changes in guest needs, the guest mix and competitive set, to recommend appropriate product/service and operational changes as necessary.
  
  
Attend and actively participate in weekly Head of Department meetings respecting the confidentiality of issues which may be discussed formally or informally.
  
  
Manage the service of food and beverage within the restaurant, café, bar, and in room dining.
  
  
Ensure cleaning and maintenance of outlets, work areas, tableware, utensils and other materials and equipment used by restaurant, bar, room service and conference areas.
  
  
Regular liaison with the Engineering Department ensuring that maintenance requests are completed quickly focusing on guest needs as a priority.
  
  
Coordinate between Conference and Events, Food & Beverage and Front Office to ensure that preparations for conference events involving Front Office/ Housekeeping have been made.
  
  
Assist in the preparation monthly restaurant, bar, and cafe reports, commenting on key performance indicators and action taken to keep on target.
  
  
Management and guidance of outlet staff under control, namely Managers, Food & Beverage Supervisors/ Team Leaders and Food and Beverage Attendants.
  
  
Prepare weekly and monthly forecasts for restaurant, bar room service and cafe areas.
  
  
Be knowledgeable of and operate within appropriate outlets and hotel liquor licensing guidelines and House Management Policies.
  
  
Any other duties as assigned.
  
  
**Position Requirements:**  
Minimum 5 - 8 years of experience in a similar role, preferably in a five star luxury setting.
  
  
Proven experience in meeting budgeted and forecasted for costs for payroll/wage costs and department costs.
  
  
Experience in managing and developing a team, including performance management, performance reviews, disciplinary procedures, creating learning and development plans, coaching etc.
  
  
Has a good understanding of luxury guest expectations and desire to meet these expectations.
  
  
Hold legislative qualifications to be eligible for the position.
  
  
Good understanding of Micros, Opera, and other relevant applications.
  
  
Project professional image at all times through personal presentation/ interpersonal skills.
  
  
Desire and ability to mentor, train and develop staff.
  
  
Has awareness of industry trends in service, product and presentation.
  
  
Initiates contacts and establishes rapport easily.
  
  
Ability to assert point of view directly yet tactfully.
  
  
Organize time and work efficiently.
  
  
Excellent numeracy, verbal and written communication skills, English essential
  
  
Appreciates and maintains an effective outlet for stress.
  
  
Aptitude for developing promotions and marketing.
  
  
Willingness to work weekends and public holidays as part of the job role.
  
  
A passion for food, wine and the culinary arts that is knowledgeable and effusive.
  
  
Has the aptitude and willingness to undertake further development with Sofitel.
  
  
Nestled amidst historic shop houses and towering skyscrapers, Sofitel Singapore City Centre is an elegantly designed 223-room luxury hotel reflecting Singapore’s rich cultural heritage with undeniable French flair.
  
  
An oasis at the heart of Tanjong Pagar, the hotel is conveniently situated just 20 minutes from Singapore’s Changi Airport, and offers gastronomic dining options including Racines, an all-day dining restaurant serving Authentic French and Local cuisine, as well as 1864, serving up cocktails and exquisite afternoon tea. The hotel boasts close to 20,000 square feet of meeting spaces across 10 flexible venues including the 600 sqm Wallich Ballroom, presenting a strategic venue of choice for MICE, business meetings, seamless soirees and the finest celebrations and weddings banquets.

title: Sales Director, Japan & Korea Market, CreditSights, Singapore based
description:
**Job Description**  
  
**CreditSights is currently seeking a** **Sales Director/Account Manager - Japan & Korea (Based in Singapore | Hybrid) .** **Please understand that fluent in Japanese is required for this role (business level and above).**  
  
CreditSights is the world's leading independent credit research firm, relied on by over 1,000 institutional clients globally to make prudent, profitable investment decisions in the global markets. Our exceptional team includes nearly 100 analysts with deep experience, allowing us to provide a unique micro-to-macro perspective across 35 industries in a way our clients could never achieve on their own.
  
  
CreditSights provides unparalleled credit intelligence and tools supporting our clients' growth, efficiency, and risk management objectives. We provide business leaders with the knowledge to confidently navigate an evolving marketplace.
  
  
CreditSights is a Fitch Solutions Company and part of Fitch Group.
  
  
**How You'll Make an Impact:**  
  
This is a hybrid sales role combining **account management** of an existing book of business with **new logo acquisition** across the Japan and Korea markets. You will bring a "hunter" mindset-identifying, qualifying, and closing opportunities-while also deepening relationships within existing accounts to ensure retention and expansion. This role is central to driving CreditSights' growth engine in two of our most strategically important markets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**Account Management**

* Manage and grow an existing book of business, working closely with Client Success Managers, product specialists, and fellow account managers to deliver a coordinated client experience.
* Drive company revenue growth while maximizing client value and embedding CreditSights into clients' workflows.

**New Business Acquisition**

* Identify and engage prospective clients across Banks, Insurers, Private Wealth, Hedge Funds, and Asset Managers.
* Develop and execute business development strategies targeting both greenspace (new logos) and whitespace (expansion within existing accounts) opportunities.
* Build and maintain a robust, well-qualified sales pipeline.

**Market Outreach & Strategy**

* Design and execute market outreach programs aligned with regional strategic priorities.
* Partner with the market development team and senior management to identify and cultivate emerging market opportunities.
* Expand your professional network through industry associations, relevant forums, and close collaboration with Marketing.

**Sales Process Management**

* Source leads, progress opportunities, and maintain accurate, up-to-date records of all sales activity and client interactions in the CRM.
* Continuously uncover new business opportunities within existing accounts across all CreditSights service lines.
* Own the full sales cycle, from initial engagement through to closed-won.

**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**

* 8+ years of experience in customer-facing, quota-carrying sales, account management, or relationship management roles-ideally within data, financial information vendors, banking, or broker/dealer environments.
* Strong understanding of the Asia Pacific financial markets landscape, particularly credit markets.
* Demonstrated ability to articulate and position the value of CreditSights' content and products to solve clients' key business challenges.
* A proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas.
* Strong relationship-building and client management skills, with the ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder accounts.
* Comfort collaborating cross-functionally with senior management and internal teams.
* A self-starter mentality with a hands-on approach, well-suited to a growth-phase business.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Excellent written and verbal English.
* **Fluent Japanese is required** (business level or above).
* Willingness to be based in Singapore with frequent travel to Japan and Korea.

**What Would Make You Stand Out**

* A growth-oriented mindset and entrepreneurial drive.
* Experience within DCM, fixed income, or credit investment functions.
* Fluency in Korean.
* A consistently strong sales track record, evidenced by quota attainment history.
* Comfort and fluency using AI tools to enhance productivity and client engagement.

**Why Choose Fitch**

* **Hybrid Work Environment** : 3 days a week in office, based on your line of business and location.
* **A Culture of Learning & Mobility** : Dedicated training, leadership development, and mentorship programs to support continuous growth.
* **Investing in Your Future** : Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs to help you achieve short- and long-term goals.
* **Promoting Health & Wellbeing** : Comprehensive healthcare offerings supporting physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing.
* **Supportive Parenting Policies** : Family-friendly policies, including generous global parental leave, to help balance career and family life.
* **Inclusive Work Environment** : A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, supported by Employee Resource Groups worldwide.
* **Dedication to Giving Back** : Paid volunteer days and matched funding for charitable donations.

At Fitch, AI is embedded in how we work every day-supporting smarter decision-making, streamlining workflows, and enabling new ways to create value for our business and clients. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day-to-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We're looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI-enabled environment-or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done.
  
  
Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch's credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interest or any appearance of a conflict of interest.
  
  
Fitch is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law.

title: Director of Sales & Marketing
description:
JOB SUMMARY
  
  
Functions as the leader of the property’s sales department for properties with bookings over 300 peak rooms and significant local catering revenue. Manages the property's reactive and proactive sales efforts. Provides day to day leadership to sales associates to achieve property sales objectives with overall responsibility for achieving booking goals and property revenues. Implements the brand’s service strategy and applicable brand initiatives in all aspects of the sales process and focuses on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of the hotel’s’ sales objectives. Evaluates the property’s participation in the various sales channels (e.g., Area Sales, Group Sales within the Sales Office, electronic lead channels, etc.) and develops strong working relationships to proactively position and market the property. Manages the marketing budget to enable development of property specific campaigns, promotions and collateral to drive revenue and meet property objectives. Interfaces with regional marketing communications for regional and national promotions pull through. Develops and implements property–wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand’s target customer profile and property associates and provides a return on investment to the owner and Marriott International.
  
  
CANDIDATE PROFILE
  
  
Education and Experience
  
  
**Required:**  

* 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

OR
  
  

* 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the sales and marketing or related professional area.

**Preferred:**  

* 4 year college degree.
* Demonstrated skills in supervising a team.
* Lodging sales experience.
* Hotel industry work experience, demonstrating progressive career growth and a pattern of exceptional performance.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES
  
  
Managing Sales Activities
  
  

* Manages the development of a strategic account plan for the demand generators in the market.
* Manages the property's reactive and proactive sales efforts.
* Determines and develops marketing communication activities, in conjunction with Regional Marketing Communications.
* Provides customer intelligence in evaluating the market and economic trends that may lead to changes in sales strategy to meet or exceed customer expectations.
* Reviews the Strategic Alignment Review (STAR) report, competitive shopping reports and uses other resources to maintain an awareness of the hotel’s market position.
* Researches competitor’s sales team strategies to identify ways to grow occupancy and RevPAR and increase market share.

* Suggests innovative marketing ideas and develops deployment strategies to continue to grow market share.
* Evaluates and supports participation and account deployment with Area Sales and Group Sales within the Sales Office.

* Serves as hotel authority on sales processes and sales contracts.
* Serves as the property sales liaison with Area Sales, Group Sales, Revenue Management, Event Management, Regional Marketing Communications and other hotel departments as appropriate.
* Participates in sales calls with members of the Sales and Marketing team to acquire new business and/or close on business.
* Identifies public relations opportunities and coordinates activities to augment the overall marketing communication strategy.
* Supports the General Manager by coordinating crisis communications.
* Executes and supports Marriott’s Customer Service Standards and hotel’s Brand Standards.
* Executes and supports the operational aspects of business booked (e.g., generating proposal, writing contract, customer correspondence).
* Participates in and practices daily service basics of the brand (e.g., , Marriott Hotels and Resorts (MHR) Spirit to Serve Daily Basics, Renaissance Hotels and Resorts (RHR) Savvy Service Basics, Courtyard, SpringHill Suites, Fairfield Inn Basics of the Day, Residence Inn Daily Huddle, or TownePlace Suites Morning Meeting).

* Monitors the effective resolution of guest issues that arise as a result of the sales process by creating mechanisms to channel issues to property leadership and/or other appropriate stakeholders.
* Maintains successful performance by increasing revenues, controlling expenses and providing a return on investment for the owner and Marriott International.
* Implements the brand’s service strategy and applicable brand initiatives in all aspects of the sales process and focuses on building long-term, value-based customer relationships that enable achievement of the hotel’s’ sales objectives.
* Interfaces with regional marketing communications for regional and national promotions pull through.
* Performs other duties, as assigned, to meet business needs.

Building Successful Relationships
  
  

* Develops strong partnerships with local organizations to further increase brand/product awareness.
* Develops and manages internal key stakeholder relationships.
* Develops strong community and public relations by maintaining property participation in local, regional and national tradeshows and client events.
* Executes exemplary customer service to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty by assisting the customer and monitoring their satisfaction before and during their program/event.
* Serves the customer by understanding their needs and recommending the appropriate features and services that best meet their needs and exceed their expectations, while building a relationship and loyalty to Marriott.
* Gains understanding of the hotel’s primary target customer and service expectations; serves the customer by understanding their business, business issues and concerns, to offer better business solution both prior to, and during the program/event.

Leadership
  
  

* Functions as the leader of the property’s sales department for properties with bookings over 300 peak rooms and significant local catering revenue.
* Develops sales goals and strategies and verifies alignment with the brand business strategy.
* Executes the sales strategy in order to meet individual booking goals for both self and staff.
* Coaches leaders of revenue generating departments in developing effective revenue strategies and setting aggressive goals that will drive the property's financial performance.
* Verifies Sales team understands and is leveraging Marriott International (MI) demand engines to full potential.
* Works with Human Resources, Engineering and Loss Prevention to monitor compliance with local, state and federal regulations and/or union requirements.
* Partners with Human Resources to attract, develop and retain the right people in order to support the strategic priorities of the market.
* Creates effective structures, processes, jobs and performance management systems are in place.
* Sets goals and expectations for direct reports using the Leadership Performance Process (LPP), aligns performance and rewards, addresses performance issues and holds staff accountable for successful results.
* Forecasts talent needs and manages talent acquisition strategy with Human Resources (HR) to minimize lost time due to turnover.
* Maintains an active list of the competition’s best sales people and executes a recruitment and acquisition plan with HR.
* Supports tools and training resources to educate sales associates on winning catering solutions.
* Champions leadership development and workforce planning priorities by assessing, selecting, retaining and developing diverse, high-caliber talent that can lead the organization today and strengthen the leadership bench for the future; continues to upgrade the sales & marketing talent; works with HR to anticipate future talent needs based on business growth plans.
* Identifies, trains and mentors group sales associates; utilizes all available on the job training tools for associates.

title: Senior Manager, Group internal audit
description:
Be a Part of Something BIG!
  
  
The Senior Manager, Group Internal Audit – Technology is a senior specialist role within Singtel Group Internal Audit, reporting directly to the Audit director, and is responsible for providing independent, objective, and risk-based assurance over Singtel’s technology, cybersecurity, and digital environments. The Senior Manager leads and delivers complex technology and cybersecurity audits, engagements, overseeing audit planning, execution and reporting, and providing robust and evidence-based challenge to key stakeholders. The role contributes to the development of the technology audit plan and ensures audit outcomes are high quality, actionable, and support effective risk management and control improvement. Audit outputs contribute directly to management assurance, Audit Committee reporting, and regulatory disclosures. Group Internal Audit operates as a key pillar of Singtel’s corporate governance framework and reports functionally to the Singtel Group Audit Committee.
  
  
Make an Impact by
  
  
Lead end-to-end delivery of complex, risk-based technology and cybersecurity audits across Singtel Group.
  
  
Develop Audit Planning Memorandums (APMs), defining audit objectives, scope, risks, and audit approach.
  
  
Design and implement audit programs and procedures aligned to Group Internal Audit methodology and professional standards.
  
  
Assess the design and operating effectiveness of IT general controls, application controls, cybersecurity controls, and technology governance frameworks.
  
  
Evaluate major technology initiatives and systems under development to ensure appropriate governance, controls, documentation, and security-by-design.
  
  
Provide independent assurance over cybersecurity risk management, including protection of networks, cloud environments, systems, and sensitive data.
  
  
Assess compliance with relevant laws, regulations, industry standards, and Singtel policies (e.g. data protection, cybersecurity, technology risk).
  
  
Identify emerging technology risks and assess Singtel’s control maturity and risk posture.
  
  
Perform control advisory reviews for significant in-flight programs and strategic initiatives where required.
  
  
Identify root causes of control deficiencies and develop practical, commercially grounded recommendations.
  
  
Prepare high-quality audit reports with minimal supervision and ensure alignment and agreement of findings with senior management.
  
  
Lead audit kick-off and closing meetings with senior executives, ensuring clear communication of objectives, scope, findings, and risk implications.
  
  
Provide clear, credible challenge to senior stakeholders while maintaining strong professional relationships and audit independence.
  
  
Escalate significant or high-risk matters to the Audit Director and support Audit Committee reporting.
  
  
Coach, train, and review the work of less experienced auditors, embedding audit methodology, quality standards, and professional judgement.
  
  
Provide technical leadership in technology and cybersecurity auditing across the function.
  
  
Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of technology audit methodology, tools, and practices.
  
  
Oversee tracking and validation of management action plans and perform follow-up reviews to ensure timely and effective remediation.
  
  
Support annual audit planning, resource management, and prioritisation of technology audit coverage.
  
  
Contribute to ad-hoc assignments, investigations, and Audit Committee-related matters as required.
  
  
Stay current on emerging technology, cybersecurity threats, and industry developments, applying insights to strengthen audit coverage and impact.
  
  
Skills for Success
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related discipline.
  
  
Professional certification such as CISA, CISSP, CISM, or CIA.
  
  
Extensive experience in technology audit, IT risk, cybersecurity, or internal audit, preferably within large, complex organisations.
  
  
Strong understanding of telecommunications, digital platforms, and large-scale technology environments.
  
  
Hands-on experience auditing cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and modern architectures.
  
  
Proven ability to lead complex audits and engage credibly with senior management.
  
  
Excellent analytical, report writing, and influencing skills.
  
  
Are you ready to say hello to BIG Possibilities?
  
  
Take the leap with Singtel to unlock new opportunities and accelerate your growth. Apply now and start your empowering career!
