Group Digital L!fe strives to bring people together with a cutting edge mix of digital services such as NextGen TV, e-books, music, digital concierge, cloud-based gaming and hyperlocal content.
  
  
Headquartered in Singapore, Singtel’s 130 years of operating experience has played a pivotal role in the country’s transformation into a major communications hub. Our Australian arm, Optus is an innovative leader in integrated telecommunications. Through our strategic investments in five regional mobile operators, Telkomsel, Globe Telecom, Advanced Info Service, PBTL, and Bharti Airtel, we are a major communications player in Asia and Africa.
  
  
Singtel is the largest listed company on the Singapore Exchange by market capitalisation. We have a vast network of offices in countries and territories throughout Asia Pacific, in Europe, USA and Australia. The Group employs more than 21,000 staff worldwide and has served 468 million mobile customers globally as of 31 March 2013.

title: Head of Regional Security, APAC
description:
At AIG, our business spans the globe. To achieve our objectives, we must be able to navigate complex and rapidly changing landscapes with confidence.

The Senior Manager - Head of Regional Security, Asia Pacific, is based in Singapore and reports to the Director, Global Security Operations in United States. This role provides the leadership, structure, partnerships, processes, and technology needed to protect AIG employees, facilities, operations, and reputation across the region.

The role leads physical security operations and investigations across 14 countries supporting approximately 4,600 colleagues. This role serves as the senior regional security advisor, translates global security strategy and standards into effective regional execution, and ensures that emerging risks are identified, communicated, and mitigated.

The ideal candidate will bring substantial multi-country security leadership experience, strong program and people-management capability, sound business judgment, and a highly collaborative approach. AIG is seeking a leader who embraces teamwork, change, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Lead AIG's physical security and protective-risk program across Asia Pacific, establishing regional priorities, operating objectives, and long-term capabilities that protect employees, facilities, operations, and corporate reputation.
* Serve as the principal regional security advisor to APAC business leadership and Global Security, providing strategic counsel regarding geopolitical developments, emerging threats, security incidents, and organizational risk and exposure.
* Translate global security strategy, standards, and policies into consistent regional execution while adapting controls to local threat, regulatory, cultural, and operating environments.
* Lead, develop, and mentor a geographically dispersed regional team, establishing clear accountabilities, succession capability, and a culture of operational excellence, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
* Define and monitor key performance indicators, operational metrics, risk trends, remediation activity, project delivery, and program maturity measures to evaluate effectiveness and drive continuous improvement.
* Manage regional security budgets, vendors, guard-force arrangements, contracts, service-level expectations, and capital investments to ensure effective resource allocation and measurable value.

title: Manager, AP VCS Marketing
description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Role Summary:

What a B2B & Product Marketing Manager does at Visa:

Reporting to the Director of B2B and Product Marketing for Commercial Solutions, the B2B & Product Marketing Manager will support key growth initiatives across Asia Pacific, with a focus on demand generation, B2B segment marketing, thought leadership, and events.

You will work closely with regional and market Sales, Product, Corporate Communications, and Marketing teams to develop customer-centric campaigns, content and experiences that build awareness, generate demand and support adoption of Visa Commercial Solutions. You are a strategic and hands-on marketer who understands customer needs, brings strong attention to detail, and uses data and insights to continuously improve marketing effectiveness.

Working in an agile environment, you must proactively ensure we achieve our goals and be skilled at pivoting and adjusting as new information and opportunities arise.

Key responsibilities:

Demand and lead generation:

* Design, support, and execute lead generation campaign strategies that showcase our commercial offerings, clearly communicate our value, and deliver measurable outcomes.
* Partner with Sales and Marketing Operations to define target accounts and audiences, support lead generation and nurturing, and progress marketing-engaged leads through the sales funnel.
* Coordinate campaign implementation across global/regional/market teams and agencies, ensuring that programs are delivered on time, within budget, and to a consistently high standard.
* Create and localize sales enablement tools that empower sales team to engage target clients effectively.
* Track and analyze campaign performance and recommend optimizations to improve engagement, lead quality, conversion and ROI.

Events marketing:

* Plan and execute Visa-led client events, webinars and industry event activations that build thought leadership, strengthen client engagement and generate demand.
* Develop event objectives, target audiences, agendas, engagement strategies and content plans in partnership with Sales, Product, Communications and market teams.
* Manage end-to-end event delivery, including timelines, stakeholders, agencies and vendors, content development, budgets, and pre- and post-event engagement.
* Support Visa's participation in priority third-party industry events by evaluating opportunities and developing activation strategies that reach relevant decisionmakers.
* Track event performance, capture learnings and identify opportunities to improve future programs.

Thought leadership and content creation:

* Drive thought leadership initiatives that strengthen Visa's position as a trusted voice in the B2B payments ecosystem.
* Develop a strong understanding of target audiences, their needs, buying motivations and decision-making criteria, translating these insights into relevant value propositions, messaging and content.
* Translate complex product capabilities, market insights and payment trends into clear and engaging narratives for business decisionmakers.
* Collaborate with subject-matter experts to develop high-quality content, client communications and speaker materials across campaigns and events.
* Monitor industry trends, competitive activity and market opportunities, applying insights to strengthen marketing strategies and programs.

As the B2B and Product Marketing Manager for Commercial Solutions, you will have a unique opportunity to shape our Asia Pacific B2B marketing efforts and play a vital role in achieving our growth objectives. If you are passionate about driving growth, building brand leadership, and creating marketing that delivers real business results, we’d love to hear from you.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* 6-8 years of experience in B2B Marketing or Product Management/Marketing, segment marketing, or event marketing, preferably in payments, financial services, or technology.
* Experience supporting integrated demand-generation campaigns/programs across channels, with an understanding of audience segmentation, account targeting, lead generation, nurturing, and sales conversion.
* Strong project-management capabilities, with experience coordinating multiple internal stakeholders, agencies, vendors, speakers, deliverables and timelines.
* Strong content development and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex ideas into clear, compelling messages for business audiences.
* Analytical mindset with experience leveraging data to measure performance, optimize marketing activity and inform decisions.
* Proficient in marketing automation tools and CRM software.
* Strategic, proactive and results oriented, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong planning, organizational and problem-solving skills
* Collaborative and culturally aware, with the ability to work effectively across regional, market, global and cross-functional teams.
* Global sensibilities and an empathetic outlook to work collaboratively with other markets and cultures around the world.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Financial Lines Underwriting Executive
description:
About Delta
  
  
Delta Underwriting Singapore is part of Delta Insurance Group, an independent specialist Managing General Agent (MGA) founded in New Zealand in 2014. Today the Group operates across APAC.
  
  
Delta was created to meet the need for insurance in emerging and specialised areas, with risk management strategies tailored to local markets. We’re known as a specialist underwriter in Cyber, Technology and Financial Lines, and known for our thought leadership and smarter ways of underwriting.
  
  
Our Singapore team is growing, and we’re looking for an experienced underwriter to grow with us. You’ll get the agility of a close-knit local team, backed by the expertise and support of the wider Group. If you’re ready to step away from rigid hierarchies, work closely with decision-makers, see your ideas put into practice quickly and have a direct hand in shaping the business, this is the role for you.
  
  
About the role
  
  
As our Financial Lines Underwriting Executive, you’ll report to the Singapore Head of Financial Lines with a dotted reporting line to the Managing Director of Delta Underwriting Singapore.
  
  
This role suits someone who enjoys the technical side of underwriting and also wants to help grow a portfolio by building strong broker relationships and contributing new product ideas. You’ll have broad visibility across the business and real influence over how we grow.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
Underwrite Financial Lines risks within delegated authority under our Lloyd’s binding authority
  
  
Analyse risk and exposure data to make sound underwriting decisions
  
  
Help shape our underwriting strategy and drive process innovation
  
  
Build and manage strong relationships with brokers and intermediaries to drive profitable growth
  
  
Support our relationships with capacity partners
  
  
Monitor portfolio performance closely
  
  
Keep systems, processes, guidelines and controls working well so we select the right risks
  
  
Promote our products with a customer-focused approach
  
  
Bring ideas for new products and improvements to our existing range
  
  
Stay ahead of legal and regulatory changes so our underwriting keeps pace
  
  
Deliver great service through fast quote turnaround and strong policy administration
  
  
Gain regional exposure across markets beyond Singapore
  
  
What you’ll bring
  
  
2+ years underwriting experience in Financial Lines, ideally in a Lloyd’s, MGA or insurer setting
  
  
Good knowledge of the Singapore and/or Asian Financial Lines market
  
  
An established broker network, or the drive to build one
  
  
Strong analytical skills and sound commercial judgement
  
  
Clear written and spoken communication, with confidence in negotiating
  
  
A relevant degree and/or professional qualification
  
  
About Us
  
  
Established in 2017, Delta Underwriting is the leading locally owned specialist underwriting firm and the first Financial Lines Lloyd’s Coverholder based in Singapore. We challenge the status quo by reshaping our approach to insurance through product, technology and service innovation. We currently provide insurance solutions to more than ten countries in the Asia Pacific region with Delta Insurance Group offices headquartered in New Zealand.

title: Customer Success Executive
description:
About NexGen
  
  
NexGen Concepts Pte Ltd is a Singapore based, full service digital marketing and creative agency. We deliver integrated campaigns, creative and video production, events, SEM, SEO, AEO, social media, web development and AI solutions for brands in Singapore and the region.
  
  
We also build our own products, including NexPulse (unified marketing analytics) and GiftLab (corporate gifting). We expect every team member to use AI tools to work faster and better.
  
  
The role
  
  
At NexGen, Customer Success means project management. The Customer Success Executiveturns signed work into delivered work: on time, on budget and to the brief. You plan projects, coordinate our internal teams and suppliers, keep clients updated and resolve issues before they escalate.
  
  
Our Director of Business Development and Account Manager lead the client relationship and new proposals. You own delivery.
  
  
**Reports to:**  
Customer Success Lead
  
  
**Location:**  
Singapore
  
  
**Employment type:**  
Full time, permanent
  
  
**Responsibilities:** project planning and delivery
  
  
Turn approved scopes and quotations into project plans with milestones, owners, budgets and deadlines.
  
  
Brief department heads on each project's requirements; they assign team members, you track progress against the plan.
  
  
Run several concurrent projects across traditional work (events, print, video production) and digital work (campaigns, social, SEO, websites, AI builds).
  
  
Track timelines and budgets; flag risks early and escalate with options, not just problems.
  
  
Check deliverables against the brief before they reach the client.
  
  
Manage revision rounds within scope, approve one extra round where justified, and route anything beyond that for requoting.
  
  
Close each project with a short review of timeline, cost and client feedback.
  
  
**Responsibilities:** client communication, costing and suppliers
  
  
Be the client's day to day contact for project updates, approvals and issues.
  
  
Run status calls and send clear written updates; log every decision and change.
  
  
Resolve client issues quickly, and escalate to the Director when the relationship or revenue is at risk.
  
  
Prepare RFQs, source and compare suppliers, and agree markups with Business Development.
  
  
Manage suppliers on brief, timeline, quality and cost against the quotation.
  
  
Document change requests and pass out of scope work to Business Development for requoting.
  
  
Keep project records, files and trackers current in our project management tools.
  
  
Use AI tools for status reports, meeting notes and documentation, while checking accuracy and protecting client confidentiality.
  
  
What you bring
  
  
Must have
  
  
2 to 5 years of project management or client servicing at a marketing, creative, digital or events agency.
  
  
Hands on management of several concurrent projects from brief to delivery.
  
  
Experience preparing RFQs, comparing supplier quotes and working to a project budget.
  
  
Enough understanding of how creative, digital and production work gets made to plan realistic timelines and spot problems early.
  
  
Calm, firm client communication, including saying no to out of scope requests.
  
  
Strong written English and organised documentation.
  
  
Comfort with project management tools (Asana, Monday.com or similar) and spreadsheets.
  
  
Daily, practical use of AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini.
  
  
Nice to have
  
  
Experience across both traditional (events, print, video) and digital projects.
  
  
Website or app development project experience.
  
  
Agile, Scrum, PMP or PRINCE2 training.
  
  
Bahasa Indonesia or Mandarin, useful for working with our regional team and clients.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
Ownership of delivery across a varied client portfolio.
  
  
Base salary of S$3500 to S$4,200 per month, depending on experience.
  
  
Work across creative, digital, events, tech and AI projects, and NexGen's own products.
  
  
Structured training in AI tools and workflows.
  
  
Leave and medical benefits in line with company policy.

description:

**Starting date:** 5 January 2027
  
  
From Tuesday to Saturday 9.30 to 18.30
  
  
Apply by 6 December 2026
  
  
**To Executive Director:** aude-emeline.loriot@alliancefrancaise.org.sg
  
  
**Barbara Chan:** finance-HR@alliancefrancaise.org.sg
  
  
**Virgile Prodhomme :** directorofstudies@alliancefrancaise.org.sg
  
  
Alliance Française de Singapour was founded in 1949. It is a non-profit educational and cultural organization, affiliated to the international network of Alliance Française. With more than 800 locations in 132 countries, the Alliance Française is undoubtedly the world’s largest network of any cultural association; it serves and gathers worldwide a multilingual and multicultural community of Francophiles.
  
  
Each year, Alliance Française de Singapour welcomes around 4,000 members of all ages (from 1 year old onwards) eager to learn the French language and explore French culture. It is also hosting the General Delegation of the Alliance Française in South East Asia, making it the flagship of the region.
  
  
For many years, Alliance Française de Singapour has offered a great array of cinema and performing arts events in its theatre as well as various visual art exhibitions in
  
  
la galerie
  
  
becoming a renowned cultural destination.
  
  
In the buzzing evolving Singaporean cultural landscape, Alliance Française continues to contribute in its modest fashion to the regional influence of the cultural scene of the City-State by positioning itself as a place of cultural expression for emerging artists of all disciplines. It articulates its cultural programming around five major events: the Francophonie Festival in March, the French Animation Film Festival in May, the International Music Day in June, the French Film Festival in November and the Fashion Artisan Week in December. Added to these major events are many other regular cultural
  
  
rendez-vous
  
  
: the Ciné-Club, the Ciné-Kids, the Ciné-Plus and the storytelling in
  
  
la médiathèque
  
  
. Alliance Française also organizes social events (Bastille Day, French Friday) where our students and public can enjoy a taste of French flavors while using the French language.
  
  
Most of our events are organized in partnership with the unfailing support of the French Embassy/Institut Français Singapour and local partners.
  
  
Alliance Française cultural and educational programming is extremely rich and coherent in achieving its goal: to create a desire of France (and French) to an everlasting greater community of people whose strength is built from crosscultural understanding which is at the heart of all dialogue.

title: Engineering Director, APAC
description:
Global Switch are recruiting for an Engineering Director, based in Singapore, who will set the strategic direction and provide accountable leadership for engineering delivery across Global Switch’s data centre portfolio across Asia Pacific. This is an exciting time within Global Switch as we expand our presence in Asia Pacific with new data centres planned in Johor, Malaysia and Bangkok, Thailand. These will sit alongside our existing best-in-class data centres in Singapore and Hong Kong. You will ensure our engineering designs, standards and practices deliver resilient, cost-effective and sustainable infrastructure that supports our business objectives and evolving customer needs. Working closely with Operations, Projects and external partners, you will translate complex engineering challenges into clear, commercially sound decisions, optimise total cost of ownership and embed innovation across power, cooling and critical infrastructure systems.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Provide strategic and technical oversight of engineering designs, client briefs and infrastructure assessments, ensuring risks, defects and Single Points of Failure are identified and effectively addressed.
* Partner with Operations, Projects, OEMs and external specialists to improve resilience, maintenance outcomes and procurement, with a strong focus on whole-life cost, technical quality and operational performance.
* Lead, develop and inspire a high-performing engineering team, creating clear accountability and a collaborative culture that can deliver confidently through change, complexity and ambiguity.
* Drive sustainability, innovation and continuous improvement across power, cooling and critical infrastructure, improving energy and water efficiency, strengthening engineering governance and embedding lessons learned across future projects.

**About you**  
  
You are an accomplished engineering leader with the technical credibility, commercial judgement and strategic perspective to influence at senior level. You can balance long-term engineering strategy with practical delivery, bringing clarity to complex technical issues and building strong relationships across functions, regions and cultures. You take ownership, remain composed under pressure and create an environment in which people are encouraged to collaborate, innovate and continuously improve.  
  
**Key Requirements:**

* Significant senior engineering leadership experience within data centres, mission-critical infrastructure or another complex, highly regulated engineering environment.
* Deep technical understanding of critical infrastructure design, power and cooling systems, infrastructure resilience, defect remediation and engineering risk management.
* A strong track record of leading and developing engineering teams, setting clear standards and driving performance, accountability and cultural change.
* Strong commercial awareness, including experience of procurement, OEM and supplier relationships, capital investment decisions and total cost of ownership.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical matters clearly, influence without formal authority and align regional delivery with global strategy.

**About Global Switch**  
Global Switch is a trusted name in the industry, with over 25 years of experience and a commitment to long-term partnerships and sustainability.  
  
We value excellence and teamwork, and we always strive to deliver the best customer service and satisfaction. We are a team of skilled and passionate professionals, proud of who we are and what we do. Joining us means becoming part of a team that values learning and growth.  
  
**As an equal-opportunity employer, Global Switch is committed to providing a working culture that values diversity and inclusion and is committed to making reasonable adjustments to provide a barrier-free recruitment process and working environment.**

description:
The Business Account Management team act as the strategic connector between BSO and the broader organisation, bringing together stakeholder needs, business priorities and BSO’s global service portfolio. As part of the Service Experience Leadership Team, BAMs translate business insights into opportunities for BSO, shape stakeholder experience and help ensure our services continuously evolve to create value for the organisation.
  
  
Core responsibilities
  
  
Work independently, recognised point of contact for BSO stakeholders, able to coach and influence others and drive resolution of issues.
  
  
Operate as a senior strategic partner for BSO, independently shaping stakeholder strategy, influencing senior leaders and connecting business priorities with BSO capabilities to drive sustainable business outcomes:
  
  
Shape Strategic Partnerships -
  
  
build trusted partnerships with senior business stakeholders, BSO leaders and Service Delivery teams, proactively identifying evolving business needs and translating them into priorities, opportunities and actions across the BSO service portfolio.
  
  
Lead Stakeholder Strategy & Governance- define
  
  
and continuously evolve the regional stakeholder engagement strategy and governance model, enabling senior leaders to align priorities, accelerate decisions and maintain clear accountability across BSO and the business.
  
  
Influence Across the Enterprise -
  
  
navigate ambiguious and competing priorities, challenge constructively and influence senior cross-functional leaders to drive enterprise outcomes across markets, functions and BSO, often without direct authority.
  
  
Shape Transformation & Change -
  
  
represent the business and stakeholder perspective in major transformations, transitions and strategic initiatives, influencing design and implementation to ensure solutions deliver sustainable business value and a strong stakeholder experience.
  
  
Drive Customer Experience & Value -
  
  
lead the regional customer experience and NPS agenda, combining stakeholder insights, service performance and business context to identify opportunities that strengthen experience, service effectiveness and business value.
  
  
Lead Critical Issues & Outcomes -
  
  
orchestrate the business response to major incidents and critical cross-functional issues, aligning senior stakeholders, clarifying accountability and ensuring both immediate resolution and sustainable corrective actions.
  
  
Champion Service Excellence -
  
  
coach, challenge and influence BSO leaders and service teams to strengthen accountability, stakeholder orientation, transparent communication and continuous improvement, helping embed a consistently high-performing service culture across BSO.
  
  
Shape BSO Strategy & Priorities
  
  
– bring together stakeholder insights, regional trends and service experience to identify emerging opportunities and risks, contributing to BSO priorities, strategic planning and the evolution of the service model.
  
  
Play your part in our team succeeding
  
  
As a BAM, you will operate at regional leadership level and collaborate across the global BSO organisation, partnering with senior stakeholders and BSO leaders to shape priorities, influence strategic decisions, navigate complex business challenges and drive transformation and service improvements. You will also contribute to the broader Service Experience leadership agenda, people Pulse initiatives, strengthening collaboration, organisational capability and a high-performing culture across BSO.

Strong business acumen with the ability to understand company priorities, stakeholder needs and service delivery dynamics and translate them into clear priorities and business outcomes.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to influence, negotiate and challenge senior stakeholders constructively, driving alignment and decisions across organisational boundaries without relying on formal authority
  
  
High emotional intelligence and resilience, with the ability to navigate difficult conversations, critical incidents and conflicting perspectives while maintaining trust and constructive relationships.
  
  
Proven ability to operate strategically in ambiguous and complex environments, connecting multiple perspectives and moving from insight to action
  
  
Knowledge of the LEGO Group organisation, stakeholder landscape or BSO operating model would be an advantage.
  
  
Previous experience in shared services, global business services, service management or a similar operating model.
  
  
Exposure to customer/stakeholder experience methodologies, service performance insights or experience measures such as NPS.

We are seeking an experienced Head of Affiliate to lead the development and expansion of our international affiliate and strategic partnership business.

* Develop and execute regional affiliate and partnership growth strategies across AsiaPacific and other international markets.
* Identify new business opportunities, high-potential markets, and strategic partners to support long-term expansion.
* Set regional business targets, allocate resources, and monitor commercial performance.

* Lead and manage international business development teams across multiple markets.
* Oversee recruitment, onboarding, performance evaluation, and development of regional team members.

* Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Finance, Operations, and Compliance teams to improve affiliate systems and commercial processes.

title: Response Operations Manager
description:
**About Blackpanda**

Somewhere in Singapore tonight, a server room is on fire. Not literally, though sometimes it might as well be. A ransomware note is blinking on a managing director's screen in a tower above Raffles Place. A family office in Paya Lebar is locked out of its own ledgers. A trading desk in MBFC is running orders on paper. Somewhere a CIO is staring at the ceiling at three in the morning, wondering who to call.

That call comes to us.

Blackpanda is Asia's premier cyber crisis response firm: Lloyd's of London-accredited, regionally headquartered, and built for one purpose, to walk in when the worst has already happened and walk out leaving the company still on its feet. We do incident response and digital forensics. We are pure IR, and we like it that way.

**Three channels, one operating force.** We reach the market in three ways, and every channel feeds the same unit.

* **Consulting.** Hourly, senior-led engagements for enterprises and board-level matters where complexity, sensitivity, or scale demand our most experienced operators.
* **IR-1.** Our proprietary fixed-cost subscription, sold through IT channels and underwritten on our own insurance paper. IR-1 puts a real response solution in the hands of mid-market and small companies, paid up front, before the breach, with our team on the other end of every activation.
* **Traditional cyber insurance.** Full-stack policies for the mature, board-level buyer, with our response practice on the inside of every claim. Not a panel. Not a vendor. Our own people.
  

**The Cyber In-Extremis Force.** At the centre of everything is the CIF. In extremis describes the moment a situation has moved beyond the tolerance of conventional units. In-extremis forces are the no-fail option. Blackpanda was founded by three former operators of the Commander's In-Extremis Force, and they are building the cyber equivalent the only way they know how: same standards, same discipline, same refusal to compromise on who gets to wear the patch.

Every responder on the CIF roster holds, or is actively earning, multiple SANS Institute certifications. The company pays for the coursework and the certifications. By the end of 2026, Blackpanda expects to field 25 full-time incident responders, by a wide margin the largest pure-IR team in Asia-Pacific and Japan.

**Our Core Values**

  

* **Sincerity:** If we say we'll do it, it's as good as done. In combat, you have to know your right flank will be there at 0200 when they said they would. The work is the same.
* **Unity:** Debate fiercely, then commit fully. We all row in the same direction.
* **Efficiency:** Timing beats speed, precision beats power, leverage beats strength.
* **Humility:** Humility forms the basis of honor. We listen, then we act, then we listen again.
* **Grit:** We don't sugarcoat setbacks or bad news. We face challenges head-on and we don't quit when it gets hard.

**Our Mission:** To provide digital emergency response to everyone.

**Our Vision:** Accessing cyber incident response is as universally accessible as dialing 9-1-1.

  

**What we are looking for**

The Response Operations Manager is the operational nexus of the Cyber In-Extremis Force. Reporting to the VP of Response and working hand-in-hand with the Executive Director of Response, you take every piece of administration, scheduling, reporting and cross-functional coordination off the shoulders of Response leadership and the responders, so they can spend their hours where they matter: on the keyboard, in front of clients, and in the war room.

Work reaches Response from every direction: IR-1 activations, ODIR consulting engagements, insurance claims, and IRR proactive readiness consulting. You make sure each piece of that work is received, staffed, tracked, handed off and closed cleanly, and that every other function in the company (Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Technology, Insurance, People & Culture and Finance) has one reliable point of contact into Response.

You own the operating rhythm of the unit. You prepare the agendas, data and reporting packs for the weekly Response Operations sync with the C-Suite, the Directors' Weekly Meeting, and every internal operational meeting Response runs. You run the triage rotations, leave plans and overtime records. You keep the CIF training pipeline moving, from Immersive rotations through to SANS certifications, and you make sure performance reviews happen on time and to standard.

This is not a responder role, and you will not be expected to run investigations. You need to understand how incident response works well enough to know what a responder needs, when, and from whom. If you have run operations for a consulting, DFIR, MSSP or other high-tempo professional services team and want to build the operating backbone of the largest pure-IR team in APJ, we want to talk.

  

**Responsibilities and Duties**

**Engagement Intake and Response Operations**

  

* Act as the single intake and tracking point for all work entering Response: IR-1 activations, ODIR engagements, insurance claim activations, and IRR readiness consulting.
* Maintain the Response engagement tracker: case numbering, client, contract type, entitlements, assigned responders, status, hours and SLA clocks.
* Confirm, before work starts, what the contract entitles the client to (IR-1 tier, retainer hours, insurance policy limits, statement of work), and flag scope or entitlement gaps to Response leadership.
* Track IR-1 activation and response SLAs and escalate early when a clock is at risk.
* Run case closure: deliverables issued, hours finalised, evidence retention and disposal logged, lessons learned captured, and client feedback requested.

**Reporting, Metrics and Operating Rhythm**

  

* Own the agenda, pre-reads, data pack and action log for the weekly Response Operations sync with the C-Suite, the Directors' Weekly Meeting, and all internal Response operational meetings.
* Build and maintain Response metrics: engagement volume by channel, SLA adherence, utilisation, billable versus non-billable hours, overtime, subcontractor usage, training progress and review completion.
* Track decisions and due-outs from each meeting and chase them to closure.
* Turn raw data into clear reporting the C-Suite can act on, and flag trends (capacity strain, margin leakage, SLA risk) before they become problems.

**Scheduling, Capacity and Rotations**

  

* Build and publish the triage and on-call rotation across Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, the Philippines and Malaysia, covering time zones and public holidays.
* Maintain the Response leave plan and make sure coverage holds before leave is approved.
* Record overtime and out-of-hours work, and track time-in-lieu and fatigue across the team so workloads stay sustainable.
* Forecast capacity against pipeline and contracted demand, and give Response leadership the data to decide when to hire, when to use subcontractors, and when to push back on new work.

**Training, Certification and CIF Readiness**

  

* Own each responder's training plan, scheduling Immersive Labs rotations and tracking progress toward their SANS certification pathway.
* Coordinate SANS course enrolment, exam scheduling and training budget usage, including the 12-month retention requirement.
* Maintain the CIF certification register (who holds what, expiry and renewal dates) for internal planning, client proposals, insurance panels and audits.
* Report training progress to Response leadership and flag anyone falling behind their pathway.

**Performance and People Administration**

  

* Run the performance review calendar for Response with People & Culture: reminders, templates, deadlines and completion tracking.
* Check that reviews are completed to standard, on time, and catalogued correctly in the HR system.
* Coordinate responder onboarding and offboarding with People & Culture and IT, including equipment, tool access, training enrolment and access revocation.

**Cross-Functional Coordination**

  

You are Response's one point of contact for every other function.

* Sales  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Responder triage schedules and availability; scheduling responders for pre-sales calls, scoping and proposal support
* Legal  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Collaborate with the Legal department to facilitate Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) and Master Services Agreements (MSAs) tailored to response engagements. Document and oversee contractual obligations and stipulations that impact service delivery protocols per agreement.
* Marketing  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Responder input for thought leadership articles, technical review of marketing materials, event and speaking engagements, and case study pipeline from closed engagements
* Customer Success  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Which work is coming into Response under which contract; clean operational handoff by connecting the right responders with the right Customer Success owner
* Technology  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Response tooling requirements; contracting, onboarding and licence renewals for tools and platforms, including Immersive Labs and other training requirements
* Insurance  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Readiness consulting services that support Insurance; activation of insurance claims and the Response work they require
* People & Culture  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Responder time for interviews and hiring; JD creation and approvals; IR subcontractor rotation and usage; onboarding responders with IT and into the company
* Finance  
  What you coordinate on behalf of Response: Billable hours, timesheet compliance, and the metrics Finance needs for invoicing, WIP and margin reporting

**Subcontractors, Vendors and Tools**

  

* Maintain the IR subcontractor bench: onboarding, NDAs, rates, purchase orders, timesheets and quality feedback.
* Rotate subcontractor usage fairly and in line with what Response leadership approves, and track subcontractor spend against budget.
* Track Response tool licences, renewals and costs, and support procurement with Technology and Finance.
* Coordinate deployment logistics for on-site work: travel, visas, forensic kit and hardware inventory.

**Process, Compliance and Continuous Improvement**

  

* Document and maintain Response operating procedures and runbooks in Confluence.
* Support client and regulatory audit requests for Response (evidence handling records, staff vetting, certifications, on-premise requirements).
* Look for administrative work that can be automated, and use Blackpanda's approved AI tools to remove it.
  

**Qualifications and Experience**

**Minimum Requirements**

  

* 5+ years in operations, PMO, resource management or business operations, with at least 2 years supporting a consulting, DFIR, MSSP, legal, or other client-facing professional services team.
* Proven experience running scheduling, rotations and capacity planning for a team of 15 or more billable professionals.
* Strong reporting skills: able to build metrics, dashboards and leadership packs from raw data in spreadsheets and business systems.
* Experience running a leadership operating rhythm: agendas, pre-reads, action logs and follow-through.
* Working understanding of cybersecurity and incident response, enough to speak the language of responders and judge urgency, without needing to be a practitioner.
* Comfortable working across many functions at once, and able to say no, escalate, and hold people to deadlines, including senior stakeholders.
* Hands-on with modern work tools (Jira, Confluence, a CRM such as HubSpot, an HRIS such as BambooHR, Google Workspace), and keen to automate repetitive work with AI.
* Precise, organised communicator in written and spoken English.
* Calm under pressure, with the discretion to handle confidential client and incident information.
  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Experience in a 24/7 or on-call operations environment (incident response, SOC, emergency services, military operations or similar) at company-level size leadership levels (100+ personnel).
* Exposure to cyber insurance claims workflows, MSP channels, or subscription service delivery.
* Experience managing subcontractors or vendor rosters, including rates, POs and timesheets.
* Certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, ITIL, or Lean Six Sigma.
* Mandarin, Japanese, Cantonese, Tagalog or Malay, in addition to English.
  

**What success looks like**

**First 90 days**

  

* One engagement tracker covering every IR-1, ODIR, insurance and IRR engagement, owned by you and trusted by Response leadership.
* Weekly Response Operations and Directors' meeting packs issued on time, every week, with a live action log.
* Triage rotation, leave plan and overtime records published and current.
* Training plan and certification register in place for every responder.

**First 12 months**

  

* 100% of performance reviews in Response completed on time and catalogued with People & Culture.
* Every responder on track against their Immersive and SANS pathway, with exceptions flagged early.
* Timesheet compliance and billable hours data that Finance can invoice from without rework.
* Response leadership spending measurably less time on scheduling, admin and internal coordination.
* Documented Response operating procedures in Confluence, and at least two administrative workflows automated.
  

**What we offer**

* 40 days paid leave per year inclusive of public holidays, which may be taken at the discretion of the employee subject to compliance with our Leave Policy and the approval of their manager.
* Limited Work From Anywhere policy allotment, allowing for work from alternate locations contingent upon coverage provided by teammates and approved by manager for 5 days per quarter.
* Enrolment in the company's comprehensive corporate health plan that includes a large direct billing network for medical and dental coverage.
* Opportunities for inter-office travel, including a required annual week-long Tribe Onsite meet-up.
* $5,000 USD/year professional training budget, contingent on approval from manager, with a 12-month retention requirement.
* Competitive base salary with performance-based variable compensation, plus equity participation in Blackpanda's growth.
  

**Declamation**

Candidates who successfully pass the Interview stage may be required to complete a Case Study, used to evaluate their knowledge and application of their skills in practical scenarios relevant to the role.

Blackpanda is committed to building a culturally diverse company, and we value a broad set of opinions in our team. As we grow, we are looking to build a team with a range of viewpoints at its core, and we encourage applications from minority candidates and all genders however you identify (X/F/M).

Blackpanda does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies. We will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited candidates submitted by recruiters with whom we have not established explicit, written agreements for our job vacancies. By submitting any candidate information, recruiters agree to forfeit any claim to fees should their candidate be hired without an established agreement with Blackpanda.

title: Head of Commercial Operations, APAC
description:
Purpose
  
  
This is a senior leadership role with accountability for the performance and transformation of Commercial Operations across 10 APAC markets. The role spans two equally important mandates: running a high-performing, cost-efficient operations function today and leading the multi-year programme to modernise it. The right candidate will be as comfortable in a quarterly performance review as they are shaping a three-year automation roadmap and credible with underwriters, technology teams, and senior regional leadership alike.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Operational Leadership
  
  
Own end-to-end Commercial Ops performance across APAC — issuance, bookings, submissions, indexing, renewals, and endorsements.
  
  
Drive productivity, quality, and cost-to-serve targets.
  
  
Lead and develop a distributed team of operations managers and senior specialists, including in CBS hub teams in Philippines and KL.
  
  
Partner closely with P&C and A&H underwriting leaders to ensure operational delivery aligns with underwriting appetite and service expectations.
  
  
Maintain clear performance frameworks that give senior stakeholders timely and accurate visibility of ops health — reporting cadences, KPIs, escalation paths
  
  
Manage operational risk proactively, including process controls, audit readiness, and regulatory compliance across markets.
  
  
Transformation & Change
  
  
Lead the Commercial Ops transformation programme including automation initiatives, workflow platforms, and legacy system migration from business case through to benefits realisation.
  
  
Define and own the multi-year FTE and cost reduction roadmap, ensuring initiative sequencing is realistic and savings are trackable.
  
  
Act as the primary commercial operations voice in enterprise transformation programmes.
  
  
Build the case for investment where required; prepare and present business cases to regional and global stakeholders.
  
  
Drive adoption of new tools and processes across markets, managing the people and change dimension in step with the technical delivery owners.
  
  
Establish baseline measurement and benefits tracking frameworks so transformation impact can be reported with confidence.
  
  
Stakeholder Engagement
  
  
Build trusted relationships with underwriting, finance, technology, and HR leaders across APAC markets.
  
  
Influence without authority — navigate complex, matrixed stakeholder environments to drive alignment and move programmes forward.
  
  
Represent Commercial Ops in regional leadership forums; provide clear, evidence-based reporting to the Head of Operations & Transformation, APAC.
  
  
Engage with country-level operations teams and market heads to embed regional strategy within local delivery.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
Essential
  
  
Substantial experience in P&C commercial insurance operations; direct underwriting operations or underwriting leadership experience is required; candidates without this background will not be considered.
  
  
Demonstrated track record leading operational teams across multiple APAC markets, ideally including hub or shared services environments.
  
  
Experience owning and delivering transformation programmes (not just participating in them) with measurable outcomes in efficiency or FTE reduction.
  
  
Strong commercial acumen; able to build, defend, and track business cases for investment.
  
  
Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders across underwriting, finance, and technology in a matrixed organisation.
  
  
Excellent communication skills; equally effective in an exec briefing as in a working-level problem-solving session.
  
  
Highly Regarded
  
  
Familiarity with automation and AI tools in an insurance operations context — workflow platforms, intelligent document processing, and unstructured data ingestion.
  
  
Experience working with centralised processing hub models in APAC.
  
  
Exposure to commercial insurance systems such as Duck Creek, Quadient or equivalent policy administration platforms.
  
  
Formal programme or change management credentials (e.g. PMP, MSP, Prosci) are a plus, though not required.
  
  
At Chubb, we invest in our most important resource; Our People. We like to challenge ourselves to be the best in our business.
  
  
We are the world’s largest publicly traded property and casualty insurer with operations in 54 countries. We’re distinguished by our extensive product and service offerings, broad distribution capabilities, exceptional financial strength, underwriting excellence, superior claims handling expertise and local operations globally.
  
  
The Chubb name carries our promise of superior service, underwriting and execution. Our unique combination of people, products and places positions us to meet the needs of clients no matter where they are in the world.
  
  
We have an exciting opportunity and are looking for someone who can match our passion and commitment to our customers and partners.

While Singapore will be the primary market, the role will also develop cross-trade opportunities and collaborate with SF's ocean freight teams across Southeast Asia and the wider international network.
  
  
The initial priority will be to establish a sustainable and scalable ocean freight business platform, with a clear roadmap towards commercial growth and profitability.
  
  
Key Requirements
  
  
Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in international freight forwarding or integrated logistics, with substantial ocean freight commercial and management experience.
  
  
Proven experience in establishing, launching or significantly expanding an ocean freight business, business unit, branch or new market.
  
  
Strong end-to-end understanding of ocean freight business operations, including FCL/LCL products, carrier procurement, pricing, business development, operations and financial management.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to develop business strategies, build commercial and operational capabilities, establish industry partnerships and recruit high-performing teams.
  
  
Strong knowledge of the Singapore ocean freight market and regional trade lanes, with established industry relationships.
  
  
Entrepreneurial, commercially driven and hands-on, with the ability to operate effectively in a business-building environment.
  
  
Strong professional proficiency in both English and Mandarin Chinese, written and spoken, is mandatory for communication with local and international customers, business partners and SF's China headquarters.

Build carrier, co-loader, overseas agent and service-provider partnerships.
  
  
Design the appropriate operating model, SOPs, pricing framework and service delivery processes.
  
  
Propose and progressively build the ocean freight team in line with approved business plans.
  
  
Establish initial customer development channels and commercial capabilities.
  
  
Define key business performance indicators and build the foundation for sustainable revenue growth and profitability.

title: AVP, Scam & Fraud Resolution Specialist (Team Manager), Group CSH
description:
**Role Overview**

* Lead a team of Scam & Fraud Resolution Specialists with full accountability for people leadership, service delivery, operational discipline and customer outcomes across complex scam and fraud cases.
* Operate as a frontline leader who sets high standards, makes sound decisions under pressure and ensures the team delivers consistently against performance, service, regulatory and risk expectations.
Provide leadership for difficult and sensitive customer situations, including tough conversations and escalations, while driving practical solutions and partnering stakeholders to improve the end-to-end scam and fraud journey.  

**Key Accountabilities & Responsibilities**

**1. Leadership, People & Performance**

* Translate PCU priorities into measurable team and individual outcomes, with clear ownership, accountability and operating discipline.
* Lead, coach and develop the team to deliver strong customer service, quality and productivity; manage performance and succession consistently and fairly.
* Build a resilient, collaborative culture that learns from feedback, supports employee wellbeing and maintains composure in demanding situations.

**2. Operational Leadership, Governance & Risk**

* Own team KPIs and service levels, including scam transfer rate, dispute turnaround time, quality, productivity and customer outcomes; identify gaps early and drive recovery actions.
* Manage workforce deployment, shift coverage and operational readiness, including weekends and non-standard hours where required.
* Oversee complex, high-risk and sensitive cases within delegated authority, ensuring accurate handling, timely escalation and clear ownership through resolution.
* Maintain regulatory, compliance, confidentiality and operational-risk discipline, ensuring controls are applied consistently and gaps are addressed promptly.
* Use management information, customer insights and root-cause analysis to improve processes, controls and customer journeys.

**3. Customer & Stakeholder Leadership**

* Champion empathetic servicing and fair, consistent outcomes for scam and fraud victims, including vulnerable customers, ensuring they are supported with sensitivity throughout the resolution journey.
* Lead difficult customer conversations and escalated cases with composure, balancing customer needs, policy, risk considerations and the Bank’s decision framework.
* Partner Operations, Fraud, Disputes, Risk, Compliance and other business units to resolve systemic issues and deliver sustainable improvements.
Represent the team in governance forums, projects and stakeholder discussions, providing clear updates on performance, risks, decisions and follow-through.  

**Working Relationship**

* Directly reporting to Head of Scam & Fraud Relations.
* Directly leads and remains accountable for the performance, development, conduct and wellbeing of PCU – Scam & Fraud Resolution Specialists.

description:

Account Executive

Times Higher Education is the data provider underpinning university excellence in every continent across the world. The Account Executive role supports higher education customers by ensuring smooth delivery and fulfilment of services for lower-spending accounts, resolving issues, coordinating requirements and helping them achieve value from the service.
  
  
Working closely with Business Development and Account Management, the role looks after a pooled portfolio of lower-spending customers and focuses on onboarding, retention and service delivery through operational excellence, while commercial growth and strategic account ownership remain with Account Management.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Onboarding & Service Delivery
  
  

* Support customer onboarding and the successful delivery and fulfilment of services, ensuring a smooth transition from Business Development.
* Proactively manage customer queries, issues and service requests, resolving them within agreed service levels.

Customer Success & Retention
  
  

* Support customers in maximising the value of THE's services through ongoing guidance and support.
* Monitor customer satisfaction and identify risks that may affect retention or service delivery, escalating to the regional unit and the Head of Retention as needed.
* Manage renewals for pooled accounts, including communicating annual price adjustments in line with THE's pricing policy.
* Track product usage across the pool and run proactive outreach to low-usage customers before renewal.

Account Orchestration
  
  

* Own the day-to-day client relationship for pooled accounts and coordinate delivery across THE.
* Services (Events, Branding): own client comms, including project updates, while the delivery unit runs project planning, events and campaign execution.
* Solutions (Hiring, Content): request back-end set-up from the Manila fulfilment team and use its usage reports to track adoption.
* Receive closed deals from Business Development with a strong brief, and introduce the delivery lead to the client within 3 days of close.
* Hand accounts that grow into multiple workstreams or take up a data subscription to Account Management.

Collaboration & Records
  
  

* Work closely with Sales, Account Management, Finance and Product to ensure customer requirements are understood and delivered effectively.
* Maintain accurate customer records and activity within Salesforce and internal systems.
* Identify and communicate customer needs, feedback, risks and opportunities to relevant internal stakeholders, referring expansion opportunities to Account Managers.

Skills & Experience
  
  

* Experience in sales, customer success, account support, client services or onboarding, ideally in a SaaS, data or subscription business.
* Comfortable managing a high volume of customer accounts and prioritising effectively.
* Exposure to the higher education sector is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of Salesforce or a similar CRM.
* Clear, friendly written and verbal communication; able to explain products simply to non-specialists.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Commercial awareness: recognises expansion signals and knows when to bring in Account Management.
* Additional languages are an advantage for international portfolios.

You do You
  
  
You do You. With colleagues located around the world, we know that our individuality and diversity of experiences are our greatest strengths. That’s why we want THE to be a place where you are welcome to be who you want to be at work; where you can share whatever part of your life or self-identity you want, without obligation or facing discrimination; and where all abilities and perspectives are recognised and accommodated.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a highly motivated and resilient leader to manage the critical operations of our domestic digital payment channels. In this fast-paced, high-impact role, you will be responsible for ensuring the seamless, 24/7 operation of vital payment ecosystems—including FAST/PayNow, GIRO, EFTPOS/NETS, and PayLah!—and driving continuous improvement to maintain DBS's operational excellence.

  

**The Commitment**

This role requires a high level of dedication to ensure the stability and reliability of our payment services. Candidates must be prepared to manage high-pressure situations, provide oversight for critical incidents, and be available to resolve operational escalations outside of standard working hours to ensure uninterrupted service for our customers.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Operational Leadership:** Direct and mentor high-performing teams overseeing daily operations, settlements, and support for FAST/PayNow, GIRO, EFTPOS (including NETS Scan & Pay), Bill Payment refunds, Fund Transfers, and PayLah!.
* **Incident & Resilience Management:** Lead the response to system issues and operational disruptions. Proactively identify and mitigate risks to ensure system resilience, addressing control gaps with urgency.
* **Performance & Efficiency:** Drive process automation and improvement initiatives to enhance productivity, reduce operational costs, and optimize transaction processing.
* **SLA & Stakeholder Management:** Ensure strict adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Collaborate across cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration and consistent service delivery.
* **Strategy & Documentation:** Maintain rigorous, up-to-date documentation for all processes and contribute to strategic initiatives aimed at elevating the customer experience.

  

**Required Skills & Experience**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Banking, Finance, Business, Operations Management, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

* **Payments Operations Experience:** Substantial experience in banking operations, including direct responsibility for high-volume domestic payment services such as FAST/PayNow, GIRO, EFTPOS/NETS, bill payments, fund transfers, or mobile-wallet operations.

* **People Leadership:** Proven experience leading operations teams, including setting priorities, managing performance, developing talent, and maintaining effective coverage for business-critical services.

* **Incident & Service Management:** Demonstrated ability to lead major incident response, coordinate timely escalation and recovery, conduct root-cause analysis, and implement sustainable remediation in a time-sensitive environment.

* **Risk & Controls:** Strong working knowledge of operational risk, internal controls, reconciliation, settlement, audit readiness, business continuity, and regulatory expectations relevant to payment operations.

* **Operational Performance:** Experience managing SLAs, service availability, transaction exceptions, operational capacity, and performance indicators, with a track record of improving reliability, productivity, and customer outcomes.

* **Change & Continuous Improvement:** Proven ability to deliver process improvement, automation, or transformation initiatives while maintaining operational stability and appropriate governance.

* **Stakeholder Management:** Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to work effectively with technology, product, risk, compliance, finance, vendors, and senior management.

* **Availability:** Willingness and ability to provide leadership oversight for critical incidents and operational escalations outside standard working hours when required.

  

**Desired Skills & Experience**

* Experience managing sizeable or multi-disciplinary teams across operations, service management, or payment support functions.

* In-depth knowledge of Singapore’s domestic payment ecosystem, including clearing and settlement flows, scheme rules, and industry developments.

* Experience partnering with technology teams on system enhancements, production change, platform migration, or resilience improvements.

* Working knowledge of data analytics, workflow tools, or automation technologies used to monitor and improve operational performance.

title: Project Procurement Manager, Process Excellence
description:
Bring more to life.
  
  
Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?
  
  
At Leica Microsystems, one of
  
  
Danaher’s
  
  
15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.
  
  
You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.
  
  
Shape the Future with Us!
  
  
At Leica Microsystems, we have been shaping the future for over 175 years with groundbreaking optical and digital solutions. With a culture rooted in customer focus, innovation, and teamwork, we lead the market in microscopy, imaging, and analysis, unveiling the invisible and empowering our customers to build a better, healthier world.
  
  
Joining Leica Microsystems means contributing to scientific discoveries and supporting surgeons in making critical decisions. Our advanced microscopes and AI-based image analysis solutions enable users to gain profound insights into development and engineering challenges. Here, you will work on meaningful projects alongside passionate colleagues, driving progress and pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.
  
  
Learn about the
  
  
Danaher Business System
  
  
which makes everything possible.
  
  
The
  
  
Project Procurement Manager, Process Excellence
  
  
is a hybrid individual-contributor role combining New Product Introduction (NPI) and strategic project procurement with procurement process excellence and compliance. The role ensures that sourcing requirements are integrated early into product development while strengthening standardized, scalable, and compliant ways of working across Global Sourcing.
  
  
Acting as a cross-functional interface across R&D, Project Management, Operations, Quality, Commodity Management, Finance, Legal, IT, Audit, and DBS, the role combines hands-on project procurement execution with global process ownership and continuous improvement.
  
  
This position reports to the
  
  
Global Head of Project Procurement & Process Excellence
  
  
and is part of Global Sourcing organisation, located in Singapore and will be an
  
  
on-site role
  
  
.
  
  
**In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**  
Lead project procurement and sourcing readiness for assigned NPI and other strategic projects from early development through industrialization and handover, including procurement scope, sourcing plans, milestones, resource needs, budgets, supplier selection, qualification and readiness, prototype and pre-series sourcing, material availability, project risks and recovery actions.
  
  
Drive early supplier involvement, cost optimization and commercial activities by partnering with R&D, Quality, Industrial Engineering, Commodity Management and other stakeholders on design reviews, Design-to-Cost, standardization, modularization and make-or-buy assessments; analyzing cost drivers and Total Cost of Ownership; and negotiating project-related commercial terms and development agreements in alignment with applicable approval processes.
  
  
Design, implement and continuously improve procurement processes across Global Sourcing, including end-to-end processes, procedures, templates, roles and controls; drive standardization and harmonization across regions, sites and teams; maintain assigned procurement playbook content; and support process ownership, governance, version control and training.
  
  
Advance procurement process excellence, performance and digitalization by applying DBS and structured problem-solving methods to identify root causes, eliminate waste and reduce manual effort; identify automation and digitalization opportunities; translate business needs into requirements for procurement systems and tools; and define and track process KPIs, adoption metrics and improvement actions.
  
  
Strengthen procurement compliance, governance and risk management by maintaining procurement-specific governance frameworks, procedures, controls and evidence requirements; performing process compliance reviews and risk assessments; coordinating corrective and preventive actions; supporting supplier due diligence, onboarding and third-party risk management; and representing Global Sourcing in relevant internal and external audits.
  
  
**The essential requirements of the job include:**  
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
  
  
Minimum 7 years of relevant experience in project procurement, sourcing, supply chain, procurement process management, compliance, or operational excellence within a manufacturing environment.
  
  
Demonstrated experience supporting NPI or product-development projects, including supplier selection, prototype sourcing, industrialization readiness, cost management, and project risk mitigation.
  
  
Proven experience in procurement process improvement, including process mapping, standardization, continuous improvement, governance, and implementation of sustainable changes.
  
  
Experience in commercial and contract negotiations and working knowledge of procurement systems and digital tools such as SAP, e-procurement platforms, Microsoft Office, Power BI, workflow tools, and process-mapping applications.
  
  
**Travel Requirements:**  
Willingness to travel internationally, estimated up to 20%.
  
  
**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**
  
  
·
  
  
Project management or continuous-improvement certification, such as PMP, Lean, or Six Sigma.
  
  
High-mix, low-volume, medical device, life science, or precision-instrument environments.
  
  
Process-management or audit/compliance training.
  
  
Leica Microsystems, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at
  
  
Danaher Benefits Info
  
  
.
  
  
For over 170 years, Leica Microsystems has helped shape the future by developing groundbreaking optical and digital solutions. As a global leader, we’re driven by continuous improvement to excite our customers and to create the best work environment for our people. Customer focus, innovation, and teamwork are at the core of our culture and the foundation of our success.
  
  
Want to be part of a company whose products are part of cutting-edge research around the world? Join Leica Microsystems in our commitment for brilliant solutions and insight.

title: Receptionist
description:
CBRE is the global leader in commercial real estate services and investments. With services, insights and data that span every dimension of the industry, we create solutions for clients of every size, in every sector and across every geography. CBRE is the place where talented people who want to do impactful work can realize potential in every dimension.

**CBRE Global Workplace Solutions (GWS)**

As one of CBRE's core global businesses, Global Workplace Solutions (GWS) provides end-to-end services to occupier clients across the entire lifecycle of a building.

Our teams help companies improve their operations and reduce costs, through expert facilities management, project management, real estate and energy and sustainability services. Our dedicated teams work across all industries, and support clients ranging from the Fortune 500 global companies to single, iconic buildings.

**About the Role:**

The Receptionist shapes the experience everyone has from the moment they walk through the door. You're the first person most people see when they walk through the door — that greeting, that eye contact, that sense someone is glad they arrived, sets the tone for everything that follows. On a well-run site, it's never an accident. You own the lobby, the visitor process, the conference room calendar, and the daily logistics of a busy front desk. You will be successful in this role when you make every visitor and employee feel expected and well taken care of, and run the front desk reliably enough that no one has to think about it.

**What You'll Do: Front Desk & Visitors**

* Greet clients, applicants, and visitors, issue visitor and parking passes, and apply security protocols so every guest feels expected.
* Receive and direct incoming calls to the appropriate personnel or voicemail so callers reach the right person.

**Meetings & Hospitality**

* Schedule and prepare meeting and conference rooms, including room setup, catering orders, and equipment, so meetings start on time.
* Request building and housekeeping services to maintain the condition of shared spaces.
* Arrange hospitality services for guests, including transportation, tickets, and reservations.

**Mail & Office Coordination**

* Track incoming and outgoing packages, mail, and freight, and arrange messenger service.
* Handle general clerical duties, distribute faxes and packages, and order office supplies so employees have what they need.

**What You Need:**

* Experience in customer service, hospitality, or an office environment
* Strong verbal communication skills and a professional phone manner
* Comfortable with standard workplace and collaboration tools (email, documents, spreadsheets, and scheduling)
* Ability to follow established procedures reliably and consistently
* Strong preference for experience in a corporate, hotel, or premium-service environment, familiarity with visitor-management systems, and coordinating conference rooms or catering

**This Role Is a Good Fit If You:**

* Get energy from imparting kindness, help, and recommendations to others. The more people you interact with in a day, the better you feel when you head home.
* Are known for noticing a guest, friend, or family members needs something before they ask. People constantly tell you "I can't believe you read my mind on that."
* Stay warm and even-keeled under pressure: whether it's the morning rush, an early VIP, or a caller who's already frustrated, and people notice you never seem rattled.
* Look forward to being at the desk before anyone else arrives, so you're the one setting the tone from the first hello.
* Are a stickler for details. You feel at your best when every visitor's information is logged, every conference room reservation is made, every I dotted and T crossed.

**Why CBRE**

When you join CBRE, you become part of the global leader in commercial real estate services and investment that helps businesses and people thrive. We are dynamic problem solvers and forward-thinking professionals who create significant impact. Our collaborative culture is built on our shared values — respect, integrity, service and excellence — and we value the diverse perspectives, backgrounds and skillsets of our people. At CBRE, you have the opportunity to chart your own course and realize your potential. We welcome all applicants.

Applicant AI Use Disclosure

We value human interaction to understand each candidate's unique experience, skills and aspirations. We do not use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to make hiring decisions, and we ask that candidates disclose any use of AI in the application and interview process.

If the above interests you, we would love to hear from you!
