title: Head of Commercial Excellence - Surgical APAC
description:
At Alcon, we are driven by the meaningful work we do to help people see brilliantly. We innovate boldly, champion progress, and act with speed as the global leader in eye care. Here, you’ll be recognized for your commitment and contributions and see your career like never before. Together, we go above and beyond to make an impact in the lives of our patients and customers. We foster an inclusive culture and are looking for diverse, talented people to join Alcon.

Main Responsibilities:

  

Lead the region Commercial Excellence function& team. Business partner to Region Franchise Heads & Region Commercial Operations team in providing insights and recommendations on commercial execution to increase sales performance and productivity. Owns CommEx processes and projects in region through effective leadership of cluster/country CommEx team. Be responsible for people development and ensures career development and coaching of the team as top priorities.

In this role, a typical day will include:

* Lead the CommEx team to business partner for Surgical APAC.
* Plays a role of proactive business partner to the Region Franchise (RVPs and CommOps) for Commercial execution and using data, analytics & insights is able to provide recommendation to improve sales execution within the region
* Partners with region franchise leadership to proactively provide insights and recommendations on areas of commercial execution, such as Go-To-Market model and field force productivity; constructively challenge & provide recommendations to the franchise to optimize SF structure, as deemed necessary
* Responsible for maintaining oversight of all critical execution KPIs to drive execution in line with the defined International framework & is able to explain deviations and influence actions & recommendation for improvement
* Represents region CommEx in QBRs, commercial reviews, sales meetings and leadership meetings
* Understand region Franchise priorities and implement CommEx solutions to region business needs/problems in line with business priorities and CommEx function strategy
* Leads change management and adoption of new CommEx tools/technologies through trainings & change management initiatives within the region
* Leads, engages, manages and motivates region CommEx team aligned with Alcon culture & drives a culture change towards the new CommEx mission and vision – shift of focus from tools and systems to Business Partnering
* Owns Region CommEx team development plan and half-yearly AED including action taking on identified areas
* Owns execution & delivery of all core CommEx processes at region within International timelines, including but not limited to:
  + Account Profiling and segmentation
  + Territory design
  + Quota-To-Payout
  + Region Sales Incentive Plan and President’s Club
* Partners closely with the International Solution Delivery Team & International Franchise CommEx Heads to drive standardization to international framework including simplification/optimization of CommEx tools/processes
* Filters and prioritizes enhancement requests related to CommEx platforms at region according to agreed prioritization framework & business imperatives
* Owns execution of all CommEx projects within the region including international/regional franchise projects
* Manges the Region CommEx team expenses within the allotted budget
* Influences and collaborates with international CommEx franchise heads, regional CommEx Head, region franchise and commercial heads and region functional leaders for daily operations
* Responsible for providing Region feedback, improvement opportunities, potential solutions and actions undertaken to regional/international on CommEx processes/projects/tools/commercial execution
* Partners cross functionally to execute international campaigns and projects as per DRCIs
* Responsible for in region communications in relation to CommEx functions
* Field visits and market visits to address key execution issues as and when needed

Lead activation of AI capability with Commercial execution, co-creating solutions, rewiring workflows and driving the adoption, change and value realization required to make AI part of how Commercial works. Includes but not limited to:

* AI Adoption & Activation in Commercial Execution - ensuring AI moves beyond availability to become part of day-to-day execution.
* Translate AI insights and capabilities into practical actions for Sales, Marketing, FLMs and other sales roles
* Change Management – lead people and organization change within the region on AI in Commercial Execution
* Rewiring Commercial Workflows – partner with country teams to redesign priority workflow to embed AI Insights within them. Relook and include within regional review processes
* Value Realization – monitor and track value realization into P&L and perform in-depth analysis to form learning on insights & action and ensure feedback loop back to International
* Co-creation of AI Solution – represent region in creation of AI solution for higher impact & faster adoption

**WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO ALCON:**

  

Mandatory: Prior experience of 2+ years in a regional role in any function in a multi-country region with multiple Focus markets is a mandatory criteria.

  

Bachelor(Masters Preferred) Science, business, finance, economics, engineering or other related quantitative field

Duration & seniority - 12+ years of overall professional experience with strong medical devices (most preferred) or Pharma industry experience. An experience in commercial excellence function is a plus, but not necessary

P&L ownership or Commercial leadership - 3+ years of experience of owning or managing business P&L and/or leading a team within commercial role in marketing or sales. Understanding of Surgical Business at Region level is a must.

Senior stakeholder management - 3+ years of experience as part of country management team, with at least 2 completed years in last role; experience of interacting with and managing senior stakeholders like Region heads, Region LT members & above Region leaders is a plus.

Region processes & project management - 2+ years of experience in managing systems and running cross country processes & projects within a Function setup, adhering to milestone timelines within big processes.

The ability to fluently read, write, understand and communicate in English

  
  

**HOW YOU CAN THRIVE AT ALCON:**

* Manage your own workload and schedule while hitting your set targets
* Collaborate with teammates to share best practices and learnings as work evolves
* See your career like never before with focused growth and development opportunities

title: Accounts Payable and Admin Officer
description:
Job Description & Requirements
  
  
We are looking for reliable Accounts Payable Officer who is responsible for managing the company’s payable functions, ensuring that all supplier invoices are accurately recorded, approved, and paid on time. This role supports financial accuracy, maintains strong vendor relationships, and ensures compliance with company policies and accounting standards. The ideal candidate is competent in prioritizing work and can work with little to no supervision. S/he is self-motivated and trustworthy.
  
  
Key Roles & Responsibilities
  
  
Accounts Duties (Accounts Payable)
  
  
Receive, sort, process and verify supplier invoices, and payment requests accurately and promptly
  
  
Ensure all invoices are properly authorized in accordance with company procedures before posting.
  
  
Prepare payment schedule and execute payment runs in accordance with agreed payment terms.
  
  
Reconcile supplier statements against company’s books and resolve invoice discrepancies or queries
  
  
Maintain accurate and up-to-date accounts payable records, maintain proper filing and documentation of supplier invoices and payment records.
  
  
Assist with month-end closing activities, including GST reconciliations
  
  
Liaise with internal departments and external vendors on payment-related matters
  
  
Assist with process improvements to enhance AP efficiency and accuracy
  
  
Administrative Duties (when the Admin Assistant is on leave)
  
  
Answer and redirect telephone calls
  
  
Check and maintain company admin email
  
  
Manage all incoming and outgoing mails/couriers
  
  
Coordinate with the bank/agent for collection and withdrawal of money (Cash to Master funds “CTM”).
  
  
Documents filling in relation to cash collection and withdrawal of CTM
  
  
Other adhoc activities
  
  
Requirements & Qualifications
  
  
Basic knowledge of accounting principles and accounts payable processes
  
  
Strong attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  
  
Good organizational and time-management skills
  
  
Ability to meet deadlines and work under pressure
  
  
Problem-solving skills and ability to resolve discrepancies independently
  
  
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other MSOffice applications
  
  
Strong sense of confidentiality and professional integrity
  
  
SINGAPORE SHIPPING ENTERPRISES PTE. LTD.
  
  
Singapore Shipping Enterprises Pte. Ltd.
  
  
was formed in 1991 to provide reliable and professional ship services to all types of ships in Singapore and throughout Asia. Our head office based in Singapore at crossroads between Europe and the rest of Asia, offers highly efficient services to owners’ vessels and their business in the Far East region.
  
  
We provide reliable services as agents and/or representatives of shipowners for their business and ships in Singapore as well as other important shipping hubs. Our port agency in Singapore has been serving all types of vessels and handling port operations since 1991. Our experience, well established networks and our around the clock care ensure that we are able to deliver high level services to our clients and build mutually beneficial relationships.
  
  
Our personnel’s in-depth knowledge of local operational conditions, regulations and policies enable us to understand and meet the requirements of our clients, and strive to exceed their expectations. Our dedicated staff of highly trained professionals consists of operation executives available 24/7 with a wide network of contacts, and an accounts team working closely together to ensure our customers’ needs are always met without any reservations.

title: Head of Talent Acquisition, APAC
description:
**Description**

Meltwater is seeking a strategic and hands-on Head of Talent Acquisition, APAC to lead talent acquisition across the Asia-Pacific region. This leader will partner closely with regional business and People leaders to build strong talent strategies, improve hiring quality and speed, strengthen recruiting capability, and ensure a consistent, inclusive candidate experience across APAC markets.

The successful candidate will balance strategic leadership with practical execution. They will use data, market insight, technology, and strong stakeholder partnerships to help Meltwater attract, assess, and hire exceptional talent while building a high-performing regional Talent Acquisition function.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own APAC Talent Acquisition strategy including end-to-end sourcing and recruiting across all functions, with a heavy emphasis on GTM hiring with the ability to support broader regional workforce priorities
* Partner with APAC leadership, people leaders and hiring managers to understand workforce plans, define critical hiring priorities and create practical recruiting strategies
* Lead, coach, and develop the APAC Talent Acquisition team clarifying goals, strengthening capability, and creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Establish consistent, high-quality recruiting practices while adapting appropriately to local market requirements and candidate expectations
* Improve hiring outcomes through structured intake, calibrated assessment, effective interview practices, and clear decision-making and ownership across the hiring process
* Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and provide market insight, talent data, and recommendations that support sound workforce decisions
* Strengthen sourcing strategies, employer brand, talent pipelines, and regional market presence across the APAC markets
* Partner with People, Legal, HRIS, Total Rewards, and other teams to support compliant and effective hiring practices.
* Use recruiting data and technology to identify trends, improve processes, and increase efficiency and strengthen the candidate and hiring manager experience
* Support Meltwater’s evolving approach to AI in Talent Acquisition, including responsible adoption and safeguards against fraudulent or misrepresented candidate activity.
* Promote inclusive hiring practices and ensure recruitment decisions are fair, consistent and grounded in job-related evidence
* Contribute to global Talent Acquisition programs and represent APAC perspectives in global initiatives.

**How You’ll Work with AI**

At Meltwater, we believe AI fluency, curiosity, and responsible experimentation are increasingly important to how we work and create value for our customers. In this role, you will be encouraged to understand how AI can improve your work, enhance decision-making, increase efficiency, and help us build better experiences and solutions. You do not need to be an AI expert, but you should be curious, open to learning, and thoughtful about using AI responsibly.

As a Talent Acquisition leader, you will help the team build practical AI fluency, identify meaningful opportunities to use AI-enabled tools, and establish safeguards that protect candidate fairness, privacy, authenticity, and human judgment. This includes supporting responsible adoption of AI in sourcing, market analysis, recruiting operations, interview preparation, and reporting, while helping the organization detect and address fraudulent or misrepresented candidate activity. AI should support, not replace, human accountability, candidate relationships, collaboration, and hiring decisions

**What You’ll Bring**

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience leading Talent Acquisition across multiple APAC markets, especially India, China, Australia and Japan
* Strong understanding of APAC talent markets, employment laws, and market considerations.
* Proven experience leading, coaching and developing recruiters across a range of experience levels
* Strong business partnership skills with the ability to influence senior leaders and hiring managers and translate business priorities into hiring strategies
* Experience building, improving and glocalizing regional recruiting strategies, operating models and processes.

title: Cluster Network Head – SEA ANZ
description:
#### **About this Position**

The Cluster Network Head of SEA AND is responsible for end-to-end quality management across Henkel’s Seven manufacturing sites in South-East Asia and Australia / New Zealand. This role is to drive and implement a consistent Network quality strategy to enhance customer satisfaction and support achieving financial targets.

**Some of the key objectives include:**

* Compliance with Henkel’s global quality standards
* Fostering a Zero-Defect culture and customer intimacy
* Driving digital transformation to simplify, standardize and efficiency
* Developing people/ competencies / critical talent pipeline and delivering key initiatives aligned with AOQ's PDIs and performance KPI’s

#### **What you'll do**

**Quality Cluster Leadership**

* Lead a team of quality professionals in the sites, develop team members.
* Lead the day-to-day operation of quality processes for a group of manufacturing sites.
* Identify systemic issues across the Network and drive to resolution, escalate critical issues to Regional Quality Head
* Responsible for stopping the processing, shipment, or use of poor-quality products.
* Animate critical customer escalations for the plants in scope providing the customer and internal stakeholders with clarity and pace of problem resolutions with CAPA

**Quality System Deployment**

* Achieve 100% compliance with mandatory minimum CtQ standards by target deadlines.
* Conduct monthly MOC/ADP governance reviews at each site to ensure proactive quality risk control.

**Ensure full implementation and governance of Henkel’s five global quality fundamentals across all SEA and ANZ plants:**

* Statistical Quality Control (SQC)
* Management of Change (MOC)
* Critical to Quality (CtQ) Standards
* Problem Solving Tools (FRPS / A3 / Six Sigma)
* Process Failure Mode & Effects Analysis (PFMEA)

  

#### **What makes you a good fit**

* Master’s degree in engineering (Chemical / Electrical / Mechanical etc)
* 5+ years of Multi-site Quality Management experience in leadership role or a related technical discipline.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing quality management, preferably in chemical, automotive, aerospace or electronics industries.
* Proven track record of deploying global quality systems such as SQC, MOC, PFMEA, and problem-solving tools in multi-site environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional and cross-cultural teams in a matrix organization.
* Strong customer-facing skills, with experience managing quality expectations of tier-1 global clients.
* Understanding of Quality Standards and Requirements including ISO / VDA / IATF / PPAP etc…
* Certified in Six Sigma / Lean Management / Auditor Experience / Root Cause Analysis
* Excellent communication skills in English. Proficiency in one or more Southeast Asian languages may be beneficial where required for business interactions with customers, suppliers, or stakeholders in specific markets

#### **Some perks of joining Henkel**

* Flexible work scheme with flexible hours, hybrid work model, and work from anywhere policy for up to 30 days per year
* Diverse national and international growth opportunities
* Global wellbeing standards with health and preventive care programs
* Gender-neutral parental leave for a minimum of 8 weeks
* Employee Share Plan with voluntary investment and Henkel matching shares
* Outpatient Medical and Specialist Coverage for employees and eligible dependents
* Life, Hospital, Personal Accident Insurance Coverage
* Flexible Benefits covering Dental, Vaccination, Eye screenings etc for employees and eligible dep
* Access to company products at discounted price

At Henkel, we come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe the uniqueness of all our employees is the power in us. Become part of the team and bring your uniqueness to us! We welcome all applications across different genders, origins, cultures, religions, sexual orientations, disabilities, and generations.

You will play a key role in shaping how our employees learn, transform and engage with the organisation, and have a real influence on how our HR processes are reimagined for the future. title: Operations Trainer (Cleaning)
description:
About the Role
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Operations Trainer (Cleaning) to support the training and development of frontline employees and supervisors across Hong Ye Group sites.
  
  
The successful candidate will provide practical on-the-job training, coach supervisors and new hires, reinforce operational standards, and work closely with L&OD to ensure that training materials and SOPs remain relevant to actual site practices.
  
  
This is a predominantly field-based role suited to an experienced cleaning professional who is confident in demonstrating cleaning methods, guiding employees and supervisors, and providing practical coaching directly at the workplace.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
New-Hire OJT and Supervisor Coaching
  
  

* Provide structured on-the-job training for new hires, covering cleaning methods, work sequencing, equipment use, chemical handling, basic safety requirements and site-specific practices.
* Use a practical coaching method of explain, demonstrate, allow practice, observe, correct and recheck to confirm that employees can perform assigned tasks safely and correctly.
* Conduct follow-up coaching after initial OJT to identify gaps and reinforce areas where additional guidance is required.
* Complete the required OJT and coaching records provided by L&OD, and submit documentation to the Head of L&OD within the required timeline.
* Provide hands-on coaching to supervisors who require stronger operational knowledge or greater confidence in guiding frontline employees.
* Observe how supervisors conduct toolbox briefings, coach employees and manage cleaning practices, then provide practical feedback and guidance.
* Act as an experienced mentor and operational reference point for both junior and experienced frontline employees.

Training and SOP Development
  
  

* Work with L&OD to develop and refine practical training materials, SOPs, visual guides, checklists and OJT resources based on actual site requirements.
* Contribute technical and operational expertise so that training materials remain accurate, realistic and suitable for frontline use.
* Conduct or support internal practical training in cleaning methodology, machinery operation, chemical handling, carpet care, washroom cleaning and other relevant cleaning processes.
* Identify recurring knowledge and skill gaps across sites and recommend new, refresher or targeted training interventions.
* Highlight situations where documented procedures require greater clarity, practicality or site-specific adaptation.
* Provide feedback to L&OD on the effectiveness and usability of training resources after they have been applied on-site.
* Support internal training delivery only unless otherwise assigned. External training programmes and vendor coordination remain under the Head of L&OD.

Capability Building
  
  

* Conductscheduled capability visits across sites to observe operational practices andidentify areas requiring coaching or reinforcement.
* Check that required toolbox briefings are conducted and assess whether supervisors deliver them meaningfully, rather than treating them only as an attendance requirement.
* Provide immediate coaching and correction where gaps are observed, instead of limiting the visit to documenting non-compliance.
* Check that required toolbox briefings are conducted and assess whether supervisors deliver them meaningfully, rather than treating them only as an attendance requirement.
* Provide immediate coaching and correction where gaps are observed, instead of limiting the visit to documenting non-compliance.

* Strong practical knowledge of cleaning methods, machinery, equipment, chemicals and workplace practices.
* Proven experience in training, coaching or mentoring cleaners and supervisors.
* Able to demonstrate cleaning procedures and provide practical on-the-job guidance at operational sites.

* Relevant WSQ cleaning qualifications arepreferred but not mandatory.

**How You'll Make an Impact:**

* **Manage Complex Calendars:** Proactively manage busy calendars, coordinate meetings across multiple time zones, resolve scheduling conflicts and help prioritise competing demands.

* **Provide Broader EA Support:** Support other Managing Directors in the APAC leadership team, including arranging business travel, managing expense claims and providing other administrative support as needed.
* **Maintain Confidentiality:** Handle sensitive business and employee information with a high level of discretion and professional judgement.

**You May be a Good Fit if:**

* At least 5 years of relevant Executive Assistant experience supporting senior executives or multiple senior leaders.
* Proven experience managing complex calendars and international travel across different time zones.
* Excellent organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* A high level of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential information.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Outlook, PowerPoint, Excel and Teams.

**What Would Make You Stand Out:**

* Experience supporting senior leaders in a regional or international organisation, ideally across APAC.
* A proactive and resourceful approach to problem solving, with the confidence to work independently and exercise sound judgement.
* The ability to build effective working relationships with senior stakeholders across different countries and cultures.
* Experience using travel and expense management systems, and comfort using AI-enabled tools to work more efficiently.

**Why Choose Fitch:**

* **Hybrid Work Environment:** 3 days a week in office required based on your line of business and location
* **A Culture of Learning & Mobility:** Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
* **Investing in Your Future:** Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals
* **Promoting Health & Wellbeing:** Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing
* **Supportive Parenting Policies:** Family-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
* **Inclusive Work Environment** : A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe
* **Dedication to Giving Back:** Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community

At Fitch, AI is embedded in how we work every day-supporting smarter decision-making, streamlining workflows, and enabling new ways to create value for our business and clients. Intelligent solutions are increasingly part of our day-to-day operations, helping teams work more efficiently and think differently as we continue to evolve. We're looking for colleagues who are comfortable operating in an AI-enabled environment-or who are curious, adaptable, and eager to build their AI literacy over time. We value professionals who embrace technology as part of continuous learning and who are committed to using it thoughtfully to enhance how work gets done.
  
  
Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch's credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interest or any appearance of a conflict of interest. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work.

In Singapore, we follow the Tripartite Guidelines on Fair Employment Practices. title: CORPORATE SERVICES ASST MANAGER
description:

CBEC is a Singapore-based corporate secretarial and accountancy firm providing practical, compliance-focused services to local and overseas businesses. Our services include company incorporation, corporate secretarial support, accounting, tax filing coordination and regulatory compliance.
  
  
Job Summary
  
  
For this Corporate Secretarial & Compliance Assistant Manager position, we are seeking an individual who is currently registered with ACRA as a Registered Qualified Individual (RQI) and is willing and legally eligible to serve as a Nominee Director for approved client companies. The successful candidate will support corporate secretarial operations and statutory compliance while exercising independent judgment in all director appointments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Act as an RQI for our registered Corporate Service Provider (CSP), subject to applicable ACRA requirements and authorisations.
* Accept Nominee Director appointments for approved client companies following due diligence, suitability checks and proper appointment procedures.
* Discharge statutory director duties under the Singapore Companies Act, including independent judgment, appropriate oversight and ongoing attention to company affairs.
* Support and oversee ACRA Bizfile transactions, including incorporations, Annual Returns, officer changes and other corporate filings.
* Perform or support company secretarial duties for client companies where properly appointed and eligible.
* Maintain accurate statutory registers, corporate records and supporting documentation.
* Support KYC/CDD, AML/CFT screening, client risk assessments and escalation of compliance concerns.
* Coordinate with clients, internal documentation teams and management to resolve compliance matters and deliver timely services.
* Liaise with ACRA and other relevant authorities when required; perform other related duties consistent with statutory obligations.

Requirements
  
  

* Must currently be registered with ACRA as a Registered Qualified Individual (RQI); registration status will be verified.
* Must be willing and legally eligible to act as a Nominee Director and meet the local residency requirements applicable to Singapore company directors.
* Minimum education: Lower Secondary School or above. This is a company hiring criterion and does not replace ACRA’s RQI eligibility requirements.
* Good understanding of Singapore company law, ACRA requirements and corporate secretarial procedures.
* Familiarity with Bizfile and relevant corporate secretarial experience preferred; at least three years of experience is an advantage, not a mandatory condition.
* Reliable, organised, responsive and able to communicate clearly with management and clients.

Work Arrangement & Remuneration
  
  

* Office location: CT Hub 2, Kallang / Bendemeer area (approximately 5 minutes’ walk from Bendemeer MRT).
* Work schedule: Five business days per week, subject to the agreed employment or service arrangement.
* Monthly remuneration: SGD 4,000–6,000+ (depending on qualifications, experience and agreed responsibilities).
* Nominee Director fees, number and scope of appointments, and related terms to be agreed separately.
* Support from our corporate secretarial and documentation teams.

How to Apply
  
  
Please submit your resume stating your current ACRA RQI registration status, relevant corporate secretarial experience, current and expected remuneration, and earliest available start date. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
  
  
CBEC is a Singapore-based corporate secretarial and accountancy firm dedicated to providing cost-effective, compliance-focused solutions for businesses of all sizes. We specialize in company incorporation, corporate secretarial services, accounting, tax filing, and regulatory compliance, ensuring our clients meet all statutory requirements under ACRA (Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority) and IRAS (Inland Revenue Authority of Singapore).

title: Producer (Film & AVL)
description:
Producer (Film & AVL) - AVPD Studios
  
  
Singapore | Full-time | Hybrid (office-based, with on-site shoot and show days)
  
  
About Us
  
  
Adrenalin Group is an integrated communications company operating across three business units: AdrenalinX (Experiential Events), AVPD Studios (Production and Livestream), and Aether Lab (Innovation and Emerging Technology).
  
  
AVPD Studios is the group's production arm. We make branded content, corporate films and digital campaigns, and deliver technical live production (audio, video and lighting) and livestreams for clients across government, nonprofit and corporate sectors.
  
  
We're looking for a Producer from a film or video production background who wants to extend into live production. You'll lead film shoots from the start, and we'll train you to produce the technical side of live shows. Once a project is confirmed, you take it from there: the client, the crew and the budget, through to delivery.
  
  
This is a technical production role. It focuses on delivering film and AVL productions, not on event concept, programme design or guest management.
  
  
What You'll Own
  
  
You will own execution from project confirmation to final delivery, and take over client communication once a project is locked.
  
  
Film and video
  
  

* Produce music videos, commercials and corporate videos from confirmation through to delivery
* Lead shoots independently, mostly with lean crews of 4-6, and step up to co-productions with international agencies on commercials with full crews of 30-40, a couple of times a year
* Provide production support and co-production on projects that need additional capacity, and step in to stabilise productions that need it
* Work with directors and writers, and coordinate between the client and our in-house post-production team through review rounds and delivery
* Prepare full film quotations and specifications

Live production, audio, video and lighting (training provided)
  
  

* Learn to produce the technical side of conferences, festivals, events and livestreams, from site visit to bump-in, show and strike
* Be trained on site visits, permits and technical documentation, including single line diagrams (SLD), Professional Engineer (PE) endorsements, risk assessments (RA) and permits to work (PTW)
* Learn to spec crew and equipment, hire AV crew and manage production schedules from bump-in to strike
* Take on a growing share of live projects over time, which will become the larger part of your work

Commercial ownership across all projects
  
  

* Manage budgets and keep projects profitable
* Help draft quotations, including basic AV specifications
* Manage client expectations, scope and feedback after project confirmation
* Help improve production processes and workflows

Who Thrives in This Role
  
  
This role suits a producer who is strong in film and keen to learn a second discipline.
  
  
**You likely:**  

* Have 3-5 years of experience in film or video production, ideally at a production house. Agency producers who have directly managed film and video shoots from start to finish are welcome
* Have led shoots independently, with small crews as a baseline
* Are strong at costing, quoting, scheduling, and managing clients, crews and vendors
* Communicate clearly under pressure and keep multiple stakeholders aligned
* Work well with directors, writers, creatives and technical teams
* Are curious about live production and keen to learn it. No prior live experience is needed, as training will be provided

Experience on larger commercial productions, or working with international agencies, is an advantage. Creative producer experience is a plus. Experience in live events or AVL production is an advantage.
  
  
Why Join Adrenalin Group
  
  
At AVPD Studios, you'll build a second discipline alongside your film craft, working on everything from lean branded content and conferences to the occasional large-scale commercial with an international crew.
  
  
At Adrenalin Group, we believe in growing people alongside the work they do. We offer lifestyle benefits, basic health support, team recognition initiatives, and an optional leadership development track.
  
  
Adrenalin Group is an Integrated Communications company with three business divisions: Adrenalin X (Experiential Events), AVPD Studios (Broadcast, Livestream & Full-Service Production), and Aether Labs (Innovation & Emerging Tech). Founded 17 years ago, we have grown into a trusted and preferred partner for large-scale government initiatives, corporate events, and brand activations, delivering impactful experiences that bring ideas to life and engage audiences meaningfully.
  
  
Our expertise spans public campaigns, industry conferences, product launches, and stakeholder engagement initiatives, integrating immersive storytelling, cutting-edge production, and strategic events execution. Our people-first, purpose-driven approach ensures that every event and activation is designed to inspire, engage, and create lasting impact. Our inclusive and diverse team brings together talent from different backgrounds, fostering an environment that values creativity, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  
  
Beyond delivering high-quality events, we are committed to governance excellence, environmental responsibility, and sustainable business growth. We incorporate environmentally conscious event solutions that is supported by Enterprise SG, embrace ethical business practices, and uphold industry standards that align with best practices. Our longstanding professional work relationships with government agencies and businesses enable us to contribute meaningfully to Singapore’s events and creative industries.
  
  
As we continue to evolve, Adrenalin remains focused on leveraging technology, expanding our capabilities, and setting new benchmarks in experiential communications - ensuring that our work not only engages audiences but also supports long-term economic and environmental sustainability.

title: Global Corporate Banking - Subsidiary Banking - Intra-Asia Greater China Desk, Executive Director
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

The senior Greater China Desk banker will play a key leadership role within the Intra-Asia Subsidiary Banking franchise, with primary responsibility for driving the growth of our Greater China corporate client business across Asia Pacific region.

The role will focus on deepening relationships with leading Greater China corporates as they expand their business, investments and financial activities across ASEAN and the broader Asia Pacific region. The successful candidate will combine strong senior-client connectivity in Greater China with a deep understanding of cross-border corporate banking, capital allocation, risk management and broader institutional banking product suite.

As a senior member of the Intra-Asia team, the individual will also help shape the strategic direction of the franchise, develop the Greater China coverage team and serve as a senior bench leader capable of taking the Intra-Asia Greater China business to the next level.

Key Responsibilities:

* Lead the Greater China Intra-Asia growth strategy:
  + Drive sustainable revenue growth and returns from the Greater China portfolio. Maintain disciplined prioritization of capital and resources, with a strong focus on relationship returns, wallet capture and cross-product penetration.
  + Own and drive the strategy for Greater China-headquartered corporates operating and investing across Asia, with particularly focus on ASEAN and other priority platforms such as RTC, RHQ, IHQ in Hong Kong and Singapore corridors.
  + Identify structural growth themes and emerging client opportunities arising from Chinese corporates' regional and global expansion, including manufacturing relocation, supply-chain diversification, energy transition, digital infrastructure, technology, innovation economy and AI infrastructure sectors.
  + Translate these themes into actionable client strategies, prioritized prospect pipelines and measurable revenue opportunities.
  + Partner with Greater China and regional leadership to continuously refine the target client universe and resource allocation across the franchise.
* Drive senior client coverage and origination:
  + Develop trusted relationships with CFOs, Treasurers and other senior decision-makers at leading Greater China corporates.
  + Lead strategic dialogue with clients around their cross-border banking and financing needs, including payments/cash management, liquidity, trade finance, market FX and rates, lending, capital markets and other strategic financing solutions.
  + Originate complex, multi-product and multi-country opportunities by connecting clients with the bank's capabilities across markets and products.
  + Act as a senior escalation and relationship point for strategically important Greater China-headquartered clients across Asia Pacific region. Facilitate senior connectivity between Greater China corporate decision-makers and the bank's regional and global leadership.
  + Build effective coverage models that combine strong headquarters relationships with high-quality subsidiary coverage in destination markets. Coordinate client strategy across countries and products to ensure a consistent, enterprise-wide approach to priority relationships.
* Provide franchise leadership:
  + Serve as a senior member of the Intra-Asia leadership team and contribute to broader strategy and management of the franchise.
  + Provide leadership, coaching and sponsorship to Greater China Desks bankers and help develop the next generation of senior coverage talents.
  + Raise standards around client planning, origination, execution and senior stakeholder management.

Required Qualifications and Skillsets:

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related discipline.
* Minimum 10 years of relevant corporate banking experience, including coverage of China-linked clients and/or Greater China corridors.
* Significant corporate banking or institutional client coverage experience, ideally including substantial Greater China and cross-border responsibilities. Mandarin proficiency (spoken and written), aligned to client coverage needs.
* Strong understanding of transaction banking, markets, credit, trade finance, and the ability to connect these into cohesive client solutions. Proven relationship management and origination capability, including negotiation and long-term client stewardship.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating complex, multi-product and multi-country opportunities with multiple stakeholders and tight execution timelines. Strong analytical skills and commercial judgment, with the ability to align opportunities to risk appetite and controls.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills; ability to influence and coordinate across internal stakeholders and client teams. Strong organization skills with ability to manage multiple concurrent deliverables while maintaining execution quality and deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications and Skillsets:

* Familiarity with multinational subsidiary treasury operating models, including cross-border liquidity structures, cash concentration, and intercompany flows.
* Demonstrated leadership capability with a collaborative, team-oriented approach, effectively partnering across coverage and product stakeholders to drive shared objectives and business outcomes.
* Track record of effective partnership with Risk, Compliance, and Credit stakeholders in a high-control environment, including issue escalation and remediation support.

**ABOUT US**
  
  
J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.  

We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Assistant Director
description:
COMPANY DESCRIPTION
  
  
Montfort Care is a social service agency that works with individuals, families and communities to create new possibilities. Founded in 2000, we now employ more than 400 employees and operate from over 30 locations in Singapore across Anti-Violence, Family Service, Mental Health, Caregiving and Eldercare services.
  
  
Guided by our founding ethos, "Those whom the world rejects must move you the most", we believe no life should be defined by its hardest circumstances. Behind every struggle is a person or family with dignity, strengths and possibilities yet to be realised. Our work begins by seeing what others may overlook and creating the conditions for people to reclaim agency, rebuild relationships and shape a different future.
  
  
Find out more at www.montfortcare.org.sg
  
  
RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
The Strategy & Growth team is an organisation-wide capability-building function for Montfort Care (MFC), partnering with leaders and teams to address the organisation's most complex and pressing challenges. It combines strategic thinking, transformation expertise and implementation to strengthen organisational capabilities and achieve sustainable impact.
  
  
The
  
  
Assistant Director
  
  
, Transformation leads organisation-wide transformation initiatives that improve service effectiveness, operational efficiency and client experience. Reporting to the Director, Strategy & Growth, the role has a strong focus on rethinking service delivery through digital means while ensuring that services remain accessible and inclusive for clients who may face barriers to digital adoption. The portfolio also includes non-digital aspects that enable digital service delivery, including service redesign, process improvement, operating model changes and new ways of working.
  
  
Working closely with the Director, Strategy & Growth, leadership, service leaders and corporate service functions, the Assistant Director identifies high-value digital transformation opportunities and leads initiatives from discovery and business case development through experimentation, implementation, adoption and benefits realisation. The role applies user-centred, agile and data-informed approaches to translate organisational and client needs into scalable solutions.
  
  
The
  
  
Assistant Director
  
  
, Transformation develops the internal capabilities required to sustain new ways of working. The role champions responsible experimentation, digital confidence and continuous improvement, ensuring that transformation strengthens outcomes for clients and employees without leaving digitally less-confident users behind.
  
  
This is a high-visibility role with frequent opportunities to engage and present to the Chief Executive Officer and leadership team. The
  
  
Assistant Director
  
  
must understand strategic intent, exercise sound judgement and translate broad direction into coherent priorities, practical action plans and measurable outcomes. The role offers an opportunity for a transformation practitioner to step into a wider organisational remit and make a significant contribution to Montfort Care's service and organisational outcomes.
  
  
Organisation Strategy Alignment and Transformation Planning
  
  
Partner with leadership, service leaders, employees and clients to define the future of social service delivery and identify the operating models, capabilities and transformation priorities required to realise it.
  
  
Define measurable outcomes and benefits for transformation initiatives, including improvements in client experience, service effectiveness, employee productivity, adoption, accessibility, efficiency and cost, and establish mechanisms to track benefits from baseline through implementation and scale-up.
  
  
Lead research, horizon scanning and analysis of client needs, sector developments, emerging technologies and new service delivery models. Translate findings into clear opportunity statements and evidence-based recommendations for leadership consideration.
  
  
Work with leadership to shape and prioritise a portfolio of digital and non-digital transformation initiatives based on strategic relevance, client and employee value, feasibility, inclusion, risk, resource requirements and expected benefits.
  
  
Facilitating annual/ multi-year strategic planning cycles. Lead secretariat function to organize MFC's annual work plan; this includes pre-retreat planning, conduct of retreats, and organising of cascade briefs to middle managers and front liners.
  
  
Transformation Project Management
  
  
Map out and track transformation project progress against MFC's strategic objectives to ensure alignment of transformation projects to broader organisational goals.
  
  
Establish governance structure for identified transformation projects based on organisation priorities; e.g. project organisation, project charter, timelines, resources, and accountability.
  
  
Engage stakeholders to build understanding of transformation objectives and drive ownership of transformation objectives by service pillars.
  
  
Diagnose broad or ambiguous symptoms, frame clear problem statements and identify root causes through data analysis, user research and process mapping. Conceptualise and implement fit-for-purpose responses, which may include service redesign, digital solutions, process improvement, operating model or organisation structure changes, capability development, and leadership or culture interventions.
  
  
Coach and guide Transformation team and Service Pillar Heads on transformation frameworks, methodologies, change management approaches and best practices. Support leadership in resolving organisation-wide structural, operational, or cultural barriers to transformation success.
  
  
Together with Service Pillar Heads, Transformation team, Communications team, drive change management strategies to enable success of transformation projects.
  
  
Track and manage transformation project progress and risks to ensure timely delivery of transformation milestones.
  
  
Design and deliver a tiered digital capability programme that can be scaled across more than 400 employees, covering foundational digital literacy, role-specific skills and advanced capabilities for digital champions. Develop playbooks, communities of practice, coaching and practical learning interventions that build a digital-first culture while supporting employees with different levels of confidence and readiness.
  
  
Experimentation and scaling
  
  
Lead research, experimentation and pilots for new ways of delivering services. Define hypotheses and success measures, test solutions with employees and clients, evaluate evidence and risks, and recommend whether initiatives should be stopped, refined or scaled.
  
  
Vendor Management
  
  
Build and manage partnerships with technology providers, social service agencies, public-sector bodies, research institutions and other ecosystem partners or vendors to co-develop and deliver transformation initiatives. Establish clear outcomes, governance, responsibilities and performance measures for joint projects.
  
  
Manage and track KPIs of vendors to ensure service delivered meet our contractual needs.
  
  
Funding Management
  
  
Research relevant grants and funding opportunities, and develop use cases and applications that support digital and broader transformation initiatives. Manage funding commitments, budgets, milestones, reporting and benefit measures to ensure compliance and intended outcomes.
  
  
Plan yearly departmental budget and be accountable for the expenditure of these funds in support of MFC organisational objectives.
  
  
People Management
  
  
Lead and develop strategy and transformation teams to drive delivery of organisational objectives.
  
  
Foster a culture of innovation in the team to meet social mission and objectives.
  
  
Risk and Compliance
  
  
Understand IPC (Institute of Public Character) and charity organisations compliance and regulatory requirements and ensure adherence.
  
  
Identify and manage transformation risks, including data protection, cybersecurity, accessibility, ethical use of technology, vendor dependency, service continuity and unintended exclusion of clients. Work with relevant corporate service functions and funders to ensure that initiatives meet applicable regulatory, security and governance requirements.
  
  
Others
  
  
Responsibilities listed above are not exhaustive. From time to time, additional duties or projects may be assigned based on organisational needs.
  
  
QUALIFICATIONS
  
  
Bachelor's degree from a recognised institution of higher learning in business, information technology, information systems, engineering, social sciences, public policy, organisational development or a related discipline. An advanced degree in business administration, information technology or a related field is advantageous.
  
  
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, Change management certifications (e.g. Prosci) is advantageous but not mandatory.
  
  
OTHER INFORMATION
  
  
Relevant Experience and Required Competencies
  
  
At least 7-10 years of progressive experience in management consulting, internal transformation, service design, digital transformation, innovation or major programme delivery, including demonstrated experience leading digital initiatives from problem definition through implementation and adoption.
  
  
Prior experience in a major technology company, digital consultancy or technology-enabled organisation, with responsibility for delivering digital products or initiatives for internal or external users.
  
  
Experience in social sector, healthcare, or mission-driven organisations is advantageous. Candidates from other sectors with an interest in driving the change in the social service sector are encouraged to apply.
  
  
3-5 years of leading teams or major workstreams with a demonstrated ability to drive organisation-wide strategy and transformation projects. Hands-on experience in driving transformation planning, stakeholder engagement and governance.
  
  
Experience working with data, KPI, OKRs, dashboarding for reporting for leadership teams.
  
  
Experience in driving process redesign, operating model/ organisation structure, skilling strategy, leadership and culture initiatives.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives, establish priorities based on organisational needs and delivery capacity, and build alignment across service, corporate and technology stakeholders.
  
  
Ability to lead concurrent initiatives using an agile, test-and-learn mindset while maintaining disciplined governance over scope, priorities, interdependencies, resources, risks and delivery commitments. The candidate must be able to adapt the approach when evidence or organisational needs change without allowing uncontrolled scope expansion.
  
  
Strong analytical ability & problem-solving skills to identify critical areas for action in a data-informed manner.
  
  
Executive presence and sound judgement to engage senior leadership, challenge assumptions constructively and influence decisions, combined with the ability to explain complex transformation and digital concepts to frontline employees and non-technical stakeholders to build understanding and commitment.
  
  

* Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

Please note that your application will be sent to and reviewed by the direct employer - Montfort Care

title: Director of Growth
description:
UPGroup Asia | Singapore & Southeast Asia
  
  
The Role
  
  
We are seeking an entrepreneurial and commercially driven Director of Growth to lead UPGroup Asia's next phase of expansion.
  
  
Reporting to the Group CEO, this role will be responsible for developing and executing a 3–5 year growth strategy that accelerates revenue, strengthens profitability and expands the Group's presence across Southeast Asia.
  
  
Beyond traditional business development, the Director of Growth will identify new markets, strategic partnerships, business channels and revenue streams, including opportunities to develop proprietary intellectual property (IP) and scalable business models.
  
  
The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in achieving measurable year-on-year revenue growth while maintaining a healthy EBITDA margin annually, building a sustainable and profitable regional business.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Drive Group Revenue & EBITDA Growth
  
  
Develop and execute a 3–5 year growth strategy aligned with the Group's long-term business objectives.
  
  
Drive agreed year-on-year revenue growth while maintaining the agreed EBITDA margin.
  
  
Identify and prioritise high-growth opportunities across Events, AV Production, Venue Management and other complementary businesses.
  
  
Work closely with business unit leaders to improve profitability, optimise commercial performance and accelerate sustainable growth.
  
  
2. Develop New Business Channels & Revenue Streams
  
  
Identify, develop and launch new business channels, products and revenue streams that complement the Group's existing capabilities.
  
  
Explore opportunities to develop proprietary IP, owned events, experiential concepts and recurring revenue models.
  
  
Evaluate new business opportunities based on market potential, scalability, profitability and long-term commercial value.
  
  
Build business cases, go-to-market strategies and execution plans to successfully commercialise new initiatives.
  
  
3. Expand Regional Markets & Strategic Partnerships
  
  
Identify and develop growth opportunities across Singapore and key Southeast Asian markets.
  
  
Establish strategic partnerships with venue owners, hotel groups, convention centres, agencies, brands and corporate clients.
  
  
Develop market-entry strategies and commercial partnerships that enable scalable regional expansion.

* **Lead Strategic Lithography Supplier Management**: Develop strong strategic alliances with major lithography equipment and technology providers to advance industry BIC performance, promote technology co-innovation, guarantee equipment quality and reliability, uphold service excellence, achieve cost competitiveness, and guide long-term technology roadmaps. Influence supplier focus and hasten closure of critical performance gaps.
* **AI Transformation**: Leveraging AI and drive AI adoption to improve efficiency, speed, and decision-making. Build AI capabilities and align the team with future workforce needs.
* **Strengthen Equipment Quality & Reliability**: Lead detailed efforts to remove chronic equipment issues and stop repeat excursions by applying root-cause resolution, equipment qualification, maintenance strategies, change control, and continuous improvement.
* **Develop Photolithography Technical Talent**: Cultivate a strong pipeline of photolithography technical leaders and subject matter experts within the Micron network. Promote technical skill advancement, mentorship, succession planning, and cross-fab collaboration to reinforce expertise in advanced lithography, EUV, equipment engineering, operational excellence, and new technology introduction.

* Strong analytical and structured problem-solving capabilities with experience applying data, automation, advanced analytics, and AI to manufacturing and equipment efficiency.

* Ability to lead complex technical challenges, translate strategy into execution, and deliver measurable business and manufacturing outcomes.

description:
**About Kaiko**

Finance is moving onchain. Stocks, funds, bonds and cash are being tokenized, settlement is getting close to instant, and markets are starting to trade around the clock. That shift only works if every participant can trust the data it runs on.

Kaiko is that trusted data partner. Banks, asset managers, exchanges, market makers, fund administrators and regulators use us to price, trade, value, manage risk and report as markets become digital, global and always on.

**What we do**

* Market data: institutional-grade trade and order-book data from traditional, digital and onchain venues, normalized into one reliable source.
* Analytics: liquidity, market structure, derivatives and onchain insight that turn raw data into decisions.
* Indices and reference rates: transparent, rules-based 24/7 benchmarks and continuous pricing used to value portfolios, mark collateral and build investment products.
* Data infrastructure: resilient, always-on delivery through APIs, cloud, partner channels and AI-ready access, built into the systems our clients already use.

In September 2026, Kaiko extended its Series B to $110M, led by S&P Global, with BNP Paribas, Bpifrance, Broadridge, Canton, Coinbase Ventures, DRW Venture Capital, Nasdaq Ventures, Royal Bank of Canada, Stellar, and Susquehanna. This year we also acquired Amberdata and Cometh, which broadens our analytics, data and onchain capabilities. Kaiko is SOC 1 and SOC 2 certified and MiCA- and DORA-compliant: the standards institutions expect from a critical data provider.

**Who We Are**

We’re a team of over 100 passionate individuals with a deep interest in building data solutions and supporting the growth of the digital finance economy. We’re proud of Kaiko’s talented team and are committed to our international representation and diversity. Our people and their values are the foundation of our continued success.

### **About the Role**

The Sales Director - APAC will execute Kaiko’s APAC GTM strategy, set and track clear KPIs, achieve regional sales targets, and be a leader to the Kaiko APAC team.

The role is based out of Kaiko’s Singapore office, with necessary regional travels.

* Participate in events in your region to proactively approach new prospects.
* Execute sales strategies to accelerate growth. Influence and implement the sales playbook, create and execute territory plan, and prepare and drive accurate revenue forecasts.
* Actively participate in closing complex opportunities in collaboration with Kaiko team members and develop an extensive partner network, building effective relationships across the target landscape and across the broader ecosystem.
* Leverage and maintain internal Sales dashboard and tools.
* Effective coordination with the Kaiko global sales team, and operations, product, engineering, and legal teams to execute and meet sales objectives.
* Mentor juniors and lead by example.

  

**Must Haves**

* Background and experience in decentralized finance and blockchains
* Understanding of traditional finance markets and financial concepts (rates, indices, risk management tools such as implied volatility and surface vol, trades and order-book data, etc.)
* Excellent commercial skills with a strategic mindset
* Ability to develop and nurture relationships
* Excellent communication skills
* Fluent English - both written and spoken, with proficiency in at least one additional language (Mandarin, Korean, Japanese)

  

**Nice to have**

* Strong affinity and exposure to the financial data industry, specifically with experience in crypto or similar markets.
* Ability to listen carefully, understand needs and build trusted relationships, including at senior executive level in large complex organisations.
* Have sold to financial institutions and bring strong pattern recognition in this space along with the exposure to broader B2B SaaS.

**What we offer**

* Great health insurance
* Contribution to your monthly gym subscription
* Remote-friendly position

* An entrepreneurial environment with a lot of autonomy and responsibilities

description:
Explore the possibilities across our global house of brands.

Defined by inclusivity rather than exclusivity, Tapestry embraces the exploration of individuality and invests in helping you grow personally and professionally. Every individual in our global house has the opportunity to make an impact, learn and be part of our growing and unique story.

At Tapestry, we have the freedom to express ourselves and run with our best ideas across Coach and Kate Spade New York. We share a profound belief in both our individual and collective potential, and know that with hard work and dedication, anything is possible.

  

Lead Merchandise Financial Planning (“MFP”), Consensus Demand Planning and Inventory Planning for the Business Unit (“BU”), serving as a strategic planning partner to the BU Head and Buying Leaders. You will translate commercial ambition into topline financial and inventory plans, orchestrate consensus demand planning, and drive decisions on inventory investment and coverage, while identifying risks and opportunities and mobilizing cross-functional action. You will own MFP, OTB and financial guardrails, while BU Buying Leaders retain accountability for commercial decisions, including assortment and ranging.

You will also lead the evolution to our next-generation integrated planning model, building more specialized Demand Planning capabilities and connected ways of working across the business.

  

**Merchandise Financial Planning, OTB & Coverage**
--------------------------------------------------

* Own the consolidated BU Merchandise Financial Plan, translating Global targets and the brand plan into sales, margin and inventory targets by category and linking growth blocks to the 5P framework (People/Consumer, Product, Price, Place and Promotion).

* Own the BU OTB and forward-cover position, ensuring inventory investment remains aligned with demand and financial targets.

* Lead investment trade-offs and decisions across product departments, resolving or escalating gaps to BU and Global targets.

* Own in-season reforecasting and validate chase & cancellation proposals against demand, coverage and OTB.

* Report on key MFP metrics to the Head of the BU and senior leadership.

**Consensus Demand Planning**
-----------------------------

* Lead the BU consensus demand planning process translating the brand plan's Five Ps assumptions (People/Consumer, Product, Price, Place and Promotion) into a credible view of consumer demand by category, challenging assumptions and driving alignment on a single consensus demand view.
* Drive the identification and resolution of gaps between the unconstrained demand plan, financial targets and inventory supportability, bringing forward risks, opportunities and recommended actions, and facilitating timely decisions and escalations.
* Model upside and downside scenarios, put a value on risks and opportunities in units, dollars, and margin and recommend where to place bets.
* Drive continuous improvement of the system-generated forecast by identifying performance gaps, capturing learnings from commercial adjustments and actual results, and feeding those insights back to Global Forecasting to refine the baseline.

* Hold the team accountable for forecast accuracy, bias and Forecast Value Add.

* Facilitate the Consensus Demand & Inventory Review as part of IBP governance.

**Inventory Planning & Deployment**
-----------------------------------

* Establish inventory targets and policies across all life-cycle segments, including SKU targets

* Oversee the VMI program and support execution of new programs and initiatives.

**Demand Planning Leadership & Transformation**
-----------------------------------------------

* Establish and champion best practices for SKU-level Demand Planning across the BU.

* Lead and develop the MFP, Consensus Demand and Inventory Planning organization, building future capability, talent and succession.

* Partner with the Global Forecasting function as it is established to shape forecasting capabilities, ensure BU commercial requirements are reflected in model design, and drive adoption, performance and continuous improvement within the BU.

* Lead the transition to our next-generation integrated planning model, building specialized Demand Planning capabilities and driving adoption of connected, exception-based ways of working that shift time from manual processes to higher-value judgment and decisions.

Hold teams accountable for using system data as the source of truth, resolving data-quality and reconciliation issues, and escalating matters to the appropriate Global standard owners.  



**Our Competencies for All Employees**  
**Courage** : Doesn’t hold back anything that needs to be said; provides current, direct, complete, and “actionable” positive and corrective feedback to others; lets people know where they stand; faces up to people problems on any person or situation (not including direct reports) quickly and directly; is not afraid to take negative action when necessary.
  
**Creativity** : Comes up with a lot of new and unique ideas; easily makes connections among previously unrelated notions; tends to be seen as original and value-added in brainstorming settings.
  
**Customer Focus** : Is dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal and external customers; gets first-hand customer information and uses it for improvements in products and services; acts with customers in mind; establishes and maintains effective relationships with customers and gains their trust and respect.
  
**Dealing with Ambiguity** : Can effectively cope with change; can shift gears comfortably; can decide and act without having the total picture; isn’t upset when things are up in the air; doesn’t have to finish things before moving on; can comfortably handle risk and uncertainty.
  
**Drive for Results** : Can be counted on to exceed goals successfully; is constantly and consistently one of the top performers; very bottom-line oriented; steadfastly pushes self and others for results.
  
**Interpersonal Savvy** : Relates well to all kinds of people, up, down, and sideways, inside and outside the organization; builds appropriate rapport; builds constructive and effective relationships; uses diplomacy and tact; can diffuse even high-tension situations comfortably.
  
**Learning on the Fly** : Learns quickly when facing new problems; a relentless and versatile learner; open to change; analyzes both successes and failures for clues to improvement; experiments and will try anything to find solutions; enjoys the challenge of unfamiliar tasks; quickly grasps the essence and the underlying structure of anything.
  
  
**Our Competencies for All People Managers**  
**Strategic Agility** : Sees ahead clearly; can anticipate future consequences and trends accurately; has broad knowledge and perspective; is future oriented; can articulately paint credible pictures and visions of possibilities and likelihoods; can create competitive and breakthrough strategies and plans.
  
**Developing Direct Reports and Others** : Provides challenging and stretching tasks and assignments; holds frequent development discussions; is aware of each person's career goals; constructs compelling development plans and executes them; pushes people to accept developmental moves; will take on those who need help and further development; cooperates with the developmental system in the organization; is a people builder.
  
**Building Effective Teams** : Blends people into teams when needed; creates strong morale and spirit in their team; shares wins and successes; fosters open dialogue; lets people finish and be responsible for their work; defines success in terms of the whole team; creates a feeling of belonging in the team.

title: Landscape Operations Executive
description:
**Department:**  
Botanique Scape Operations
  
  
**Reports to:**  
Botanique Scape Director
  
  
**Employment:**  
Full Time
  
  
**Location:**  
60 Paya Lebar Road #09-13 Paya Lebar Square Singapore 409051
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The Landscape Operations Executive coordinates and supervises day-to-day deployment of landscape crew, quality check on the team's performance, plants and product procured. You will make sure work is delivered safely, on schedule, within budget, and to the client’s quality standards. You will be the link between Horticulturist, management, site crews, subcontractors, suppliers and clients.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Site and work coordination
  
  
Plan and schedule daily, weekly and monthly maintenance routines (turfing, pruning, irrigation, fertilising, pest control, planting)
  
  
Allocate manpower, equipment and materials across sites
  
  
Conduct regular site inspections and make sure work meets contract specifications and quality standards
  
  
Track progress on landscape installation and enhancement projects
  
  
Team and subcontractor supervision
  
  
Supervise supervisors, gardeners and general workers
  
  
Brief teams on daily work plans, safety requirements and priorities
  
  
Manage subcontractors and monitor their performance, attendance and compliance
  
  
Support training and skills development for site staff
  
  
Crew Scheduling
  
  
Client and stakeholder management
  
  
Act as the day-to-day contact for clients, property managers and authorities
  
  
Respond to feedback, complaints and service requests promptly
  
  
Compile, prepare and present service reports, inspection findings and recommendations
  
  
Support contract renewals by maintaining strong client relationships
  
  
Health, safety and compliance
  
  
Enforce workplace safety and health policies, including work-at-height, machinery and chemical handling procedures
  
  
Conduct toolbox meetings, risk assessments and incident investigations
  
  
Make sure site practices meet statutory and environmental requirements
  
  
Resources, assets and cost control
  
  
Monitor use of materials, plants, chemicals, fuel and equipment
  
  
Ensure plants are in good condition before releasing them to client's premise.
  
  
Arrange servicing and repair of machinery and tools
  
  
Raise purchase requests and coordinate with suppliers and nurseries
  
  
Help manage site budgets and flag cost overruns early
  
  
Reporting and administration
  
  
Maintain site records, attendance, work logs, inspection checklists and maintenance schedules
  
  
Reporting monthly attendance submission.
  
  
Prepare progress, incident and variation reports for management
  
  
Support invoicing, claims
  
  
Requirements
  
  
Qualifications and experience
  
  
WSQ CUGE Level 2 and above. Nitec/Higher Nitec or fresh graduates with strong interest in landscape and plants
  
  
2–4 years of experience in landscape operations or maintenance, or in site supervision
  
  
Experience supervising workers or subcontractors is preferred
  
  
Skills and knowledge and good to have
  
  
Solid knowledge of plant care, turf management, irrigation systems and horticultural practices
  
  
Familiarity with workplace safety regulations and site risk management
  
  
Good planning, organising and problem-solving skills
  
  
Strong communication and people management skills
  
  
Class 3 and above driving license for island wide visits is an advantage
  
  
Proficiency in MS Office; experience with work-order or maintenance management software is an advantage
  
  
Industry credentials - ISA certified arborist or CPH Certified Practicing Horticulturist
  
  
Personal attributes
  
  
Hands-on, proactive and comfortable working outdoors in varying weather
  
  
Customer-focused, with attention to detail
  
  
Able to handle multiple sites and shifting priorities
  
  
Willing to work occasional weekends or on short notice for urgent site needs
  
  
Key Performance Indicators
  
  
Client satisfaction and complaint resolution time
  
  
On-time completion of scheduled works
  
  
Safety record (incidents and near-misses)
  
  
Adherence to budget and resource use
  
  
Quality audit scores
  
  
What We Offer
  
  
$3,500 to $3,800
  
  
Benefits, such as medical, annual leave, training, or uniform allowances
  
  
Career progression toward Senior Executive, Assistant Manager or Operations Manager roles
