title: Regional Demand Planner
description:
**Key Responsibilities:**  
1. Generation of Forecast using multi-view approach.
  
  
Forecasting Strategy – Identify and collaborate on changes to demand strategy relative to market and business changes, including demand pattern changes, seasonal influences and shifts in business focus.
  
  
Forecasting policies - Shape and refine forecasting policies to support business needs and system capabilities.
  
  
Co-ownership of Salesforce.com (CRM) opportunity pipeline integrity and trends, along with Regional Commercial Director (RCD).
  
  
Lead monthly customer forecast collection in a way that does not overload the Sales team.
  
  
Gain cross-functional alignment on the consensus forecast and its assumptions.
  
  
Consolidate and interpret information from multiple demand inputs, including Salesforce opportunities, statistical models, marketing strategic plans, and commercial/customer forecasts.
  
  
Use leading and lagging indicators to pressure test forecast assumptions. Understand market environment and dynamics that impact the demand plan.
  
  
Identify and document risks and upsides to the consensus forecast.
  
  
2. Support the monthly Integrated Business Planning (IBP) process.
  
  
Follow the workday calendar for loading forecast into APO (ERP) and preparing for Global Demand Review.
  
  
Ensure Americas Business Leadership are informed of key demand trends and implications.
  
  
Act as a trusted key leadership partner on behalf of Americas region to other functional leaders (Marketing, Finance, Product Management, Supply Chain etc.)
  
  
Identify gaps in the plan that require escalation. Perform what-if scenarios(simulations) to resolve demand/supply imbalances and equip business leadership to make educated decisions. Propose solutions to achieve business targets.
  
  
Monitor and respond to deviations in forecast KPIs and produce improvement resolutions.
  
  
3. Active participation in short- and long-term sales outlook processes.
  
  
Support the annual process to create and propose a regional Profit Objective/Business Plan for the upcoming year.
  
  
Collaborate with Regional Commercial Director (RCD) and Regional Enablement Leader (REL) to support a weekly pulse outlook for current quarter revenue.
  
  
Assist the commercial team to generate a monthly CY Sales Outlook, overlaying supply constraints and risks on unconstrained forecast.
  
  
4. Lead continuous improvement activities focused on growth and demand generation.
  
  
Demand segmentation - Continually assess and improve the demand segmentation framework to determine companywide approach to forecasting of different demand types (e.g., high volume, low volume, high volatility, seasonal, specific customers, segments).
  
  
Forecast model usage & back testing - Help identify, assess and implement best in class forecast models & techniques for different demand types; conduct back testing regularly to refine approaches.
  
  
Support effort to shift organization to Demand Generation culture, supporting improved business performance.
  
  
Utilize key working relationships across multiple functions in the business to facilitate and support improvement opportunities, including in reporting, analytics, inventory strategies, profit reviews etc.
  
  
**Key Qualifications:**  
BS degree in Engineering, Science, Supply Chain, Business, or related field.
  
  
Preferred experience with Forecasting, APO, Excel, Power BI, Salesforce.com, and other statistical models.
  
  
**Key Competencies:**  
Comfortable with complex datasets, SKU-level accuracy, and error prevention
  
  
Analytical Skills – creating insights/decisions from large datasets using Excel or PBI.
  
  
Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  
  
Able to inspire others to accept change and take action.
  
  
Innovative thinking through creative ideas and taking calculated risks.
  
  
Self-accountable for driving fast results, entrepreneurial spirit
  
  
Ability to collaborate effectively across functions, geographies, and levels in the organization and build positive working relationships with coworkers and internal customers.

title: Business Development Executive (Furniture B2B – Experienced Only)
description:
**Please read before applying:**  
We are only considering candidates who have
  
  
direct, proven experience in furniture B2B business development
  
  
. We are not looking to train someone on how the furniture trade works—we are looking for a seasoned closer who already knows the industry, understands the buyers, and knows exactly how to bring in more B2B furniture sales from day one.
  
  
If you already know how to get specified on projects, win over interior designers, navigate commercial budgets, and turn one-off trade inquiries into high-value repeat accounts, we want to talk to you.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
You will take immediate ownership of growing our B2B revenue, applying your proven sales playbook to expand our commercial and trade footprint. Your daily duties will include:
  
  
**Immediate Pipeline Generation:**  
Leverage your existing industry knowledge and outreach strategies to bring in new B2B clients—including interior design firms, architecture studios, fit-out contractors, hospitality groups, property developers, and corporate offices.
  
  
**Winning Specifications & Tenders:**  
Work directly with designers and project managers to get our pieces specified into mood boards, BOQs (Bills of Quantities), and commercial fit-out tenders.
  
  
**High-Ticket Closing:**  
Present custom capabilities, materials, and trade pricing with authority—negotiating commercial terms, bulk discounts, and payment schedules while protecting company margins.
  
  
**Account Expansion:**  
Convert first-time trade buyers into loyal, recurring accounts that come to you first for every new residential or commercial project.
  
  
**Seamless Handover:**  
Collaborate with our dedicated sales support, procurement, and logistics teams to verify production lead times, stock availability, and delivery schedules so your clients stay happy.
  
  
**Revenue Accountability:**  
Maintain a disciplined CRM pipeline and consistently hit or exceed monthly and quarterly B2B sales targets.
  
  
Who We Are Looking For (Non-Negotiable)
  
  
**Direct Furniture B2B Experience:**  
2+ years working specifically in B2B business development, trade sales, or project sales for a
  
  
furniture brand, distributor, or manufacturer
  
  
. Applications without furniture B2B experience will not be shortlisted.
  
  
**You Know How to Get Sales:**  
You don't need a script or hand-holding. You already have a tested playbook for finding decision-makers, booking meetings, and closing commercial furniture deals.
  
  
**Active Industry Network:**  
You ideally bring warm relationships—or know exactly how to quickly build them—with interior designers, architects, procurement managers, and commercial developers.
  
  
**Fluent in Furniture Specs:**  
You already understand lead times, MOQs, upholstery/material grading, custom fabrication limits, and how to read floor plans or BOQs.
  
  
**Commercially Driven:**  
You are motivated by closing big deals, hitting numbers, and maximizing your commission.
  
  
What We Offer
  
  
**High Earning Potential:**  
Competitive base salary paired with an aggressive, transparent commission structure built to reward proven rainmakers.
  
  
**Zero Admin Drag:**  
You sell; our dedicated procurement, logistics, and customer service teams handle the backend execution so your time stays focused on revenue.
  
  
**Autonomy & Growth:**  
We don't micromanage people who deliver. Prove you can grow the B2B book, and you have a direct path to Senior BD, Key Account Director, or Head of Commercial Sales.
  
  
Comfy is committed to working directly with world-class sofa manufacturers from around the globe. We have partnered with factories that have combined the very best of designer styles, high tech functionality, and honest pricing. In our effort to bring you the best options in style, comfort, and utility, we have essentially removed the need for furniture retailers. Keeping cost low, and streamlining your process has always been a top priority at Comfy. Therefore, all of our products are perfectly optimized to contain the best possible pricing, and the highest quality options available on the furniture market.

title: Commercial Development Director, MedSurgical
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

The Medical Surgical portfolio brings together multiple operating units, including Core Surgical Innovations (CSI), Respiratory Interventions and Surgical Technologies (RST), Digital Technologies (DT), Acute Care and Monitoring (ACM), and Endoscopy. This role connects the global operating units with Asia Region-Led Markets, including Hong Kong and Taiwan, to identify investments, establish priorities, and accelerate sustainable portfolio growth.

As Director, Medical Surgical Portfolio, you will lead commercial and market development across Asia Region-Led Markets, Hong Kong and Taiwan, translating portfolio strategy into market-level execution. You will partner across operating units and regional leadership to identify growth opportunities, prioritize investments, and drive execution toward Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and overall Medical Surgical portfolio performance. The role requires significant influence across functions and executive stakeholders, with additional focus on digital technologies, robotics and large capital opportunities.

  

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Lead commercial and market-development strategy across the Medical Surgical portfolio to accelerate growth and AOP performance.
* Translate global operating unit strategies into regional priorities, investments and execution plans across Asia Region-Led Markets, Hong Kong and Taiwan.
* Develop and execute commercial strategies for Digital Technologies, including digital and robotic technology adoption.
* Influence operating unit, regional and executive stakeholders to align priorities, secure support and advance strategic initiatives.
* Identify and evaluate new markets, investments, licensing opportunities and business-development opportunities using market and financial analysis.
* Lead business reviews and performance reporting, identifying risks, opportunities and actions to improve portfolio performance.
* Partner with sales, marketing, operating units and customers to identify market needs and develop near- and long-term growth strategies.
Build strategic relationships across functions and markets to accelerate execution, share best practices and strengthen regional commercial capabilities.  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree.
* 3+ years of digital and software sales experience.
* Experience in financial modelling, including sensitivity analysis and interpretation of results.
* Experience in market research, commercial strategy and translating market insights into business actions.
Experience influencing cross-functional stakeholders and managing multiple projects concurrently.  

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree.
* Commercial or market-development experience across Asia, including Hong Kong and/or Taiwan.
* Experience engaging senior and executive stakeholders across multiple countries or business units.
* Experience with large capital sales, digital health, digital technologies and/or robotics.
Medical Surgical portfolio, surgical technology or related clinical-specialty experience.  

**Physical Job Requirements**  
  
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.
‌
‌

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:

  

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.

  

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com .

**Benefits & Compensation**
===========================

**Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package**  
A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

This role is responsible for driving Eaton Electrical Sector sales strategy and success for the Data Center vertical market in Asia Pacific by working closely with regional / local sales organizations and aligned with the global and regional business growth strategy. Prepare and execute target account growth plans including specification development and actions at key value chain members and influencers. * Account relationship management involving account resources at appropriate decision making level with titles up to and including C-level executives. On-going assessment of relationship efficiency and effectiveness, insuring Eaton is in the best position to win profitable business.

Results and measurements will include quantitative and qualitative measures (revenue / orders, End-to-End profitability, extended portfolio, further strategic account development by defining mutual innovations and solutions projects, relationship development, etc.).
* Lead, coordinate and define a single, action oriented, account plan including input from all members of the regional/country sales, service and support team assigned and associated with the client(s) and as mutually agreed, where appropriate, by the assigned accounts. Establish domain expertise in strategic customer’s business, then develop and sustain relationships including high level contacts within assigned accounts.
* Lead and oversee the development of proposals, value propositions, alliances and contract negotiations with assigned accounts.
* Build, and then lead an ‘account team’ in support of assigned accounts. Leverage and coordinate resources including general sales force, product and commercial marketing, division operations, services and segment managers to achieve sales objectives.
* Ensure connections with any 3rd parties (consulting engineers, EPCs, contractors, manufacturers of ‘adjacent’ equipment) who have, or could have, significant influence at assigned Strategic Accounts.
* Engage the customer in new product/service development initiatives. Assure accounts are ‘top of mind’ within Eaton for customer focus groups in new technology development. Solicit their support in serving as a beta site for new offers and a reference case for accounts with similar applications.
* Provide leadership and input to marketing and operations to develop product and services solutions relevant to the accounts, assuring priority in product needs roadmap, as well as go to market strategies for the datacenter segment.
* Establish Eaton as a leader in the datacenter industry community. This role must be capable of serving as Eaton’s primary spokesperson in the industry and be viewed as a credible peer of key industry executives.
* Responsible for customer relationship review process for accounts as part of the voice of customer process.

-------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Business, MBA preferred
* Over 10 years of relevant experience in sales and/or business development，experience in the Data Center industry, particularly in East Asia.

a. Competitive benchmarking of features and pricing  
b. New product requirement definition  
c. Business plan development  
d. Value proposition development  
e. New product launches  
f. Forecasting

* Ability to understand and support complex products and technologies.

-----------

* Excellent written and verbal communication, including presentation skills.
* Strong organizational and project management skills.
* Ability to multitask and deliver projects within tight deadlines.
* Ability to work effectively in a matrix organization, virtual teams and cross-cultural environments

All positions may require participation in video and in-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

description:
**Company Description**

**About AbbVie**

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

 **Job Description**

The MSL Oncology – Hematology will play a crucial role in AbbVie’s preparedness for the launch of new hematology products. This individual will be responsible for addressing evidence and educational gaps and collaborating with external scientific stakeholders to develop partnerships that support and expedite opportunities for patients to access AbbVie’s advanced therapeutics.

Responsibilities:

* Provide scientific and technical leadership to ensure professional and credible relationships with thought leaders and external experts of strategic importance to AbbVie.
* Ensure a strong medical and scientific presence for AbbVie in key academic centers by facilitation of research and educational initiatives, while supporting requests for medical and scientific information on products or areas of therapeutic interest to AbbVie.
* Support internal teams such as sales, marketing and members of the Affiliate Brand Team to develop their scientific and technical expertise through the delivery of scientific update presentations. Work collaboratively and cross-functionally with other in-field members while retaining functional independence.
* Assist in the initiation; oversight and follow up of assigned clinical studies and medical projects initiated within the therapeutic area for which the MSL carries responsibility (e.g. post marketing clinical activities such as registry/database projects, epidemiological surveys, post-authorization studies (phase IV). All such activities must comply with applicable local laws, guidelines, codes of practice, SOPs, and AbbVie R&D (GPRD) SOPs.
* Act as the point of contact with thought leaders to facilitate Investigator Initiated Study (IIS) ideas and requests for support to the local and global medical teams as appropriate.
* Serve as a point of contact within the Medical Affairs team for thought leaders and external experts within an assigned geographic area to satisfy their needs for scientific knowledge in a therapeutic area and, when requested, relevant AbbVie medicines, to support their safe, effective and appropriate use.
* Deliver credible presentations on scientific matters to physicians, individually or in groups (meetings, clinical sessions, etc.), were requested, but with the focus on Tier 1 and 2 thought leaders.
* Participate in the selection process to identify appropriately qualified thought leaders the Company would wish to engage in collaborative efforts – such as potential research collaborations, or educational and advisory roles (Advisory Boards, Congresses, Symposia, etc.); while ensuring a high level of scientific or educational integrity in these collaborative efforts.
* Facilitate medical and scientific field intelligence – for example, competitor research and medical strategies, educational activities – and communicate, where appropriate, within the Company.
* Attend relevant scientific meetings and Conferences. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to develop summaries of key data and other scientifically relevant information to inform AbbVie strategic priorities and initiatives.

* Provide key thought leaders / external experts and internal medical and clinical teams with scientific and technical support for publications of scientific or medical interest.
* Ensure that all activities and interactions are conducted with due regard to all applicable local, global and national laws, regulations, guidelines, codes of conduct, Company policies and accepted standards of best practice.
* Location: A field based role with up to 20% of an individual’s time may be spent working in the affiliate medical team head office, typically – the remainder of time being spent as field based. This is subject to local needs, and the discretion of the ASEAN Medical Director.

* Medical, Pharmacy or other bachelor’s degree in scientific discipline or higher (PhD)
* A background in medical affairs or a related field, along with experience in working closely with the pharmaceutical industry.
* Strong understanding of the clinical landscape, including the regulatory and payer landscape in Singapore.
* Excellent communication and proven relationship-building skills in effectively establishing new links with external stakeholders.
* Possess strong organizational skills, the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

description:
### **ABOUT WORLD TABLE TENNIS**

World Table Tennis is where the sport’s fiercest battles meet bold ideas and creative minds. WTT is powered by a global crew of innovators, storytellers, and game-changers, who bring energy, expertise, and imagination to everything they do.

We’re not your typical workplace; we’re the global engine behind a sport on the rise. So whether it’s staging iconic global events or redefining fan experiences, this is where bold ideas get built, and where every role has impact. At WTT, the arena simply hits different.

### **HEAD OF CONTENDER & FEEDER SERIES**

The Head of Contender & Feeder Series is responsible for the overall oversight, coordination and consistent delivery of WTT Star Contender, WTT Contender and WTT Feeder events worldwide.

In addition, the position oversees the coordination and development of central event services, ensuring consistent operational standards, efficient resource allocation and effective support across the WTT event portfolio.

The successful candidate will provide leadership to Event Managers and Competition Managers, work closely with Local Organising Committees (LOCs) and WTT departments, and contribute to improving event quality, operational efficiency and financial sustainability.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES**

##### **Event Portfolio Leadership & Delivery:**

* Oversee the planning, preparation and delivery of WTT Star Contender, Contender and Feeder events.
* Ensure consistent implementation of WTT event manuals, competition requirements and operational standards.
* Monitor event readiness, timelines, budgets and operational risks, providing guidance and intervention where required.
* Support event managers and competition managers in delivering high-quality events and resolving operational challenges.
* Ensure consistent service standards for players, officials, sport presentation and other stakeholders.

##### **Central Event Services:**

* Oversee the coordination and continuous improvement of central event services supporting the wider WTT event portfolio.
* Develop and maintain standardised operational procedures, planning tools, templates and reporting systems.
* Coordinate shared event logistics, operational support services and supplier requirements with relevant WTT departments.
* Support the development and implementation of event management systems, including accreditation, entries and operational reporting.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, reduce duplication and optimise resources across events.
* Work closely with the heads of grand smash and champions to ensure consistent operational support across the WTT event portfolio.

##### **LOC & Stakeholder Management:**

* Maintain strong relationships with locs, national associations, host organisations and key stakeholders.
* Ensure event organisers understand and fulfil their contractual and operational obligations.
* Support the evaluation of potential host locations and event organisers.
* Participate in site inspections, planning meetings and event evaluations.
* Act as the senior escalation point for significant operational and stakeholder-related issues.

##### **Financial & Resource Management:**

* Monitor operational budgets and financial performance across the contender and feeder series.
* Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency and the financial sustainability of events.
* Support the evaluation of hosting proposals, operational budgets and resource requirements.
* Coordinate the effective allocation of event managers, competition managers and shared event resources.
* Work with WTT finance and relevant departments to monitor operational expenditure and event performance.

##### **Team Leadership & Cross-Departmental Coordination:**

* Provide leadership, direction and support to assigned event managers and competition managers.
* Establish clear responsibilities, objectives and performance expectations.
* Coordinate with WTT competition, operations, hospitality, it, commercial, sport presentation and creative media & engagement departments.
* Promote collaboration, accountability and knowledge sharing across the events team.
* Support staff development and continuous improvement of event delivery processes.

##### **Performance Review & Continuous Improvement:**

* Oversee post-event evaluations and ensure timely reporting.

* Degree or equivalent qualification in sports management, event management, business administration or a related field.
* Significant experience in international sports event management, with a proven track record of overseeing multiple events and leading multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong understanding of event operations, competition management, logistics and stakeholder services.
* Experience working with Local Organising Committees (LOCs), national federations and international stakeholders.
* Strong project management, budgeting and resource planning skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, digital collaboration tools and event management systems.
* Willingness to travel internationally and work flexible hours during event periods.

##### **Desirables:**

* Experience delivering international table tennis events or events in other racket sports.
* Experience implementing or improving event management systems, particularly for accreditation, entries or operational reporting.
* Experience coordinating shared operational services across multiple events, such as staffing, logistics or supplier support.

title: Head of Human Capital
description:
Role Purpose
  
  
Lead the organisation's People & Culture function, combining reliable HR operations with strategic workforce and talent development. Ensure employees are recruited well, supported fairly, developed intentionally and connected to the organisation's mission and values.
  
  
The role is both strategic and hands-on, providing advice to leadership while overseeing day-to-day HR delivery, governance, culture, capability, and future workforce needs.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
People Strategy and Workforce Planning
  
  
Develop and implement the People & Culture strategy aligned with organisational priorities.
  
  
Advise leadership on workforce planning, organisation design, talent needs, culture and people risks.
  
  
Build succession plans and talent pipelines for critical roles.
  
  
HR operations, governance and compliance
  
  
Oversee payroll, benefits, employee records, HR systems, policies and the staff handbook.
  
  
Ensure compliance with employment requirements, internal controls and data protection.
  
  
Prepare clear people reports, metrics and recommendations for leadership and the HC&N Sub-Committee.
  
  
Escalate serious grievances, legal exposure and other high-risk people matters promptly.
  
  
Recruitment and employee experience
  
  
Lead manpower planning, job design, recruitment, selection and onboarding.
  
  
Improve hiring quality, candidate experience and timely recruitment.
  
  
Strengthen the employee experience from onboarding to exit.
  
  
Performance, learning and capability
  
  
Lead a fair and practical performance management process.
  
  
Implement competency frameworks across recruitment, performance, learning and career development.
  
  
Drive learning, leadership development, coaching and manager capability-building.
  
  
Talent, culture and engagement
  
  
Lead talent reviews, career pathways, succession planning and retention efforts.
  
  
Partner with Organisational Development and leaders to strengthen values, serving leadership and workplace culture.
  
  
Lead staff engagement, listening, recognition and wellbeing initiatives, with visible follow-through.
  
  
Compensation and employee relations
  
  
Maintain fair and competitive salary and benefits practices within budget.
  
  
Manage annual salary and bonus reviews and oversee payroll controls.
  
  
Provide trusted advice on grievances, disciplinary matters, performance concerns and sensitive conversations.
  
  
Communication and change
  
  
Communicate policies, benefits, people initiatives and organisational changes clearly and sensitively.
  
  
Support leaders and managers in explaining people decisions and guiding employees through change.
  
  
Others
  
  
Any other related duties in New Hope CSL as assigned by Reporting Officer
  
  
Accountability
  
  
Reports to Deputy Director of Organisational Development
  
  
Competency Requirement
  
  
Core Competencies
  
  
Aligned with the New Hope CSL's mission and values.
  
  
Strategic but willing to be hands-on.
  
  
Empathetic, fair and decisive, with high integrity.
  
  
Collaborative, self-directed and confident in handling sensitive matters.
  
  
Strong knowledge of employment practices, employee relations, compensation, benefits and HR governance.
  
  
Experience in workforce planning, competency frameworks, performance, learning or succession planning.
  
  
Strong communication, judgement, discretion, coaching and change management skills.
  
  
Technical Competencies
  
  
Proficiency in IT Systems and Microsoft Office Suite (e.g., Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).
  
  
Education and Experience
  
  
Degree in Human Resources, Business, Psychology, Organisational Development or a related field.
  
  
At least 10 years of progressive HR or People & Culture experience, including 3 to 5 years in a senior role.
  
  
Experience across HR operations and strategic talent or human capital development.
  
  
Social service or non-profit experience is preferred.
  
  
The intent of this job description is to provide a representative summary of the major duties and responsibilities of the position. You may be required to perform job-related tasks other than those specifically presented in this description. This job description does not constitute a contract of employment.
  
  
New Hope Community Services (New Hope CS) is a social service agency working to bring change into the lives of the displaced and disadvantaged in the community.
  
  
Since 2004, we have been empowering our beneficiaries with opportunities to better their own lives. We provide a range of services and programmes such as temporary shelter, casework, mentoring, job-matching, life-skills training and support with long-term housing and employment. Together with our 3P Partners — Public, Private and People — we serve all people regardless of race or religion.
  
  
We are a full member of the National Council of Social Service since 2005 and have been granted Institutions of a Public Character (IPC) status until 2026.
  
  
Our Vision
  
  
To be a Beacon of New Hope to the Displaced and Disadvantaged in the Community.

title: Head of Strategic Programs and Enablement
description:
Posting Description:

**Head of Strategic Programs and Enablement**

**Aon is in the business of better decisions**

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world.

As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

**What the day will look like**

* Define and lead the multi-year ABS (Aon Business Services) APAC strategy, annual planning cycle, integrated roadmap and operating-model evolution.
* Lead APAC governance and Steering Committees, setting agendas, clarifying decision points and ensuring ownership, escalation and follow-through.
* Present priorities, performance, risks, investments, decisions and outcomes to APAC leadership and global ABS stakeholders.
* Lead regional portfolio and value-realisation governance, including demand prioritisation, investment alignment, dependencies and benefits tracking.
* Direct the ABS Business Partner model, translating Solution Line and country priorities into governed demand, roadmaps and investment cases.
* Sponsor the regional performance framework, KPI and OKR definitions, executive dashboards and financial-performance insights.
* Coordinate executive communications, leadership engagement and change narratives for the ABS APAC agenda.
* Lead and develop the Strategy & Planning team, with clear mandates, decision rights and succession capacity.

**How this opportunity is different**

The Head of Strategic Programs and Enablement shapes the ABS APAC agenda and translates regional priorities into a clear strategy, integrated plan and disciplined governance. As part of the ABS APAC leadership team, the role strengthens executive decision-making, prioritisation, investment alignment and visibility of performance and value creation.

The role connects business strategy, Solution Line priorities, country requirements, capacity, investment and delivery commitments. Success is reflected in a coherent multi-year roadmap, stronger governance, transparent performance and reporting on sustained business impact across APAC.

**Skills and experience that will lead to success**

* Extensive leadership experience across strategy, planning, transformation, portfolio management and business enablement in a complex matrix organisation.
* Demonstrated ability to advise senior executives, lead governance forums and influence regional and global decisions.
* Proven capability in operating-model design, investment prioritisation, business cases and portfolio governance across countries and business units.
* Strong commercial, financial and operational judgement, with an ability to connect strategic choices to measurable outcomes.
* Exceptional executive communication, synthesis, facilitation, negotiation and stakeholder-influencing skills.
* Proven people leadership and experience building accountable, multidisciplinary teams.

title: Head of Membership
description:
The Role
  
  
We are seeking a commercially driven and personable Head of Membership to grow our membership community, strengthen retention and lead the complete Member journey—from the first enquiry and Club tour to onboarding, everyday visits and renewal.
  
  
The role leads both the Membership team and the Member Experience team, with direct responsibility for reservations, concierge services, Member recognition and relationship management. It combines strategic commercial leadership with hands-on oversight of the interactions that shape how Members experience the Club.
  
  
The successful candidate will be a confident ambassador and a genuine host: someone who builds lasting relationships, understands individual preferences and ensures Members feel recognised, valued and connected. Success will be measured not simply by new memberships secured, but by the strength, engagement and loyalty of the community.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Membership Strategy, Acquisition & Revenue
  
  

* Develop and deliver the annual membership strategy and departmental budget, taking accountability for acquisition, joining-fee and subscription revenue, retention and net membership growth.
* Build a qualified prospect pipeline through Member referrals, corporate relationships, strategic partnerships, wine and food communities, and targeted initiatives developed with Marketing and Commercial & Events.
* Lead the enquiry-to-membership process, ensuring timely follow-up, engaging Club tours, clear communication of membership value and consistent application of the Club’s admission procedures.
* Maintain accurate forecasts and conversion reporting, assessing acquisition channels and campaign results to direct resources towards effective, sustainable growth.

2. Member Experience Team Leadership
  
  

* Directly manage the Member Experience team, overseeing reservations, concierge services, arrivals, Member recognition and day-to-day enquiries. Establish clear service standards, responsibilities and escalation procedures.
* Ensure every interaction—from a telephone call or reservation request to arrival and departure—is warm, professional, accurate and discreet.
* Oversee reservation management, waitlists and special requests, working closely with Operations to balance availability, Member access and service capacity in accordance with approved Club policies.
* Establish regular reviews of forthcoming reservations so that Member preferences, first visits, special occasions and relevant service requirements are communicated to Operations, Culinary and Wine teams before arrival.

3. Onboarding, Engagement & Community Building
  
  

* Own a structured onboarding journey, including welcome communications, Club orientation, team introductions and follow-up throughout the first 90 days, helping new Members feel comfortable and become active participants in Club life.
* Maintain a visible presence in the Club, building relationships beyond formal appointments and ensuring recognition extends across the membership community.
* Use Member interests, preferences and feedback to recommend relevant dining experiences, tastings, masterclasses and social occasions, encouraging participation without making interactions feel transactional.
* Work with Marketing, Commercial & Events, Wine and Operations to shape engaging programmes and communications, contributing Member insight while coordinating with the teams responsible for delivery.

4. Retention, Relationships & Service Recovery
  
  

* Lead a proactive retention programme, identifying reduced engagement, unresolved concerns and other signs of potential resignation, with clear ownership of personalised follow-up.
* Oversee renewals, reactivations and resignation requests, ensuring Members receive timely, accurate information and that the reasons behind departures are understood and reported.
* Take ownership of sensitive Member concerns and escalated complaints, coordinating appropriate resolution with the General Manager and relevant departments and following through directly with the Member.
* Turn recurring feedback into practical improvements to service, communication and the membership experience, rather than treating each concern as an isolated case.

5. Membership Administration, Systems & Governance
  
  

* Oversee accurate processing of applications, approvals, membership categories, account changes and benefits, applying approved fees and policies consistently and escalating exceptions for authorisation.
* Work closely with Finance on subscription notices, billing information, payment follow-up and account discrepancies, ensuring financial accuracy without compromising the Member relationship.
* Maintain the quality of membership and Member Experience records across the Club’s membership systems and SevenRooms, working with authorised colleagues to keep profiles, preferences and interaction histories accurate.
* Protect confidential Member information, uphold agreed data-access and amendment procedures, and provide regular reporting on acquisition, renewals, resignations, engagement and service performance.

6. Team Development & Cross-Club Collaboration
  
  

* Recruit, coach and develop the Membership and Member Experience teams, with clear objectives, regular feedback and practical training in Club knowledge, communication, hosting and service recovery.
* Manage staffing, rosters and departmental resources to provide appropriate coverage during operating hours, peak periods and key Club events.
* Build a culture of ownership: team members should anticipate needs, communicate clearly and follow requests through to resolution rather than simply passing them between departments.
* Work closely with Group Membership leadership and counterparts across the Clubs to maintain consistent standards, coordinate visiting-Member arrangements and support access to approved reciprocal privileges.

Candidate Requirements
  
  
Professional Experience
  
  

* Proven experience in a luxury private members’ club or a similarly exclusive, membership-led hospitality environment, with a strong understanding of member expectations, discretion, personalised service and club culture.
* Substantial experience in membership management, relationship management or premium hospitality, including responsibility for leading teams and delivering measurable business and service outcomes.
* Demonstrated success in growing membership or a comparable high-value client portfolio, improving retention, building referral networks and developing long-term relationships.
* Experience personally engaging with senior executives, high-profile individuals and discerning international clientele, while maintaining confidentiality and professional boundaries.

Commercial & Operational Capabilities
  
  

* Strong understanding of the full membership lifecycle, including prospecting, Club tours, applications, onboarding, engagement, renewals, reactivations and service recovery.
* Commercial acumen, with the ability to set targets, manage departmental budgets, forecast membership revenue, monitor conversion and retention, and turn performance data into action.
* Working knowledge of CRM and membership systems, with the ability to maintain accurate Member profiles and reporting; experience with SevenRooms or equivalent guest relationship platforms is advantageous.
* Sound judgment in managing reservations, concierge arrangements, sensitive Member requests and service escalations in a high-touch hospitality setting.

Leadership, Relationships & Personal Attributes
  
  

* A polished, approachable and confident host with outstanding interpersonal, presentation and written communication skills, able to build trust and represent the Club with credibility.
* A hands-on people leader who can coach, motivate and hold Membership and Member Experience teams accountable for consistently exceptional standards.
* Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across Operations, Wine, Culinary, Marketing, Events and Finance.
* Highly organised, culturally aware and solutions-oriented, with calm judgment under pressure, close attention to detail and a proactive approach to anticipating Members’ needs.
* Willingness to maintain a visible presence at the Club and support evening, weekend or special Member events as business needs require.

Additional Advantages
  
  

* An established professional network within Singapore’s premium hospitality, private club, corporate or luxury lifestyle communities, with the ability to create meaningful introductions and partnerships.
* A genuine interest in fine wine, gastronomy and curated cultural experiences, aligned with 67 Pall Mall’s membership community.
* Relevant qualifications in hospitality management, business, marketing or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience is equally valued.

**Standard Worldwide:**  
67 Pall Mall is a private members’ club like no other – founded by wine lovers, for wine lovers.
  
  
**Standard Worldwide:**  
This is a club which actively encourages members to share interest in the world’s finest wines with like-minded people; with a diverse wine list crafted to excite, challenge and captivate the club’s members.
  
  
**Country Specific:**  
From the historical penthouse on the top floor of Shaw Centre, we exist to bring people together over a shared love of wine, primarily to experience the diversity of our cellar, but also to meet new people and hear new ideas. We want to create a unique ambience, a sense of belonging and community, where wine enthusiasts from all walks of life can enjoy their passion.
  
  
**Standard Worldwide:**  
We encourage motivated individuals to join our diverse and inclusive team, where your unique perspectives and experiences are valued and celebrated.

title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
Chief Technology Officer (CTO) – Agentic AI / Generative AI
  
  
**Location:**  
Singapore
  
  
**Employment Type:**  
Full-time
  
  
**Work Arrangement:**  
On-site / Client-site as required
  
  
**Reporting To:**  
Chief Executive Officer
  
  
About the Company
  
  
Our client is an enterprise sovereign AI platform provider, developing secure, AI-powered solutions that enable organizations to unify institutional knowledge and execute intelligent workflows under strict governance and access controls.
  
  
Its platform supports deployment across air-gapped, private-cloud and sovereign environments, ensuring sensitive enterprise data remains within the client's own infrastructure.
  
  
The company serves organizations across government, banking and financial services, insurance, healthcare, manufacturing and construction.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
We are seeking an accomplished and commercially astute
  
  
Chief Technology Officer (CTO)
  
  
to spearhead the company's technology strategy, AI architecture and engineering development.
  
  
This is a hands-on executive leadership position requiring an individual who combines strong software engineering and AI development capabilities with the confidence and communication skills to engage investors, enterprise clients and strategic stakeholders.
  
  
The successful candidate must be comfortable moving between technical execution and executive-level discussions — from writing and reviewing code, designing AI architectures and guiding engineering teams to articulating the company's technology vision, presenting solutions and pitching to investors.
  
  
This is an opportunity for a technology leader who can translate ambitious AI concepts into production-ready products and commercially viable solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Hands-on Software Engineering & AI Development
  
  
Provide technical leadership in the design, development and implementation of AI-powered platforms and applications.
  
  
Maintain hands-on involvement in software development, including coding, code reviews, system architecture and technical problem-solving.
  
  
Drive the development and integration of Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents and intelligent automation capabilities.
  
  
Oversee the development of scalable, secure and production-ready software solutions.
  
  
2. Technology Strategy & AI Architecture
  
  
Define and execute the company's technology roadmap in alignment with business and commercial objectives.
  
  
Lead architectural decisions covering AI platforms, cloud infrastructure, data systems, APIs and enterprise integrations.
  
  
Evaluate emerging technologies and identify opportunities to strengthen the company's product capabilities and competitive positioning.
  
  
Ensure solutions are designed for performance, reliability, scalability, security and cost efficiency.
  
  
3. Engineering Leadership
  
  
Lead, mentor and develop engineering and AI teams.
  
  
Establish strong engineering practices, development standards and technical governance.
  
  
Drive technical innovation, product development and continuous improvement.
  
  
Guide engineering teams through the transition from prototypes and R&D into production deployment and commercial scale.
  
  
4. Investor Engagement & Executive Presentations
  
  
Represent the company in investor meetings, funding discussions and strategic presentations.
  
  
Confidently articulate the company's AI capabilities, technical architecture, product roadmap and competitive advantages.
  
  
Translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling business propositions.
  
  
Participate in investor pitches, demonstrating both technical credibility and commercial understanding.
  
  
Respond effectively to technical and strategic questions from investors, board members and senior stakeholders.
  
  
5. Enterprise Client Engagement & Commercial Development
  
  
Participate in strategic customer meetings, enterprise presentations and technology demonstrations.
  
  
Work closely with business leadership to support sales pitches, solution positioning and major commercial opportunities.
  
  
Understand client requirements and translate business challenges into practical AI-driven solutions.
  
  
Build relationships with technology partners, infrastructure providers, AI ecosystems and strategic stakeholders.
  
  
6. Security, Governance & Responsible AI
  
  
Ensure AI solutions comply with appropriate data security, model risk and governance requirements.
  
  
Oversee the deployment of solutions across private-cloud, air-gapped and sovereign environments.
  
  
Establish appropriate controls for third-party models, datasets, APIs and technology providers.
  
  
Requirements & Qualifications
  
  
At least 10 years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML development, technology leadership or related fields.
  
  
Proven experience in a senior technology leadership capacity, such as CTO, VP Engineering, Head of AI, Technical Director or equivalent.
  
  
Strong hands-on software development and coding experience, with the ability to understand, review and contribute to complex technical implementations.
  
  
Demonstrated expertise in modern AI technologies, including Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, machine learning and related architectures.
  
  
Proven track record of developing and delivering complex technology products from concept or prototype through production deployment.
  
  
Strong understanding of software architecture, cloud infrastructure, APIs, data engineering and enterprise technology environments.
  
  
Experience leading engineering teams and driving technical delivery.
  
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to present technical solutions to investors, C-suite executives and enterprise clients.
  
  
Demonstrated ability to pitch technology propositions, communicate business value and engage senior decision-makers.
  
  
Strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking and executive presence.
  
  
The Ideal Candidate
  
  
We are particularly interested in technology leaders who possess the following combination:
  
  
**Technically Hands-on:**  
Not purely a strategic or administrative CTO. Able to get into the code, understand the engineering challenges and drive technical execution.
  
  
**AI-Centric:**  
Strong practical understanding of modern AI technologies and the ability to turn AI capabilities into commercially deployable products.
  
  
**Investor-Facing:**  
Articulate, persuasive and confident when presenting technical solutions, pitching business propositions and engaging investors.
  
  
**Commercially Minded:**  
Understands how technology creates business value, supports revenue growth and strengthens market positioning.
  
  
**Executive Leader:**  
Able to lead engineering teams while representing the company credibly at the highest levels.
  
  
If you are a technology leader who can build, innovate, lead and confidently articulate a compelling AI vision to investors and enterprise customers, we would like to hear from you.
  
  
We are a Manpower, Recruitment and Employment Agency that provides reliable and tailored staffing solutions. We do our very best to ensure that our candidates are looked-after and given the opportunity to attain their career goals.

title: ICT Infrastructure - Windows
description:
We are seeking a hands-on
  
  
Windows ICT Infrastructure Engineer
  
  
to design, implement and support Windows server, VDI and Active Directory infrastructure for critical business applications. The role drives
  
  
operational efficiency through automation and AI-assisted engineering
  
  
, ensures compliance with the Authority's technical standards, security requirements and IT policies, and works closely with service providers, application teams and operations staff.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Windows Infrastructure Engineering
  
  
Design, implement and manage Windows infrastructure to meet availability, continuity, security and capacity requirements, translating business and application requirements into suitable solutions.
  
  
Provision, configure, and maintain Windows virtual machines and associated services within an OpenStack environment, encompassing capacity planning, lifecycle management, performance monitoring, and troubleshooting across the hardware and OS layers.
  
  
Utilise the OpenStack Horizon dashboard to deploy and manage instances, flavours, images, volumes, snapshots, networks, security groups, key pairs, and floating IPs, as well as to monitor resource quotas and usage.
  
  
Support architecture reviews, implementation planning, testing and operational readiness.
  
  
Act as the primary Windows technical point of contact for new initiatives, working with application teams, infrastructure teams and service providers to resolve issues and support production.
  
  
AI & Technical Automation
  
  
Develop, test and maintain PowerShell scripts, Ansible playbooks and runbooks to automate provisioning, configuration, Active Directory administration, hardening and health checks, log collection, reporting and remediation.
  
  
Convert manual procedures into controlled, repeatable automation with appropriate validation, logging, exception handling, security controls, rollback and version control.
  
  
Deploy and use AI tools for scripting, troubleshooting, log and event analysis and anomaly detection, ensuring outputs are technically validated before production use.
  
  
Continuously identify opportunities for AI and automation to improve reliability, troubleshooting effectiveness and operational efficiency.
  
  
VDI Infrastructure Support
  
  
Support the Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) platform and resolve incidents escalated from the Service Desk / Application teams.
  
  
Troubleshoot pools, session hosts, VDI integration issues with Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, certificates, virtualisation and storage.
  
  
Perform patching, capacity and user entitlement management, and monitor platform health, performance and user experience.
  
  
Perform root-cause analysis, escalate complex issues to vendors, and maintain operational procedures and knowledge base articles.
  
  
Active Directory Support
  
  
Troubleshoot authentication, authorisation, account lockout, Kerberos/NTLM, trust and domain join issues.
  
  
Resolve domain controller replication, AD-integrated DNS, Sites and Services, FSMO role and Group Policy issues, and create and maintain Group Policy Objects.
  
  
Manage OU structure, delegated administration, service accounts and privileged groups in line with security standards, and perform health assessments and backup/recovery verification.
  
  
Perform root-cause analysis, escalate complex issues to Microsoft, maintain documentation and guide Level 1 support teams.
  
  
Security, Governance & Operational Readiness
  
  
Ensure Windows infrastructure complies with the Authority's Technical Architecture, SG-TRM, IM8 and applicable IT policies, and remains secure, controlled and supportable throughout its lifecycle.
  
  
Ensure automation is tested, documented and implemented through established change-management processes.
  
  
Maintain technical documentation, procedures and runbooks, and support operational readiness and knowledge transfer to operations teams and service providers.
  
  
Skills and Qualifications Required
  
  
Education and Experience
  
  
Tertiary education in Computer Science, Information Technology or a relevant technical field is preferred.
  
  
Minimum 3–5 years' hands-on experience in Windows Server 2019/2022, Active Directory, virtualisation, SAN storage integration and Microsoft SQL Server.
  
  
Experience supporting VDI and Active Directory in an enterprise environment with high availability, security and governance requirements.
  
  
Technical Knowledge
  
  
Active Directory administration, backup and recovery, Group Policy, Sites and Services, migration and upgrade planning, and GCC Active Directory / Remote Desktop Services integration.
  
  
Utilize Ansible Automation Platform to patch servers and deploy software.
  
  
Windows authentication and authorisation mechanisms.
  
  
Windows Server roles (DNS, DHCP, SMTP, SFTP, Certificate Services), clustering and high-availability configurations.
  
  
Microsoft technologies including IIS and Microsoft Configuration Manager (MECM, formerly SCCM).
  
  
Security hardening, configuration management, patch management and compliance tools.
  
  
Monitoring tools such as Performance Monitor, structured troubleshooting and root-cause analysis of complex Windows Server and Active Directory issues.
  
  
Automation and AI
  
  
Strong PowerShell scripting, with demonstrated experience turning manual Windows operational processes into reliable, maintainable automation.
  
  
Proven experience using AI tools in Windows infrastructure operations, such as AI-assisted troubleshooting, scripting, analysis or anomaly detection.
  
  
Professional Skills
  
  
Strategic and analytical thinker, able to understand business needs and technical challenges and develop practical, comprehensive solutions.
  
  
Results and customer oriented, with a focus on service delivery excellence.
  
  
Team player with strong organisation and people-handling skills, able to work effectively with internal teams and external service providers.
  
  
Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to present technical solutions and influence stakeholders.
  
  
Preferred
  
  
Familiarity with AIOps and experience in infrastructure automation or configuration automation platforms.
  
  
Possession of relevant Microsoft role-based certifications, such as Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate or AWS / Azure Administrator Associate.
  
  
Exposure to the OpenStack Horizon dashboard and related tasks, including instance lifecycle, snapshot, resize instance and access management.

We are Singapore Head Quartered multinational company with offices in Singapore, Malaysia and India. Planning to expand to other South East Asia and US. We are Client business focused technology and consultancy services company which focuses mainly in on the below business towers:
  
  
1. Digital Transformation
  
  
2. Cloud enablement & migration
  
  
3. Cyber Security
  
  
4. Consultancy Services
  
  
1.
  
  
**Digital Transformation:**  
We provide end to end Digital Transformation through application development, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning and Internet of things to customers who want to keep pace with changing trends to achieve competitive edge of new generation business models. Even in this fast-moving 5G internet world we found some of the companies are stuck with their old practices of using excel and legacy applications to run their business. description:
We are partnering with a regional digital infrastructure and data centre platform in a search for a
  
  
Head of Procurement (Data Centre)
  
  
to set up and run a full-scope procurement function across its data centre portfolio, covering sourcing strategy, tender governance and vendor relationships across the region.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Shape procurement strategy, policy and process to keep sourcing across the portfolio compliant, cost-disciplined and responsive, defining the
  
  
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  
and reporting used to track performance against them.
  
  
Put in place the authority delegation, approval workflows and procurement controls needed to satisfy governance and audit standards.
  
  
Lead the end-to-end procurement and tender process, from requisition through bid evaluation, award recommendation and contract execution, validating approval notes and purchase requisitions before purchase orders are raised.
  
  
Set pre-qualification and vendor selection criteria with key stakeholders, then lead commercial negotiations on major construction, equipment and services packages, keeping tenders competitive, auditable and aligned to project timelines.
  
  
Work with project management consultants to track delivery timelines for long-lead equipment, liaise with Finance to secure tax exemptions on overseas shipments, and get ahead of potential supply chain or logistics disruptions.
  
  
Once a facility is operational, work with the Operations team to plan budgets, run the vendor selection and bidding process for
  
  
Operating Expenditure (OPEX)
  
  
spend, and coordinate with Finance on contract execution and payments.
  
  
Drive year-on-year cost efficiency by applying should-cost analysis, benchmarking and
  
  
Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
  
  
assessment across major spend categories, tracking savings realised against baseline.
  
  
Look for scope to standardise specifications, aggregate purchase volumes, and negotiate longer-term supply agreements that span multiple sites.
  
  
Cultivate strategic relationships with the key
  
  
Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs)
  
  
, contractors and service providers the business depends on, running regular business reviews that cover performance, risk and improvement actions.
  
  
Track supplier delivery, quality and performance outcomes against contractual
  
  
Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
  
  
.
  
  
Act as the procurement subject matter expert for live and pipeline data centre developments, working alongside operations, engineering, legal, finance, and design and construction teams to keep sourcing aligned with project goals.
  
  
Set up and maintain the e-Procurement system supporting requisition-to-pay processes, and keep spend visibility, pipeline tracking and reporting current enough for management decision-making.
  
  
Keep procurement practice aligned with regulatory,
  
  
Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG)
  
  
and internal control obligations in every market of operation, and manage supply chain exposure, including lead times on long-lead equipment.
  
  
Bring sustainability and environmentally responsible design principles into sourcing decisions and vendor evaluation.
  
  
Maintain and update procurement reporting, including monthly spend and contracts dashboards and a competency mapping report that tracks procurement skills against business goals.
  
  
Requirements
  
  
A bachelor's degree in supply chain management, engineering, business or a related discipline is required, with
  
  
Chartered Institute of Procurement and Supply (CIPS)
  
  
or equivalent certification preferred.
  
  
10 years or more of procurement experience end to end, at least 4 of those years spent leading a procurement function, ideally gained in data centre, infrastructure or construction settings.
  
  
A track record of running high-value tenders and negotiating major contracts across construction and
  
  
Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing (MEP)
  
  
equipment and related services.
  
  
**Practical, end-to-end ownership of the procurement cycle:** preparing and qualifying vendor lists, issuing and evaluating RFPs, analysing bid proposals, reviewing terms and conditions with Legal, and running objective vendor shortlisting through
  
  
Pre-Qualification (PQ)
  
  
,
  
  
Technical Bid Evaluation (TBE)
  
  
and
  
  
Commercial Bid Evaluation (CBE)
  
  
methods.
  
  
Experience building vendor pools and shortlisting general contractors, major equipment suppliers (including long-lead items) and quantity surveying or project management consultants, spanning both local and international markets.
  
  
Solid grasp of data centre construction methods, engineering industry standards and how project delivery works in this space.
  
  
Demonstrated success introducing procurement policy, process and governance where no mature function previously existed, partnering across finance, legal, operations, and design and construction teams.
  
  
Practical experience with e-Procurement or
  
  
Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
  
  
systems such as SAP, Oracle or Coupa would be an advantage.
  
  
Sharp commercial, negotiation and analytical skills, equally comfortable in the weeds and at the strategic level, with strong communication and decision-making across competing stakeholder interests.
  
  
Genuine integrity and trustworthiness, with a natural ability to bring others along and stay positive; comfortable navigating shifting priorities and ambiguity, with regional sourcing exposure across multiple Asian markets a plus.

Natasha Ngiam, natasha@onesevenc.com

title: Head, Corporate Services
description:
The Head, Corporate Services is a key member of AMP’s management team, contributing significantly to AMP’s leadership by shaping organisational priorities, strengtheningcross-functional collaboration and shared accountability, and fostering a cohesive and inclusive management culture across AMP and its entities.
  
  
The Head provides strategic leadership and oversight of AMP's corporate functions, including Corporate Communications, Branding, and Digital Marketing, Finance, Technology and Facilities Management, ensuring alignment with the organisation's mission, strategic priorities, and governance requirements.
  
  
The role drives organisational effectiveness through financial stewardship, technology enablement, operational excellence, brand management, and stakeholder communications. The Head is responsible for developing corporate capabilities, optimising resources, managing risks, and strengthening systems, processes, and infrastructure to support AMP's growth and long-term sustainability.
  
  
MAIN DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
  
  
1. Corporate Strategy, Governance and Organisational Excellence
  
  
a) Develop and implement corporate services strategies, plans, and frameworks to support AMP's mission, strategic priorities, and organisational objectives.
  
  
b) Lead the development and review of corporate policies, governance frameworks, and operating guidelines to strengthen organisational effectiveness, accountability, and compliance.
  
  
c) Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, service quality, and stakeholder experience across corporate functions.
  
  
d) Provide strategic advice and recommendations to Management on corporate services matters, emerging trends, risks, and organisational priorities.
  
  
2. Finance, Risk and Resource Stewardship
  
  
a) Provide oversight of financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation to ensure financial sustainability and prudent stewardship of organisational resources.
  
  
b) Lead the development and implementation of risk management, internal controls, and compliance frameworks to safeguard organisational assets and reputation.
  
  
c) Oversee financial governance, procurement, and funding utilisation to ensure compliance with regulatory, audit, and donor requirements.
  
  
d) Monitor organisational performance and resource utilisation to support informed decision-making and effective resource deployment.
  
  
3. Technology, Infrastructure and Business Continuity
  
  
a) Lead the development and execution of technology and digital transformation strategies to enhance organisational effectiveness, productivity, service delivery, and stakeholder experience.
  
  
b) Oversee the management of technology infrastructure, cybersecurity, enterprise systems, and digital platforms to support operational resilience, innovation, and organisational growth.
  
  
c) Drive the adoption of emerging technologies and digital solutions to improve business processes, data-driven decision-making, and operational efficiency.
  
  
d) Develop and oversee infrastructure strategies and asset management plans to ensure the organisation's facilities, systems, workplaces, and resources remain sustainable, scalable, and aligned with current and future operational needs.
  
  
e) Provide strategic oversight of facilities management, workplace operations, space planning, maintenance programmes, and vendor partnerships to ensure safe, efficient, and fit-for-purpose environments.
  
  
f) Lead infrastructure enhancement and workplace transformation initiatives to optimise resource utilisation, improve employee experience, and support organisational growth and service delivery.
  
  
g) Establish and maintain business continuity, disaster recovery, workplace safety, and crisis management frameworks to safeguard organisational operations, assets, and stakeholders.
  
  
4. Corporate Communications and Branding and Digital Marketing
  
  
a) Lead the development and execution of AMP's corporate communications, branding, and digital marketing strategies to strengthen organisational visibility, reputation, and stakeholder engagement.
  
  
b) Oversee brand governance and the consistent application of AMP's brand identity across all communication channels and platforms.
  
  
c) Direct strategic communications, media relations, public engagement, and digital outreach initiatives to support organisational objectives.
  
  
d) Monitor communication effectiveness and stakeholder sentiments to strengthen AMP's positioning and public profile.
  
  
5. Stakeholder Management
  
  
a) Build and maintain strategic relationships with government agencies, regulators, vendors, and other stakeholders to advance organisational objectives.
  
  
b) Lead workforce planning, talent development, and capability-building initiatives across corporate services functions in AMP Group to strengthen organisational performance.
  
  
c) Foster shared service collaboration across divisions and subsidiaries to ensure effective service delivery and alignment with organisational priorities.
  
  
d) Champion a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, service excellence, and accountability across corporate services functions.
  
  
6. Leadership and People Management
  
  
a) Provide leadership and direction to corporate services teams to achieve organisational goals and operational excellence.
  
  
b) Promote employee engagement, collaboration, and a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
  
  
c) Lead change management initiatives to support organisational transformation and strategic priorities.
  
  
7. Develop Organisational Capability for Service Delivery
  
  
a) Drive capability development strategies to strengthen the division's professional competencies, leadership bench strength, and service delivery capabilities.
  
  
b) Assess current and future workforce capability requirements and establish capability-building priorities to support the division's strategic objectives and evolving service needs.
  
  
c) Lead the development and implementation of learning, talent, and succession plans to ensure organisational readiness and sustainability.
  
  
d) Cultivate a high-performance and continuous learning culture that promotes professional excellence, innovation, and service effectiveness.
  
  
e) Strengthen leadership and management capabilities across the division to enhance organisational resilience, employee engagement, and operational performance.
  
  
f) Champion workforce planning and talent development initiatives to ensure the division is equipped with the skills and expertise required to meet current and future service demands.
  
  
SECONDARY DUTIES
  
  
a) Participate in inter-divisional project committees and render support to other department events as and when required.
  
  
REQUIREMENTS
  
  
Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Information Technology, Communications, Marketing, Facilities Management, Public Administration, or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
  
  
Minimum 10 years of progressive leadership experience in corporate services, shared services, operations, or a related function, with experience overseeing multiple corporate functions.
  
  
Proven track record in leading and managing corporate services portfolios, including Finance, Technology, Facilities Management, Corporate Communications, Branding, and Digital Marketing.
  
  
Experience in strategic planning, organisational governance, risk management, resource optimisation, and operational excellence.
  
  
Experience working with senior management, Boards, auditors, regulators, and external stakeholders.
  
  
Proven ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams, drive organisational performance, and build strategic partnerships.
