title: Account Director
description:
Req ID: 64773

Job Function: Sales and Commercial

Posting Start Date: 19/11/2026

Posting End Date: 30/11/2026

Division: BT International

Job Location: Marina One East Tower

Advertised Salary: Competitive

**About the role**
------------------

The role holder is responsible for driving substantial sales growth across strategic and high-potential customers in the South East Asia region. This includes both MNCs headquartered in Singapore (A-Ends) and inbound MNCs (B-Ends).

  

ASEAN is the world’s fifth-largest economy, and is on track to become the fourth-largest by 2030. Singapore sits at the heart of this growth, home to over 5,000 multinational corporations that use it as a base for their regional and global operations. These MNCs are undergoing rapid digital transformation - driven by rapid advancements in AI, infrastructure upgrades, and sustainability priorities - creating both disruption and opportunity for innovative solutions.

  

Against this backdrop, Singapore has been identified to be a Key Market for BT International, and is home to key strategic customers, as well as HiPo accounts, across industries such as BFSI, Manufacturing, FMCG.

  

The role holder will: (1) lead client engagement across existing strategic customers to retain and grow our Share of Wallet with the customer, and (2) lead the pursuit of acquisition customers. All activities will need to be strongly underpinned by BT International’s GTM Strategy and the associated sales initiatives (e.g. HiPo Program, Account Growth Plans, etc.).

  

Why join this role? Make your mark by opening new enterprise relationships in Singapore and turning customer transformation priorities into business wins. The opportunity combines prospecting, relationship-building and complex solution selling, with Secure Connectivity and Digital Workplace at the heart of the customer conversation. It is a role for someone who wants to create opportunities, shape the pursuit and see the deal through—not simply inherit a portfolio.

  

Success will be measured through incremental sales margin (ICGM), revenue growth, and other key metrics such as recurring revenue and profit, in line with the Financial Year Payplan Structure.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

This role is all about building and growing pipeline across the direct channel in Singapore, through a two-pronged approach:

  

**Existing Strategic Customers**

* Hunt for growth within existing accounts, driving year-on-year expansion through upsell and cross-sell opportunities aligned to BT’s Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) and HiPo criteria, with a sharp focus on Secure Connectivity and Digital Workplace.
* Deepen client engagement and build trusted relationships that deliver measurable satisfaction, reflected in strong NPS scores and Gartner Peer Insight reviews.
* Partner across teams and with external stakeholders to deliver winning, profitable outcomes for customers and BT.
* Take full ownership of your accounts in Salesforce - keeping data accurate, forecasts reliable, and visibility strong on Revenue and EBITDA.
* Shape and execute proactive account plans that unlock new opportunities, expand services, and strengthen BT’s footprint.
* Build influence across key networks and use innovative approaches to spark fresh conversations and introduce new services.
  

**Acquisition Customers**

* Hunt for new growth by identifying high-potential target accounts aligned to BT’s Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).
* Research prospects in depth to uncover their IT and business priorities, assess existing BT touchpoints and map the decision-making landscape. Qualify opportunities against a clear customer need, a credible sponsor, the funding path, the buying process and timing, and BT’s ability to compete and deliver.
* Proactively generate leads through partners, prospecting tools (e.g. Propensity Model, LinkedIn Sales Navigator), and outbound activity including email, social media, and calls.
* Engage customers to uncover their challenges and objectives, and position BT’s solutions in terms of clear business outcomes and value.
* Build and nurture long-term relationships with decision-makers, confidently handling objections and articulating compelling use cases.
* Develop targeted hunting plans that map out priority deals to pursue, the competitive landscape, key decision-maker contacts, and clear next actions.
* Own the end-to-end acquisition sales cycle - from lead generation through to deal closure.
  

Success in this role means consistently growing revenue and margin across both strategic and new acquisition accounts, while building a healthy, sustainable pipeline aligned to BT’s ICP and HiPo criteria. You’ll be recognised for strengthening BT’s position in the market by delivering value-led solutions, expanding our customer footprint, and forging trusted, long-term partnerships. Above all, success is about driving measurable outcomes for customers while achieving ambitious sales targets for BT.

**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Customer Obsession; Having the empathy and curiosity to understand see things from the customer’s point of view
* Hunter Mentality: A fearless attitude and grit to make things happen and uncover the customer’s unconsidered needs
* Tech Enthusiast: Keen interest in digital transformation and cybersecurity, with an aptitude to learn and convey complex technical concepts in an easy-to-understand manner
* Interpersonal Skills: Possesses strong communication and active listening skills to build rapport and trust with prospects. This includes verbal and written skills (e.g. storytelling, creative emails, etc.)
* Adaptability: Ability to adapt and iterate on the prospecting approach in a fast-paced high growth sales environment
* Growth Mindset; Open and willing to be coached and to learn from others and grow positively

**Desirable Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* Proven experience in relationship management and direct sales, ideally with a mix of strategic account management and new business acquisition.
* Prior experience in the Singapore region, with a strong understanding of regional market dynamics and enterprise customer landscapes.
* Proven experience in strategic thinking, influencing decisions, and shaping adoption of complex solutions.
* Proven ability to craft creative solutions to complex business challenges, including navigating cross-geography and cross-cultural environments.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth sales environment, demonstrating adaptability, resilience, and a results-driven mindset.

At BT International, our purpose is to keep the world connected. As part of BT, we build on almost 180 years of innovation and expertise to deliver secure connectivity and digital services to some of the world’s leading multinational businesses and organisations. Our customers trust us to safeguard their data, drive their digital transformation and keep their businesses running. With colleagues on the ground across the world and supporting customers wherever they need to operate, BT International offers a truly global experience. Whether it’s about providing cloud connectivity, helping organisations collaborate, or enabling innovation in cybersecurity and digital services, you’ll be part of a team that shapes how businesses succeed in a world that is being transformed by AI. If you have the drive and ambition to make an impact on a global stage, BT International is where it happens.

The successful candidate will bring a strong track record of leading complex enterprise technology transformation programs, managing executive-level client relationships, navigating challenging delivery environments, and driving successful outcomes at scale.

This role offers a unique opportunity to lead a significant global insurance transformation initiative and influence how a leading insurer modernizes its core policy, underwriting, and claims platforms.

* **Program Leadership & Delivery:** Provide overall strategic and operational leadership for a large-scale, complex, multi-year software implementation and transformation program spanning multiple countries, business units, and workstreams.

title: Director, Solution Consulting – AI Foundry
description:
**Company Description**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

 **Job Description**

**What you get to do in this role:**

The **Director, Solution Consulting - AI Foundry** will lead a forward-deployed technical team of AI engineers and solution architects responsible for turning complex customer problems into scalable AI solutions. The team will shape AI solution architecture, build rapid proofs of concept and pilots, and develop reusable accelerators that bring generative AI, LLMs, agents and workflow data together to deliver measurable business outcomes.

You will:

* Lead, coach and grow a high-performing team of AI Engineers and AI Solution Architects working directly with customers and internal teams on strategic AI opportunities.
* Guide the architecture and delivery of AI prototypes, proofs of concept and pilots.
* Translate complex business problems into practical AI solution architectures using LLMs, agentic AI, enterprise data, APIs and workflow automation.
* Drive the development of reusable AI patterns, accelerators and reference architectures that can scale across customers, industries and use cases.
* Partner closely with Sales, Pre-sales and Business Unit Stakeholders to co-develop AI use cases that accelerate platform adoption and customer value.
* Engage with senior technical and business stakeholders, from enterprise architects and engineering leaders through to CIO/CTO-level executives, to shape AI strategy and articulate value.
* Establish strong engineering and architecture practices around evaluation, security, governance, observability and responsible AI.
* Develop the team through coaching, hiring and talent planning while ensuring the right technical capabilities are deployed against the highest-impact opportunities.
* Actively participate in EBC as presenter and thought leader in the AI space.

  
**Qualifications**

**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 7+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales, solution architecture, engineering, professional services or forward-deployed technical teams.
* Strong practical experience designing and delivering generative AI solutions, including LLM-based applications, AI agents and enterprise AI architectures.
* Experience taking AI solutions from problem definition and rapid prototyping through PoC/pilot and toward production-scale deployment.
* Strong understanding of modern AI solution architecture, including RAG, agentic architectures, model/tool orchestration, APIs, data integration, evaluation and AI guardrails.
* Experience working with enterprise cloud and AI platforms and integrating AI capabilities into complex enterprise technology environments.
* Ability to translate ambiguous business problems into technical architectures and clearly connect AI capabilities to measurable customer and business outcomes.
* Strong executive communication skills with the ability to engage CIOs, CTOs, enterprise architects, technical leaders and business executives.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence across Product, Engineering, Sales, Solution Consulting and Customer Success organizations.
* Strong coaching and people leadership skills with the ability to attract, develop and retain senior engineering and architecture talent.
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving environment where the technology, customer requirements and solution patterns are continuously evolving.

  
**Additional Information**

**Work Personas**

title: Global Policy Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Policy development**

* Develops company positions and policy responses on international human rights and labour issues, including the EU Forced Labour Regulation and international due diligence and certification requirements.
* Analyses international trade barriers, tariffs and comprehensive economic partnership agreements (CEPAs), and the EU Deforestation Regulation as a market access issue, and recommends responses for the business.
* Monitors global carbon policy and standards, and briefs the Head of Policy & Advocacy on their implications.
* Researches and reports on policy positions published by peers, customers, standards bodies and industry associations, for benchmarking purposes.

**Stakeholder engagement**

* Builds and maintains working-level relationships with standards bodies, international organisations, Singapore government stakeholders, and NGOs and think tanks of interest to the company.

* Acts as the point of contact for policy requests from internal stakeholders in Singapore, including the trading business, and routes them to the right colleagues in Jakarta.
* Prepares talking points, presentations, briefing papers and position papers in support of the company's policy and advocacy needs.

**Reporting and documentation**

* Provides tactical counsel to the Head of Policy & Advocacy on international policy issues.
* Records meeting outcomes, tracks commitments made and received in external engagements, and follows them up.
* Contributes to consultation responses, submissions and other written outputs for external engagement.
* Delivers on special projects as assigned by the Head of Policy & Advocacy or the Global Impact Director.

**Staying informed**

* Builds and maintains a global trade and tariff policy repository focused on measures that affect the company's commodity trade, with traders as its main users.
* Establishes, implements and maintains an international policy tracking system covering the EU, the US, the ILO, the OECD and voluntary sustainability standards, read alongside the Indonesian coverage held in Jakarta.

推动并贯彻落实公司“精耕东南亚”发展战略，负责区域重点战略部署在新加坡市场的落地执行，确保业务发展方向与区域战略目标保持一致。

title: Assistant Director of Food & Beverage
description:
About Us
  
  
voco Orchard Singapore provide guests with the world-renowned voco™ experience from the moment they walk through its doors. Famed to be hotels to count on, yet different enough to be fun, voco hotels are unstuffy hotels where people feel comfortable to relax, and just get on with life. Hotels that stand out from the crowd, voco combines familiar comforts with the indulgences of a hotel, to create somewhere that’s dependable, but not vanilla. Somewhere premium, but with a laidback spirit. Somewhere reliable, but different.
  
  
Your Day to Day
  
  
voco Orchard Singapore is seeking a dynamic and passionate Assistant Director of Food and Beverage. You’ll manage food and beverage operations to ensuring quality service and standards are maintained to deliver a memorable guest experience. Always following government regulations concerning health, safety or other requirements.
  
  
Manage hotel food and beverage marketing programmes and participate in and maintain system-wide food and beverage marketing programmes and promotions
  
  
Keep an eye on competitor activity /industry innovation. Review and approve menu design and concepts with Executive Chef
  
  
Help prepare the hotel’s annual budget and the setting of departmental goals
  
  
Monitor budget and control expenses with a focus on food, beverage and labour costs
  
  
Drive promotions that deliver great dining experiences for guests at a good value
  
  
Manage everyday activity, plan and assign work ensuring you always have the right staffing numbers
  
  
Develop your team and improve their performance through coaching and feedback, and create performance and development goals for colleagues
  
  
Make sure all food and beverage equipment is in operational condition and regularly cleaned
  
  
Make sure all food and beverage facilities including banquet/convention spaces are clean and properly stocked to anticipated business volume.
  
  
Any other ad-hoc duties
  
  
What we need from you
  
  
Bachelor’s degree / higher education qualification in Hotel Management, culinary arts, or related field preferred
  
  
College and/or advanced training in food and beverage management
  
  
3 years of related experience, including supervisory experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  
  
Must speak local language
  
  
Alcohol awareness certification and/or food service permit or valid health/food handler card, as required by local law
  
  
What we offer
  
  
We’ll reward all your hard work with a great salary and benefits – great room discount and superb training.
  
  
Join us and you’ll become part of the global IHG family – and like all families, all our individual team members share some winning characteristics. As a team, we work better together – we trust and support each other, we do the right thing and we welcome different perspectives. You need to show us you care: that you notice the little things that make a difference to guests as well as always looking for ways to improve - visit www.http://careers.ihg.com to find out more about us.
  
  
**IHG is an equal opportunity employer:** Minorities / Females / Disabled / Veterans.
  
  
voco Orchard Singapore is the newest IHG hotel to open in Singapore, and the first voco hotel to open in Southeast Asia.
  
  
The name 'voco' derives from the Latin word for ‘to invite’ or ‘to come together’, and the very first thing you’ll notice at voco Orchard Singapore is the warmth of the welcome. Both informal and indulgent at the same time, our hotels each have their own character inspired by their location, and all feature playful, personal touches that guests remember long after check-out.
  
  
Our guests are the kind of people who know exactly what they want whether they’re travelling for work or pleasure and appreciate the time and space to really indulge and enjoy.
  
  
Located at the start of Orchard Road in Singapore, the hotel provides a stay in the heart of the city with exciting dining, shopping and entertainment options right on its doorstep. Comfortable guest rooms and suites offer city views and ample space to work or relax, and award-winning restaurants and MICE facilities enhance the experience.
  
  
Our warm intuitive voco hosts are ready to tailor-make incredible and memorable cosmopolitan experiences in the heart of Singapore, bringing to guests the best of dining and entertainment experiences.

description:
The job holder will be responsible for delivering high quality voyage management services. Responsible to supervise, guide and managing the performance of the Operators within his / her office, setting relevant objectives to achieve high performing culture within Operations.
  
  
The job holder will manage and supervise day to day operational activity within the relevant office/ area, working
  
  
always in close coordination with Chartering Teams and Regional Operations Director.
  
  
This activity includes all aspects of the Voyage Execution, including Trade and Voyage review, participation in Trade meetings as required.
  
  
The job holder will be responsible for ensuring proper operations of voyages according to company's Voyage Execution principles.
  
  
The job holder will ensure that the company’s policies and procedures are followed by all operational staff within his area of responsibility and implement any changes or addition as may be decided by Senior Management.
  
  
The jobholder will be responsible for supplier management within his area of activity, including all voyage related cost elements .He/ she will coordinate all supplier related activities as appropriate and necessary with the procurement department, whilst managing and coordinating any supplier management/ negotiation activities which may be undertaken by staff based in the local offices.
  
  
The job holder can be assigned operating responsibilities as required, example cover during vacation periods, spot trades etc. Some travel to attend port operations, vessels and supplier meetings will be required
  
  
The job holder will prepare reports, participate in seminars or other internal events, including crew training as may be necessary.
  
  
G2 Ocean is a joint venture of two of the world’s largest open hatch shipowning companies Gearbulk and Grieg Star. G2 Ocean is one of the world’s largest ship operators within the open hatch and dry bulk segment that operates a fleet of more than hundreds open hatch and conventional bulk vessels. Annually, we complete over 4000 port calls to more than 70 countries each year.
  
  
G2 Ocean has a global presence in 15 locations around the world and operates 32 trade routes on six continents. Our global presence enables the company to respond effectively to customer’s needs. The main commodities carried on G2 Ocean’s vessels include wood pulp and other forest products, aluminium, steels, granite, and industrial minerals as well as project cargoes.

title: Events & Experience Manager
description:
### **ABOUT WORLD TABLE TENNIS**

World Table Tennis is where the sport’s fiercest battles meet bold ideas and creative minds. WTT is powered by a global crew of innovators, storytellers, and game-changers, who bring energy, expertise, and imagination to everything they do.

We’re not your typical workplace; we’re the global engine behind a sport on the rise. So whether it’s staging iconic global events or redefining fan experiences, this is where bold ideas get built, and where every role has impact. At WTT, the arena simply hits different.

### **EVENTS & EXPERIENCE MANAGER**

The Events & Experience Manager will support the successful planning and delivery of WTT events, ensuring consistent operational standards and a high-quality experience for players, officials, spectators, partners and other stakeholders.

Working closely with the Heads of Events, Event Managers, Competition Managers, Event Organisers and relevant WTT departments, the position will coordinate event preparations, operational requirements, branding and event experience initiatives.

The role will also contribute to event bidding processes, the development of operational manuals and the continuous improvement of WTT events.

While reporting to one designated Head of Events, the position may support activities across the wider WTT event portfolio.

### **RESPONSIBILITIES**

##### **Event Planning & Coordination:**

* Support the planning, preparation and delivery of WTT events in accordance with WTT Event Manuals and operational standards.
* Coordinate event timelines, operational requirements and deliverables with Event Organisers and relevant WTT departments.
* Organise and participate in event planning meetings, maintain progress trackers and monitor key deadlines.
* Support event readiness assessments and follow up on outstanding operational requirements.
* Attend assigned events and provide onsite operational support, including issue resolution and escalation where required.

##### **Event Experience & Activation:**

* Support the development and implementation of a consistent, high-quality event experience across the WTT portfolio.
* Coordinate with Commercial, Creative Media & Engagement, Sport Presentation and other departments on event branding, presentation and activations.
* Support initiatives to enhance the experience of players, spectators, partners and other stakeholders.
* Identify creative opportunities to improve event engagement and strengthen the WTT brand.

##### **Event Organiser & Stakeholder Coordination:**

* Maintain effective communication with Event Organisers, host organisations, suppliers and relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor operational deliverables and ensure timely follow-up on outstanding requirements.
* Support site inspections, planning meetings and event evaluations.
* Assist Event Managers and Heads of Events in resolving operational and stakeholder-related matters.

##### **Event Bidding & Host Assessment:**

* Support the coordination of event bidding processes and host-city assessments.
* Assist in preparing and reviewing event proposals, operational requirements and supporting documentation.
* Monitor event-related administrative and financial obligations in coordination with relevant departments.
* Support the evaluation of potential host cities, venues and event organisers.

##### **Event Manuals & Operational Standards:**

* Contribute to the development and updating of WTT Event Manuals, operational guidelines, procedures and planning tools.
* Maintain accurate event documentation, progress reports and operational records.
* Support the standardisation of event planning and delivery processes.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency through new procedures, technologies and event management tools.

##### **Cross-Departmental Coordination & Reporting:**

* Work closely with WTT Events, Operations, Commercial, Creative Media & Engagement, Sport Presentation and other relevant departments.
* Ensure event requirements, timelines and operational information are communicated effectively.
* Provide regular progress updates, identify outstanding matters and escalate significant risks or delays.
* Support post-event evaluations and the implementation of lessons learned across the event portfolio.

### **REQUIREMENTS**

##### **Essentials:**

* Degree or equivalent qualification in Event Management, Sports Management, Business Administration or a related field.
* At least three years of relevant experience in sports event management, live events or international event delivery.
* Experience coordinating event delivery with event organisers, venues, suppliers and other stakeholders.
* Understanding of event operations, logistics, branding and stakeholder services.
* Strong organisational, administrative and project management skills, with the attention to detail needed to manage multiple projects, competing deadlines and changing priorities under pressure.
* Ability to communicate clearly, work collaboratively across cultures and take the initiative to resolve problems.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and event or project management tools.
* Willingness to travel internationally, work flexible hours during event periods and support different event functions as needed.

##### **Desirables:**

* Experience working in professional sport or delivering international sporting events.
* Experience delivering event activations or supporting host-city bids.
* Experience developing event manuals or operational procedures.
* Creativity and a commitment to improving the event experience for participants and stakeholders.

Purpose and Scope
  
  
Reporting to the Head, Safety, Risk & Compliance, you will ensure compliance with all HSSE laws and regulations and other HSSE requirements applicable to the Energy-from-Waste plant activities, products and services.

Provide day-to-day support to Operation & Maintenance (O&M) teams on Hazards & risks control issues and assessing process hazards and risks.
  
  
Manage the sustainability and/or support implementation of the following Process Safety elements for:
  
  
Process Hazard Analysis (PHA).
  
  
Management of Change (MOC).
  
  
Pre-Start-up Safety Review (PSSR).
  
  
Process Safety Performance Measurement and Analysis.
  
  
Compliance with relevant MOM Process Safety requirements.
  
  
Interface with various departments and related stakeholders to support key HSSE Programs (e.g. HSSE O&M Cross Inspection, 5S, GHSSE & MPM Monthly Reporting, PPE Inspection, etc.).
  
  
Interface with other departments to jointly deliver technical/education training & audits programs to the field to improve competencies and ensure compliances.
  
  
Liaise with authorities on Licenses, Permits, and Written Permissions applications & renewals processes, and also on emission reporting and emission exceedance management.
  
  
Contribute as part of cross-functional teams in the investigation and analysis of incidents / accidents in any company owned premises / asset; to identify root causes of problems and recommend and follow-up on corrective & preventive actions/solutions.
  
  
Conduct training for staff & contractors on HSSE matters & emergency response drills as well as implement promotional Programmes / activities where required to raise awareness / understanding of Staff & Contractors on new or changes in HSSE-related systems / procedures.
  
  
Conduct regular site HSSE inspections.
  
  
Conduct Monthly HSSE Committee Meeting.
  
  
Assist in the Annual Respirator Fit-Test.
  
  
Assist in Workplace Safety and Health (Medical Examinations) Regulations Exposure to Noise (Audiometric Test).
  
  
Conduct and Review Method Statement and Risk assessments.
  
  
Assist in Conduct noise monitoring in accordance with the Workplace Safety and Health Act (Chapter 354a), WSH (Noise) Regulations 2011 & Personal Dosimetry monitoring based on person in similar exposure group (SEG).
  
  
Assist in Conduct boundary noise monitoring in accordance with Environmental Protection & Management (Boundary Noise Limits for Factory Premises) Regulations , Environmental Protection and Management Act (in compliance to NEA requirements).
  
  
Assist in Industrial Hygiene monitoring based on WSHA (General Provisions) Regulations : Permissible Exposure Limits of Toxic Substances ( Personal and Static test).
  
  
Assist in Indoor Air Quality Assessment (Instantaneous measurement in accordance to SS554:2009).
  
  
Qualification, Skills and Experience
  
  
Related industry experience with an Engineering degree or diploma, preferably in Chemical/ Environmental / Process or Risk engineering.
  
  
Registered Workplace Safety and Health Officer with MOM.
  
  
Registered Fire Safety Manager with Singapore Civil Defence Force.
  
  
Minimum 7 years of industrial experience in the relevant process industries.
  
  
ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and ISO 45001 internal auditor trained.
  
  
Strong knowledge of Singapore HSSE related regulatory requirements preferred.
  
  
Meeting standard industrial practices, Codes/Standards, and Insurance Guidelines
  
  
Experience in process safety and manufacturing is desired.
  
  
Able to communicate at all levels and firm in decision.
  
  
Able to work under pressure & tight deadlines.
  
  
Able to self-motivate and encourage cohesive work team.

title: Strategic Partnerships Manager [CCP for ICT Professionals]
description:
Business Development Manager – AI Finance & Technology Partnerships
  
  
**Company:** VibeBooks / Singapore employing entity
  
  
**Location:** Singapore
  
  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, Permanent
  
  
**Department:** Business Development & Strategic Partnerships
  
  
**Reports To:** Head of Business / Founder
  
  
About VibeBooks
  
  
VibeBooks is an AI-powered finance platform that helps businesses and accounting firms transform how their financial operations are managed.
  
  
Unlike traditional accounting software, VibeBooks combines accounting, document processing, reconciliation, payments, receivables management and financial analysis with intelligent AI agents capable of executing workflows, applying business rules and continuously improving operational processes.
  
  
Our mission is to make sophisticated finance capabilities accessible to businesses of all sizes while enabling accounting firms to serve more clients efficiently through automation.
  
  
As we expand our presence in Singapore and international markets, we are building a partnership ecosystem comprising accounting practices, professional services firms, technology providers and business platforms.
  
  
About the Role
  
  
We are seeking a Business Development Manager to develop and scale VibeBooks' business and technology partnership ecosystem.
  
  
The successful candidate will identify new commercial opportunities, establish strategic relationships with accounting and professional services organisations, and support the adoption of AI-powered finance solutions among businesses.
  
  
This role combines commercial relationship development with consultative technology sales, digital transformation advisory and partner enablement.
  
  
The position offers an opportunity for a professional from a commercial, client services or relationship-management background to transition into the rapidly growing field of AI-enabled financial technology through structured training and practical experience.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1. Strategic Partnership Development
  
  
Identify, engage and develop partnerships with accounting firms, corporate service providers, business consultants and professional networks.
  
  
Establish referral, reseller and solution partnerships to expand VibeBooks' market reach.
  
  
Develop partner engagement proposals, commercial models and joint go-to-market initiatives.
  
  
Maintain relationships with partners and support their long-term growth and success.
  
  
2. B2B Technology Business Development
  
  
Identify business opportunities for VibeBooks' AI-powered finance and accounting platform.
  
  
Conduct discovery meetings to understand prospective partners' finance operations, business processes and digitalisation requirements.
  
  
Present VibeBooks' capabilities through product demonstrations, solution proposals and commercial discussions.
  
  
Manage business opportunities throughout the sales cycle, from prospect identification through onboarding.
  
  
3. AI and Digital Transformation Solutions
  
  
Develop an understanding of AI agents, financial workflow automation, accounting processes and SaaS technologies.
  
  
Work with internal product and technical teams to translate business requirements into appropriate VibeBooks solutions.
  
  
Identify opportunities to automate manual finance processes through intelligent document processing, reconciliation, workflow automation and AI-assisted financial operations.
  
  
Support discussions with technology and enterprise partners regarding integration requirements, APIs and connected financial systems.
  
  
4. Partner Enablement and Adoption
  
  
Develop onboarding and enablement programmes for new accounting-firm and technology partners.
  
  
Coordinate product training, demonstrations and pilot implementations.
  
  
Gather partner feedback and collaborate with product teams to improve platform capabilities and user experience.
  
  
Monitor partner engagement, product adoption and commercial performance.
  
  
5. Commercial Growth and Market Development
  
  
Develop sector-specific go-to-market initiatives targeting accounting practices, SMEs and professional services organisations.
  
  
Build and manage a structured sales pipeline using CRM tools and data-driven reporting.
  
  
Analyse partner conversion, product adoption, sales performance and commercial opportunities.
  
  
Support joint marketing initiatives, industry engagement and educational workshops that promote the adoption of AI-enabled finance technology.
  
  
Candidate Requirements
  
  
Degree or diploma in business, marketing, hospitality, communications or a related discipline.
  
  
Experience in business development, commercial partnerships, account management, client services or stakeholder engagement.
  
  
Strong interpersonal, presentation, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
  
  
Ability to understand business challenges and communicate solutions clearly.
  
  
Strong organisational skills, commercial awareness and willingness to learn.
  
  
Interest in emerging technologies, artificial intelligence, financial technology and business process digitalisation.
  
  
Prior experience in accounting, financial software or enterprise SaaS is not required. The successful candidate will undergo structured training to develop the domain knowledge and technical-commercial competencies required for the role.
  
  
Training and Professional Development
  
  
The successful candidate will undergo a structured training and mentoring programme covering:
  
  
AI-powered finance platforms and digital accounting operations.
  
  
Financial technology, SaaS business models and consultative B2B technology sales.
  
  
Accounting workflows, financial controls and business process automation.
  
  
Product demonstrations, solution discovery and technical-commercial proposals.
  
  
Strategic partner development, channel management and partner enablement.
  
  
CRM systems, pipeline analytics and data-driven commercial decision-making.
  
  
Technology integrations, APIs and enterprise solution requirements.
  
  
Training will comprise supervised on-the-job learning, practical assignments, product workshops and mentorship from experienced business and technical team members.
  
  
Expected Outcomes
  
  
On successful completion of the training programme, the employee should be able to:
  
  
Independently engage accounting firms and business partners regarding AI-enabled financial technology solutions.
  
  
Conduct structured discovery meetings and recommend appropriate VibeBooks capabilities.
  
  
Manage partner development and commercial opportunities using digital sales tools.
  
  
Coordinate partner onboarding and product adoption.
  
  
Contribute to the growth of VibeBooks' accounting-firm and technology distribution ecosystem.
  
  
Career Development
  
  
This position provides a pathway into specialist technology business development and strategic partnerships, with opportunities to progress into senior responsibilities in channel partnerships, enterprise solutions and regional business development.
  
  
Counto is a firm building the next generation of AI powered accounting services. We are on a mission to create a fully virtual AI accountant.

title: QUANTITY SURVEYOR
description:
Overview
  
  
As a Quantity Surveyor, you will be responsible to perform all the required job responsibilities as stated below. You are to assist the Senior Quantity Surveyor (SQS) to ensure that all Quantity Surveying processes and procedures are in compliance to the Company’s standard and requirements.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
A)
  
  
Tendering Process
  
  
1) Monitor and update all tender invitations for precast work in the list of daily tender enquiries and summary tender enquiries.
  
  
2) Responsible to send all the tender drawings and document (including amendments) into the tender folders for tender teams’ action.
  
  
3) Review, study and check through the requirement of the tenders and list down the necessary project information which require for management’s decision in accepting / rejecting the tender invitations.
  
  
4) Highlight and list down deviations or special requirements during tender stage and clarify with Main Contractors, if necessary.
  
  
5) Quantity take-off for all the tenders, in the form of manual measurement or by mean of software and update the amendment changes of the tender.
  
  
6) Assist in preparation of Bill of Quantities (BQ) for SQS to do build-up costing of the precast work.
  
  
7) Discuss with SQS and arrange for meetings (if necessary), to get in-depth project information or details required for built-up costing.
  
  
8) During tender stages, sourcing of quotation for rates or technical data or cast-in materials, moulds or other special items are required due to every project’s requirement varies.
  
  
9) Review and evaluate technical / cost data of the products upon receipt of such quotations (as mentioned in item no.: 12), highlight any special issues or points to SQS for her knowledge so that built-up cost can be prepared with more accuracy.
  
  
10) Assist in preparation and submission of tender quotations and ensure timeline are met for every tender.
  
  
11) Prepare Tender Analysis upon every tender submission for management’s information and review.
  
  
12) Monitor, follow-up and update SQS for any post-tender queries / meetings require from the Main Contractors / clients and ask for SQS’s direction.
  
  
13) Responsible of the regular updates on Tender Results (awarded main contractors for projects) so that the Business Development Department can follow up for business opportunities.
  
  
14) Upon award of the project compile up the necessary project and cost data and organize a kick-off meeting with various Head of Departments to brief on project schedule, procurement planning and delivery schedule.
  
  
B)
  
  
Project Operation
  
  
1) Assist in preparation of project budget for management’s approval upon project award.
  
  
2) Sourcing of pricings for materials or subcontract work and prepare cost comparison for pricing analysis purposes and discuss with management.
  
  
3) Evaluate technical / commercial submission of Subcontractors and vendors whenever necessary.
  
  
4) Arrange and carry out tender interview, negotiate of price with suppliers and subcontractors including of preparation of sub-contract agreement / letter of award.
  
  
5) Prepare and respond to all subcontractors or suppliers’ progress claims. Evaluate, certify and issue Payment Response to subcontractors within the monthly time frame as set out in Security of Payments Acts (SOP).
  
  
6) Responsible to all Project’s monthly progress claim submission to the customers.
  
  
7) Project administration and documentation including closing of final accounts with the subcontractors / suppliers and clients.
  
  
8) Ensure customers’ requirement are determined and met, thus enhance customer satisfaction.
  
  
9) Perform any other duties as assigned by the Management and the designated manager.
  
  
Requirements
  
  
1) Minimum Diploma in Civil Engineering / Building / Quantity Surveying or equivalent.
  
  
2) Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience in precast concrete / construction industry.
  
  
3) Proficient in MS Office and other Measurement Software.
  
  
4) Possess good problem analytical and problem-solving skills.
  
  
5) Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  
  
6) Able to adopt and work in a fast-pace environment.
  
  
7) Possess teamwork spirit to work with other quantity surveyors and purchasers to accomplish the task.
  
  
8) Possess positive working attitudes and sociable with colleagues.
  
  
9) Show independency ability to multi-task, prioritize and organize tasks
  
  
Incorporated in 2013, Bathsystem Singapore (BSS) leveraged on our Principle Solution Provider Bathsystem Italy’s technical expertise and their over 30 years’ of experience in PBU solutions to achieve Singapore construction industry’s long term vision.
  
  
With the trust of our valued customers, we have completed more than 11,000 PBUs in Singapore. We thank all our valued customers for the trust and confidence in our high-quality products!

title: Assistant/Deputy Director, Operational Risk & Assurance (Corporate Services)
description:
At Singapore Children's Society, we are committed to improving the well-being of children, youth and families through services that are responsive, evidence-informed and focused on lasting impact. Strong operational governance helps ensure that our centres and departments translate approved policies, procedures, licensing requirements and risk controls into consistent day-to-day practice.
  
  
The Operational Risk & Assurance function provides independent operational assurance across the Society. If you can combine sound judgement, constructive challenge and disciplined follow-through to strengthen compliance, controls and continuous improvement, we invite you to join us.
  
  
Work Objectives
  
  
Lead the Society’s operational assurance programme, distinct from the Internal Audit programme, to assess whether centres and departments implement approved policies, SOPs, licensing requirements and risk controls effectively and consistently. Establish proportionate disciplines for operational reviews, licensing readiness, SOP governance, RAMS and control-effectiveness testing, continuous-improvement actions and Plan-Act-Track monitoring. Provide objective implementation findings and closure validation while preserving the accountability of Centre Heads, Department Heads and process owners for operations and remediation.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  
1. Operational Assurance Strategy and Review Programme
  
  
Develop and maintain a risk-based annual operational assurance plan that is distinct from, and coordinated with, the Internal Audit programme.
  
  
Conduct centre and department operational assurance reviews focused on implementation of approved requirements and operating effectiveness of controls.
  
  
Define proportionate review criteria, evidence requirements, sampling approaches and operational reporting formats.
  
  
Issue evidence-based operational findings and recommendations, and escalate significant, recurring or systemic implementation gaps.
  
  
Avoid duplicating Internal Audit engagements; where an issue falls within an approved audit scope, coordinate the review boundary with AD, Compliance.
  
  
2. Licensing and Operational Regulatory Readiness
  
  
Lead readiness assessments for operational and service licensing requirements and coordinate evidence verification with accountable owners.
  
  
Maintain visibility of readiness milestones, evidence status, dependencies and identified implementation gaps.
  
  
Conduct gap analyses and challenge the adequacy of corrective actions before inspections, renewals or submissions.
  
  
Report material operational-readiness risks and overdue actions through the appropriate management or governance channel.
  
  
Do not assume ownership of corporate statutory submissions retained by AD, Compliance or the relevant corporate owner.
  
  
3. SOP Governance and Standardisation
  
  
Establish and maintain an organisation-wide SOP governance framework covering ownership, approval, version control, review cycles and retirement.
  
  
Oversee the central SOP repository and standardise SOP structures, templates, naming conventions and minimum control requirements.
  
  
Advise teams on translating approved policies and regulatory requirements into clear, practical and auditable procedures.
  
  
Monitor overdue SOP reviews, ownership gaps and exceptions; Centre Heads and Department Heads retain ownership of operational content and implementation.
  
  
Coordinate with AD, Compliance where an SOP issue requires a change to an organisation-level policy or governance requirement.
  
  
4. Operational Risk-Control Assurance
  
  
Provide assurance oversight of RAMS and related operational risk-control documentation.
  
  
Review and test the design, documentation, implementation and operating effectiveness of key operational controls.
  
  
Distinguish control-design gaps from implementation failures, incomplete evidence and ineffective remediation.
  
  
Provide practical recommendations while preserving management ownership of the control and corrective action.
  
  
Escalate material control failures or recurring weaknesses to the appropriate management or governance forum.
  
  
5. Remediation, Continuous Improvement and Plan-Act-Track
  
  
Administer the Plan-Act-Track framework for assigned Internal Audit, operational review, After Action Review, Service Improvement Plan, corrective and preventive actions.
  
  
Maintain visibility of action owners, target dates, dependencies, status and required closure evidence.
  
  
Review evidence and validate whether remediation has been implemented and is operating as intended rather than relying solely on task completion.
  
  
Recommend closure, reopening or escalation; Compliance retains the master Internal Audit status and formal ARC reporting for audit findings.
  
  
Analyse recurring issues and lessons learnt to support prevention, standardisation and sustainable improvement.
  
  
6. Reporting, Partnership and Capability Building
  
  
Provide decision-ready operational reporting on assurance coverage, licensing readiness, SOP governance, control effectiveness and overdue actions.
  
  
Work with AD, Compliance, Centre Heads, Department Heads, Facilities, Safety and Health, IT, Data Protection, Finance, HR and other control owners.
  
  
Maintain independence of operational assurance judgement while engaging teams constructively and respecting management accountability.
  
  
Develop practical tools, templates, checklists and guidance for consistent assurance work and evidence standards.
  
  
Lead assigned staff or project resources and build organisational capability in root-cause analysis, controls and sustainable action closure.
  
  
Job Requirements
  
  
Qualifications and Experience
  
  
Bachelor’s degree in Risk Management, Business Administration, Accountancy, Quality Management, Public Administration, Social Sciences or a related discipline.
  
  
At least eight to ten years of relevant experience in operational assurance, quality assurance, compliance, risk management, internal controls or a related governance function.
  
  
Experience planning operational reviews, evaluating evidence, testing control design and operating effectiveness, and following remediation through to validated closure.
  
  
Experience with licensing readiness, SOP governance, corrective/preventive action tracking and multi-site or centre-based operations.
  
  
Relevant professional certification in risk, audit, quality, business continuity, workplace safety and health, process improvement or project management is advantageous.
  
  
Skills and Attributes
  
  
Strong operational risk, internal-control and compliance knowledge, with the ability to translate requirements into practical review criteria.
  
  
Strong assurance and analytical capability in scoping, sampling, evidence evaluation, root-cause analysis, control testing and closure validation.
  
  
Excellent report-writing, facilitation and stakeholder-engagement skills, including constructive challenge.
  
  
Independent, objective, pragmatic and proportionate, with disciplined follow-through and respect for management ownership.
  
  
Competence in Microsoft 365, Copilot and relevant registers, dashboards, repositories and workflow tools used for assurance monitoring.
  
  
About Singapore Children’s Society
  
  
Singapore Children’s Society protects and nurtures children and youth of all races and religions. In 2025, the Society reached out to 22,333 children, youth and families in need. Established in 1952, its services have evolved to meet the changing needs of children.
  
  
Today, Children’s Society operates more than 10 service centres islandwide, offering services in the four categories of: Vulnerable Children and Youth, Children and Youth Services, Family Services, and Research and Advocacy.
  
  
Our Patron-in-Chief is President Tharman Shanmugaratnam.
  
  
Our
  
  
Mission
  
  
We champion the wellbeing of children and youth by shifting mindsets and creating lasting change
  
  
Our
  
  
Vision
  
  
A future where every child and youth enjoys a safe and happy childhood and flourishes in strong families and caring communities
  
  
Our
  
  
Core Values
  
  
Compassion and Caring, Commitment, Professionalism, Integrity, and Openness to Change
  
  
For more information, please you can also watch our latest corporate video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UW\_xE\_3y-nY

title: Dry Bulk Vessel Operator

title: HR Executive / Senior Executive, Human Resources & Office Projects
description:
The HR Executive / Senior Executive, Human Resources & Office Projects is an organised, hands-on role that combines office relocation and renovation project management with HR generalist responsibilities.
  
  
During the initial three months, or longer depending on project requirements, the incumbent will focus primarily on coordinating SEC's office relocation and renovation, ensuring that agreed timelines, budgets and operational requirements are met with minimal disruption to staff.
  
  
Upon completion of the project, the role will transition primarily to HR generalist responsibilities, including talent acquisition, payroll, statutory submissions, employee onboarding and offboarding, HR administration, staff engagement, and learning and development.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
1.
  
  
Office Relocation & Renovation Project Management
  
  
Coordinate the office relocation and renovation project from planning through completion, ensuring agreed timelines, budgets and operational requirements are met.
  
  
Develop and maintain project schedules, action trackers, budgets and progress updates for management.
  
  
Gather requirements from internal stakeholders and coordinate office layout, workspace and facility needs.
  
  
Obtain and evaluate quotations, coordinate vendor selection, and monitor the performance of contractors, movers and other service providers.
  
  
Liaise with building management, contractors and relevant stakeholders on renovation arrangements, access requirements and necessary approvals.
  
  
Coordinate with IT support on the relocation and setup of network connectivity, equipment and related infrastructure.
  
  
Organise furniture and equipment procurement, asset inventories, packing, moving, disposal and reinstatement activities where required.
  
  
Communicate relocation plans and arrangements to employees, addressing practical concerns and minimising disruption to operations.
  
  
Track project risks, outstanding defects and follow-up actions, and coordinate inspections and final handover.
  
  
Maintain complete project records, including quotations, approvals, contracts, invoices and handover documents.
  
  
2.
  
  
Talent Acquisition & Employee Lifecycle
  
  
Coordinate recruitment activities, including job advertisements, candidate sourcing and screening, interview arrangements and reference checks.
  
  
Prepare employment offers, contracts and related documentation.
  
  
Manage onboarding arrangements, employee records, orientation and coordination with relevant departments.
  
  
Track probation and confirmation timelines and follow up with reporting managers.
  
  
Coordinate offboarding, including resignation documentation, clearance, exit interviews and final payroll inputs.
  
  
Administer work pass applications, renewals and cancellations where applicable.
  
  
3.
  
  
Payroll& Statutory Administration
  
  
Prepare and process monthly payroll accurately and on time, including salary changes, allowances, deductions, leave adjustments and final payments.
  
  
Administer CPF submissions and applicable IRAS employment income reporting and tax clearance filings.
  
  
Maintain payroll records and reconcile payroll information with Finance and relevant service providers.
  
  
Administer employee benefits, leave, claims and insurance matters.
  
  
Respond to employee enquiries on payroll, benefits and HR procedures, escalating complex matters to the Head of HR.
  
  
4.
  
  
HR Operations & Administration
  
  

* Maintain accurate employee records, HR systems and personnel documentation while safeguarding confidentiality.
* Prepare employment letters, HR reports and other employee-related correspondence.
* Support the implementation and review of HR policies, procedures and workflows.
* Coordinate performance appraisal exercises and maintain the relevant records.
* Support HR audits, statutory reporting and documentation requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve HR processes and administrative efficiency.

5.
  
  
Staff Engagement and Learning & Development
  
  

* Coordinate staff engagement initiatives, employee surveys, team activities and organisational events.
* Support follow-up actions arising from employee feedback and engagement activities.
* Coordinate training needs identification, course registrations, training schedules and logistics.
* Maintain training records, budgets and evaluation reports, and administer applicable funding claims.
* Support employee development initiatives and monitorthe completion of planned training.

6.
  
  
Other Responsibilities
  
  
Undertake other HR, office administration and organisational projects, and any ad hoc duties assigned by the Head of HR.
  
  
Requirements
  
  
Degree or diploma in Human Resources or related field
  
  
3–5 years of relevant HR experience

Strong interpersonal, communication, organisational and negotiation skills
  
  
Proficient in MS Office and HR systems (Times Soft)

title: LNG Originator
description:

The LNG Originator will identify and develop mid- to long-term LNG sourcing and business opportunities, supporting the company's LNG portfolio development and trading strategies.
  
  
The role involves evaluating market opportunities, developing relationships with LNG buyers and suppliers, and supporting the structuring, negotiation, and execution of LNG transactions, including Key Terms, Heads of Agreement (HOA), and Sale and Purchase Agreements (SPA).

Develop and maintain commercial relationships with LNG producers, buyers, traders, and other market participants
  
  
Screen potential counterparties and evaluate LNG project developments and commercial opportunities
  
  
Support the development and execution of LNG sourcing and portfolio strategies
  
  
Coordinate with Korean-speaking stakeholders at the company's headquarters on LNG sourcing strategies, commercial negotiations, and contract execution.
  
  
Commercial Negotiation & Contracting

Evaluate commercial terms, including pricing structures, volume commitments, delivery terms, and contractual flexibility
  
  
Coordinate with internal teams and external counterparties throughout the transaction process
  
  
Support the execution and ongoing commercial management of LNG agreements
  
  
Market Analysis & Portfolio Optimization
  
  
Analyze mid- to long-term LNG market trends, supply-demand fundamentals, and pricing developments
  
  
Identify structured transaction and portfolio optimization opportunities
  
  
Evaluate commercial risks and opportunities associated with LNG sourcing, trading, and shipping arrangements
  
  
Prepare business proposals, market intelligence reports, and commercial analyses for management
  
  
Stakeholder & Counterparty Management

Support ongoing relationships and commercial discussions with existing counterparties
  
  
3. Requirements
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
  
Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in LNG-related commercial operations, trading, origination, or business development

Experience in LNG commercial activities, contract negotiation, contract management, or transaction support

Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  
Experience in negotiating or supporting LNG Key Terms, HOA, SPA, or other commercial agreements
  
  
Experience in long-term LNG sourcing, structured transactions, or portfolio optimization
  
  
Familiarity with Asian LNG markets, including suppliers, buyers, and major LNG projects
  
  
Bachelor's degree or higher in energy, economics, finance, business, engineering, or a related field

The company is primarily engaged in LNG sourcing, trading, and value chain development, securing stable supply channels and optimizing portfolio competitiveness. Through active participation in global LNG markets, PRISM ENERGY International supports SK E&S’s vision of becoming a top-tier LNG player.

title: Senior Manager, Chartering & Business Development
description:
Angle is supporting an established ship operator to hire a Senior Chartering Manager. This person will build and lead the long-term time charter book. This role offers a path to grow into more senior leadership roles as the business develops.
  
  
You’ll originate and develop relationships with cargo owners and charterers, long-term time charters, this will be your predominant focus. Grow a stable cargo base that supports geared and gearless fleet. Alongside the longer-term development work, you’ll also run profitable day-to-day chartering, matching cargoes and vessels, negotiating fixtures, and taking controlled positions on third-party tonnage within approved limits.
  
  
This is an individual contributor role reporting to the Head of Drybulk. You’ll work closely with Operations, Finance, Risk and Post Fixture internally, and with shipowners, charterers, brokers and agents externally. Success will be measured by the pipeline of strategic accounts and long-term opportunities you build, the COAs and long-term contracts you convert, and the commercial returns you deliver. Those who perform will have the opportunity to step into broader leadership responsibilities as the platform grows.
  
  
What you bring
  
  
Significant drybulk chartering experience, ideally across more than one side of the market.
  
  
A proven record of winning new business, particularly COAs or long-term time charters

Benefit from MUFG’s commitment to professional development, working opportunities, and a supportive team environment that values collaboration and knowledge sharing.
  
  
**What you'll do:**  
As an Internal Control professional at MUFG in Singapore, you will take on a multifaceted role spanning internal controls, governance, operational resilience and management support. Working closely with various departments, you will help ensure that GCIB maintains effective controls, appropriate governance standards and accurate control-related records.
  
  
Your responsibilities will include coordinating GCIB self-inspections, managing SOX reporting processes, tracking remediation actions and following up on findings through to closure. You will also coordinate business continuity management activities, including disaster recovery exercises, and maintain critical records such as call trees and next-of-kin information.
  
  
In addition to overseeing and driving greater consistency in SOPs and governance documentation on SharePoint, you will support non-system information security controls to help ensure appropriate standards for information handling are maintained. You will also monitor incidents and support timely escalation and reporting where required.
  
  
Your responsibilities will extend to vault governance, including record reconciliation and periodic access reviews, as well as the maintenance of authorities-related documentation, including Letters of Delegation of Authority, Deeds of Substitution and authorised signature lists.
  
  
You will also provide ad-hoc administrative and management support to help ensure the smooth running of the department. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, sound control awareness and the ability to work effectively across multiple stakeholders, while remaining flexible and adaptable to changing business priorities.
  
  

* Perform and coordinate GCIB self-inspection processes, SOX reporting and spreadsheet controls, including the management of findings, supporting evidence, remediation tracking and follow-up actions.
* Oversee and drive greater consistency in standard operating procedures (SOPs), RACI matrices and internal guidelines, and maintain related governance documentation on GCIB SharePoint.
* Perform and coordinate business continuity management activities, including business impact analysis, call tree and next-of-kin record maintenance, disaster recovery exercises and other related activities.
* Serve as PIC for non-system information security controls, including data-handling requirements and information security exceptions, in accordance with Bank policies.
* Serve as PIC for incident monitoring and reporting, ensuring timely escalation, communication and accurate documentation of events affecting divisional operations.
* Manage GCIB Vault governance, including regular record reconciliation, access reviews and implementation of relevant controls to safeguard sensitive materials.

* Provide administrative and management support as assigned by the Head of Department or Management, including ad-hoc responsibilities that contribute to the effective operation of the team.
* Collaborate with relevant departments and stakeholders to support the timely and accurate implementation of internal requirements, Head Office procedures and Bank policies.
* Maintain robust control-related records and procedures and support effective governance across GCIB functions.

**What you bring:**  
To excel as an Internal Control professional at MUFG in Singapore, you bring proven experience from roles involving internal control or audit functions, ideally within financial services. Your academic background equips you with essential theoretical understanding while your practical experience ensures you can navigate complex regulatory environments confidently. You possess exceptional attention to detail which allows you not only to spot inconsistencies but also deliver high-quality results every time. Managing competing priorities under tight deadlines is second nature; you remain calm yet responsive even when demands escalate. Communication is one of your strengths—you engage openly with colleagues at all levels fostering trustful relationships that drive collective achievement. Professionalism defines how you handle sensitive matters; integrity guides every decision you make. Your proactive attitude means you anticipate needs before they arise while collaborating seamlessly within teams regardless of pace or change. Technical proficiency across Microsoft tools supports your daily workflow; familiarity with business continuity practices further enhances your contribution during emergencies or disruptions. Ultimately your blend of analytical skills, interpersonal abilities, industry knowledge and unwavering commitment, makes you an invaluable asset for this role.
  
  
Degree qualification is required for this position
  
  
**For Associate:** a minimum of five years’ experience in internal control, audit (internal or external), risk management, compliance or governance roles, preferably within a financial institution is essential for success.
  
  
Your strong attention to detail enables you to critically review information, identify gaps promptly, and deliver accurate outputs consistently.
  
  
The ability to manage multiple priorities under strict timelines demonstrates your organisational skills and commitment to dependable follow-through.
  
  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills allow you to work confidently with management as well as stakeholders across departments and locations.
  
  
Professionalism, integrity, and discretion are vital when handling confidential or sensitive information within the organisation.
  
  
A proactive approach combined with collaborative teamwork ensures you adapt comfortably in fast-paced environments while supporting colleagues effectively.
  
  
Strong proficiency in Microsoft 365 tools, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, and Copilot, to support effective record-keeping, collaboration, and communication.
  
  
Experience supporting business continuity management activities adds value by enhancing operational resilience within the division. Familiarity with incident monitoring/reporting processes strengthens your ability to respond quickly during critical situations.
  
  
**What sets this company apart:**  
MUFG stands out as one of the world’s largest financial groups committed to delivering excellence through responsible banking practices. The company fosters an inclusive workplace where every team member’s voice is valued, encouraging collaboration across departments regardless of hierarchy or location. MUFG’s dedication to integrity permeates every aspect of its operations; employees are trusted partners who contribute meaningfully toward shared goals without compromising ethical standards. title: Cluster Learning & Development Manager - Conrad Singapore Marina Bay and Conrad Singapore Orchard
description:
At Conrad Hotels & Resorts, we believe that true luxury is being yourself. As a member of Hilton's luxury portfolio, Conrad delivers intuitive service, meaningful connections, and purposeful experiences that empower both our guests and our Team Members.
  
  
The Cluster Learning & Development Manager serves as a strategic business partner and culture champion responsible for driving learning excellence, leadership development, talent growth, service culture, and organizational effectiveness across Conrad Singapore Marina Bay and Conrad Singapore Orchard.
  
  
This role is instrumental in cultivating a high-performance learning culture that reflects Conrad's Luxury Service Standards, Hilton Values, and Employer of Choice aspirations. The incumbent acts as a catalyst for continuous learning, leadership capability building, and cultural transformation while ensuring that all Team Members are equipped to deliver exceptional guest experiences with passion, purpose, and excellence.
  
  
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
  
  
Picture yourself brightening someone’s day. When you join our Hotels team, that’s exactly what you’ll do every time you come to work! You are responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive team member training and development programs to enhance team skills and performance; assessing training needs, designing and updating training courses to ensure that the training content matches the team members' job responsibilities and career paths; managing training budgets to ensure maximum return on training investment. As a
  
  
Cluster
  
  
Learning & Development Manager
  
  
, you’re not just managing training initiatives for hotel team members – you’re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
  
  
**Here’s what you’ll do during a typical day:**  
Learning & Development Strategy
  
  

* Develop and execute the annual Cluster Learning & Development Strategy aligned with business goals, Conrad Brand Standards, and Hilton's global learning framework.
* Lead the design, implementation, and evaluation of all learning and capability-building initiatives across both hotels.
* Establish a culture of continuous learning that supports operational excellence, talent retention, and career growth.
* Identify learning needs through performance data, guest feedback, quality audits, and business priorities.
* Ensure training interventions deliver measurable improvements in guest satisfaction, team engagement, and operational performance.

Luxury Service Culture & Brand Excellence
  
  

* Champion the Conrad Luxury Service Culture and ensure all Team Members understand and embody Conrad's service philosophy.
* Facilitate and sustain brand immersion programmes that reinforce luxury hospitality standards and memorable guest experiences.
* Lead initiatives that strengthen service excellence, guest engagement, and personalized luxury experiences.
* Collaborate with department leaders to embed brand standards into everyday operations and team behaviors.

Leadership Development
  
  

* Develop leadership capability at all levels through structured learning programs, succession planning initiatives, and coaching interventions.
* Facilitate Hilton leadership development programs and support participation in regional and global learning initiatives.
* Coach Department Heads, Managers, and Supervisors in leadership effectiveness, performance management, communication, and people development.
* Support talent reviews and succession planning processes to strengthen leadership bench strength across both properties.

Team Member Development
  
  

* Drive onboarding, orientation, and assimilation programmes to ensure a strong Team Member experience from day one.
* Manage and facilitate all mandatory Hilton and hotel-specific training programs.
* Design learning pathways that support technical skills, service excellence, cross-functional exposure, and career growth.
* Support individual development plans and facilitate career conversations across all levels.
* Mentor high-potential Team Members and emerging leaders.

Talent Management & Organizational Development
  
  

* Partner with the Human Resources team and business leaders to support talent management, succession planning, and workforce capability development.
* Support organizational change initiatives, culture transformation projects, and employee engagement strategies.
* Conduct learning and development needs analyses to address capability gaps and future business requirements.
* Facilitate interventions that improve team effectiveness, collaboration, and workplace culture.

Departmental Training Excellence & Train-the-Trainer Programme
  
  

* Develop, implement, formalize, and continuously enhance a comprehensive Cluster Train-the-Trainer (TTT) Programme across Conrad Singapore Marina Bay and Conrad Singapore Orchard.
* Establish a structured departmental trainer framework to ensure every department maintains qualified and certified trainers who support ongoing learning and capability development.
* Partner with Department Heads to identify, appoint, and develop Departmental Trainers and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).
* Facilitate Train-the-Trainer certification programmes focusing on adult learning principles, facilitation skills, coaching techniques, presentation effectiveness, and learning evaluation.
* Ensure departmental trainers are equipped to deliver onboarding, technical skills, luxury service standards, compliance, and brand-related training programmes consistently.
* Monitor trainer effectiveness through training audits, observations, participant feedback, and business performance indicators.
* Conduct regular trainer calibration sessions to ensure consistency in learning delivery and alignment with Conrad Brand Standards and Hilton learning philosophies.
* Create and maintain a training governance framework that drives accountability for learning delivery within every department.
* Recognize and celebrate training champions who demonstrate excellence in developing Team Members and fostering a learning culture.

Training Planning & Coordination
  
  

* Lead the annual and quarterly learning planning process across both hotels, ensuring training initiatives are strategically aligned with business priorities and operational requirements.
* Develop comprehensive learning calendars and training schedules that maximize participation while minimizing operational disruption.
* Prioritize learning activities effectively across multiple stakeholders, locations, and business demands.
* Ensure all learning programmes are delivered within established timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
* Maintain strong project management discipline in the planning, implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of all learning initiatives.
* Utilize data and workforce insights to forecast learning needs and proactively address capability gaps.

Operational Partnership
  
  

* Build strong partnerships with General Managers, Executive Committee Members, and Department Heads to align learning initiatives with business needs.
* Conduct regular training reviews and learning effectiveness discussions with department leaders.
* Support operational departments with coaching, facilitation, and performance improvement initiatives.
* Ensure learning interventions support key commercial, operational, guest experience, and people metrics.

Learning Administration & Compliance
  
  

* Manage Hilton learning systems and ensure compliance with all required training and certification programmes.
* Maintain accurate training records, training reports, and compliance documentation.
* Monitor completion rates and effectiveness of mandatory, brand, safety, and compliance training.
* Ensure all learning activities meet company, legislative, and operational requirements.

Internship, Education & External Partnerships

**About the Role**
------------------

Tan Tock Seng Hospital (TTSH) is looking for a driven and detail-oriented Manager to support our Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and Business Continuity Management (BCM) programmes. In this role, you will play a central part in safeguarding the hospital's ability to deliver care, protecting our patients, staff, and operations from disruption and risk. If you thrive at the intersection of strategic thinking and hands-on programme management, this is a role where your work genuinely matters.

* Experience in emergency preparedness, including training, coordination, or project management.
* Professional certifications in ERM and/or relevant BCM accreditation (e.g., ISO 22301, BCCS, ISO 31000, COSO or equivalent).
* Prior experience in a healthcare or public sector setting.
