title: Safeguarding Controller - APAC
description:
Working alongside an existing team of Safeguarding specialists and reporting to the Global Safeguarding Accountable Owner, your role is to assist each of the existing controllers and product managers in ensuring the APAC safeguarding control framework runs smoothly. The role will span across both safeguarding for payments and e-money and investment business and offers a fantastic opportunity to learn about the handovers between the regimes. You will also be joining at an exciting time of product growth and expansion..
  
  
Your Mission
  
  
You will play a crucial role in ensuring that new product launches are compliant with safeguarding regulations and controlled in a proportionate manner
  
  
You will be responsible for ensuring completeness of our policies and procedures and coordinate with individual controllers to obtain attestations of the controls operation and alignment to the controls framework
  
  
You will be responsible for coordinating and implementing a first line of defence assurance for APAC safeguarding controls
  
  
You will be responsible for maintaining the APAC safeguarding risk and controls matrix for the APAC entities
  
  
You will be the first point of escalation of discrepancies identified by the Reconciliations team for safeguarding reconciliations and provide SME advise on their resolution and treatment
  
  
You will be involved in the incidents management process and link incidents to control failures, which will enable senior management to see themes within the control environment
  
  
You will be responsible for MAS regulatory reporting and other safeguarding regulatory reporting preparation
  
  
You will be responsible for the annual safeguarding audit coordination
  
  
You will help document, challenge and build an end-to-end view of our internal control environment to illustrate key risks, controls and processes. This will all be done within our internal risk management software
  
  
Opportunities
  
  
Own your own path of success - You’ll have a high level of autonomy and responsibility.
  
  
Grow with the role - You will have the exposure and opportunity to speak to key senior members of the organisation getting into the details of remediation steps. You will be able to develop your technical skills and knowledge by being involved in several change management programmes relating to regulatory uplifts across different territories as well as related to implementing new products or features working with our engineering team to ensure these are safeguarding compliant.
  
  
Stepping stone - This role provides an excellent platform for someone looking to step into the safeguarding function of a fast-growing Fintech.
  
  
Develop an in-depth knowledge of Wise’s business - Get to know many teams across the business as you partner with them as part of day-to-day activities.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
**A bit about you:**  
Technical knowledge - You have 5-8 years CASS (Client Assets Sourcebook) / Customer Moneys and Assets Protection (CMAP) framework experience in APAC (Singapore preferred) across investment business and payments.
  
  
Theory - You have strong understanding of Payments Services Act (PSA) under MAS.
  
  
Practice - You have sound writing skills and ability to convey regulation in a clear manner to fellow colleagues who are not SMEs and communicate key risks related to these regulations
  
  
Love getting things done - You are not afraid to roll up your sleeves and take responsibility to do whatever needs doing to solve problems. You take a proactive approach in resolving complex issues. We get it done!
  
  
Commercial acumen - You understand the value of taking a balanced approach to risk and controls to support the growth of the business.
  
  
Collaborative - You work well in a multinational team environment and know how to have an impact through others. No Drama Good Karma!
  
  
Development - You are keen to learn and develop your knowledge of how a FinTech and fast growing scale-up operates.
  
  
Our Safeguarding team is spread across the globe, but mainly in London and Tallinn, so there are some video calls and some travel involved for treasury wide initiatives.
  
  
Who we are
  
  
Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move money around the world. With the Wise account people and businesses can hold over 40 currencies, move money between countries and spend money abroad. Large companies and banks use Wise technology too; an entirely new cross-border payments network that will one day power money without borders for everyone, everywhere. However you use the platform, Wise is on a mission to make your life easier and save you money.
  
  
Co-founded by Kristo Käärmann and Taavet Hinrikus, Wise launched in 2011 under its original name TransferWise. It is one of the world’s fastest growing, profitable technology companies and is listed on the London Stock Exchange under the ticker, WISE.
  
  
16 million people and businesses use Wise. In fiscal year 2023, Wise processed approximately £105 billion in cross-border transactions, saving customers around £1.5 billion.
  
  
What it’s really like to work here
  
  
At Wise, we do things a bit differently. There’s no corporate nonsense, and no old-fashioned hierarchy. Instead, we work in dozens of self-sufficient, autonomous teams. Think of them like start-ups within a start-up that learn from each other.
  
  
Each team picks the problems they want to solve. So there’s no micro-management. No hiding behind fancy job titles. And no one telling you what to do. You are your own boss. But you’ll get tons of guidance and plenty of support from talented, super-smart colleagues from all over Wise.
  
  
We’re going to be upfront — the way we work doesn’t suit everyone. But if freedom, autonomy, and life-affirming, head-scratching professional challenges rock your world, we could be a match made in heaven.

description:
Extend Networks (X10)
  
  
delivers next-generation satellite network infrastructure and intelligent user terminal solutions across multi-orbit constellations (GEO, MEO, and LEO). We are pioneering the concept of a fully integrated satellite and cellular based Network-as-a-Service infrastructure solution. This ground-breaking model was developed to meet the demanding business and mission critical needs. As part of our APAC expansion, we are looking for someone who thrives on breaking new ground and is ready to own our product and sales operations cycles across the region.
  
  
ROLE SUMMARY
  
  
We are seeking a technically grounded Product/Sales Operations Manager specializing in satellite networks and user terminals. Serving as the critical bridge between product engineering, sales team and customers, you will shape solution designs of end-to-end terminal-to-teleport architectures, keep product and project documentation accurate, build compelling vertical use cases, and translate customer operational needs into scalable product roadmaps.

Network & Terminal Solution Design (Pre/Post-Sales)
  
  

* End-to-End Architecture Design: Architect tailored satellite connectivity solutions spanning user terminals, RF subsystems, satellite modems/routers, and ground hubs.
* RFx & Technical Proposals: Lead technical responses to RFIs, RFPs, and RFQs, producing detailed system diagrams, bill-of-materials (BoM) pricing, and commercial packaging (CapEx, OpEx, and Hardware-as-a-Service models).
* PoCs & Field Trials: Scope, coordinate, and evaluate customer proof-of-concept (PoC) deployments, over-the-air (OTA) terminal demonstrations, and factory acceptance tests (FAT).

QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS
  
  
Preferred Experience & Skills
  
  

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Electrical/RF Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent industry experience).

* Terminal & Modem Expertise: Hands-on familiarity with satellite terminal hardware (stabilized maritime antennas, land-mobile/COTM, flat-panel ESAs) and hub/modem platforms (e.g., ST Engineering iDirect, Hughes, Gilat, Comtech).

* Documentation & Storytelling: Proven track record of writing clear technical documentation, solution briefs, and commercial use cases tailored to both C-level buyers and network engineers.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; familiarity with Murex, SWIFT or other Treasury platforms is advantageous.

* Experience in static data, reference data, instrument or counterparty setup, settlement instructions, or Treasury systems is advantageous.

* High level of attention to detail and an understanding of how data changes affect trade processing, accounting, settlement and reporting.

  

**Working Requirements**
========================

* The role may require support outside standard business hours, including selected public holidays or weekends, based on product and market coverage.

* Location is in Tampines.

  

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* Accurate and timely completion of assigned activities within agreed service levels and cut-off times.

* Prompt identification, escalation and resolution of exceptions, with clear audit trails.

About You
  
  
3+ years in infrastructure support or support engineering, including support/service desk experience in structured, SLA-driven, customer-facing environments (cloud, data centre, or managed services)
  
  
Clear written notes, concise updates, and reliable follow-through. Able to explain technical issues accurately to customers and colleagues, and produce handovers the next shift can act on immediately
  
  
GPU and hardware troubleshooting.
  
  
**Working knowledge of GPU infrastructure:** hands-on with nvidia-smi or similar diagnostics, comfortable interpreting hardware error output and logs, and confident physically troubleshooting servers — reseating components, swap testing, working via BMC/out-of-band management — through to preparing RMA evidence. A strong technical base here is required, not a learning goal
  
  
**Solid working knowledge:** confident on the CLI with systemd, filesystems, permissions, and standard networking tools. Able to troubleshoot common issues independently and know when to escalate
  
  
Solid grasp of IP addressing, subnets, VLANs, routing, DNS, and firewalls. Awareness of high-performance east-west fabrics (RDMA/InfiniBand concepts) is a plus and a core growth area in this role
  
  
Ticketing and ITSM discipline.
  
  
Experience working within structured support processes (ITIL or similar): prioritisation, escalation, SLA awareness, and accurate documentation
  
  
Observability foundations.
  
  
Able to use dashboards and alerts to identify symptoms, gather evidence, and follow runbooks. Comfortable proposing simple alert or dashboard improvements with review
  
  
Scripting and automation basics.
  
  
Comfortable reading and writing simple Bash or Python, and using Git for version control
  
  
Platform and DC fundamentals.
  
  
Understanding of servers, networks, storage, and virtualisation concepts, ideally from a support or operations background
  
  
Growth mindset.
  
  
Curious, dependable, and collaborative. You seek feedback, ask questions, and invest in learning to progress toward Senior
  
  
Able to work in a fast-moving environment with evolving processes, participate in on-call after onboarding, and travel when needed
  
  
Nice to Have
  
  
High-performance fabrics and GPU-HPC.
  
  
Exposure to RDMA/InfiniBand, link-level diagnostics (mlxlink, ibdiagnet, or equivalent), NCCL-based troubleshooting, or NVLink concepts
  
  
High-performance storage.
  
  
Exposure to VAST or comparable AI-optimised storage platforms, Ceph, or NFS at scale, including basic storage–network troubleshooting
  
  
OpenStack and fleet operations tooling.
  
  
Familiarity with OpenStack troubleshooting flows, or fleet-scale tooling for provisioning and health (MAAS, NetBox, Redfish, or similar)
  
  
Understanding of core concepts (nodes, pods, services, logs) and basic troubleshooting via runbooks. Helpful context for our platform, though not the core of this role
  
  
Automation and access tooling.
  
  
Experience with Ansible or Terraform, CI/CD participation (GitHub Actions or similar), or access and security tooling such as Teleport or Vault
  
  
Progress toward relevant Linux, networking, Kubernetes, cloud, or security certifications over time
  
  
In All We Do, Our Core Values Guide Us
  
  
Relentless Innovation
  
  
At Nscale, we constantly push the boundaries of innovation, embracing creative risks to shape the future. Our aim is to deliver products that not only meet but exceed today’s expectations, setting new standards for tomorrow.
  
  
Ownership and Accountability
  
  
Every Nscaler is fully accountable for their work, driving it with excellence and urgency. We set high standards, ensuring that our contributions are not just good but exceptional.
  
  
Openness and Transparency
  
  
We believe trust and transparency are key to our success. We maintain open communication within our teams and with stakeholders, sharing both successes and challenges. Our open-source approach allows customers to explore our technology, building trust and ensuring our solutions are both innovative, secure, and reliable.
  
  
Customer-Centric Focus
  
  
Our customers are central to our mission, and we are committed to delivering impactful solutions that drive real-world success. We focus on deeply understanding their needs and challenges, striving to exceed expectations in both product quality and service.
  
  
Sustainability
  
  
We are dedicated to considering the long-term environmental and societal impacts of our technologies. By integrating sustainability into our operations and product development, we ensure that our innovations are both effective and responsible, contributing positively to the world around us.
  
  
Full-Speed Collaboration
  
  
Collaboration at Nscale is fast, efficient, and respectful. We work together seamlessly, with clear communication and mutual respect, ensuring our shared goals are met with high standards and impactful outcomes.
  
  
Equal Opportunities Statement
  
  
We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.
  
  
If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

title: Demand Generation Manager, Startups, APAC
description:
**About Stripe**  
  
  
  
  
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies-from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups-use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.  
  
  
  
**About the team**  
  
  
  
  
APAC Demand Generation is a team of marketers and channel specialists that builds strategies to engage prospects and customers, generate demand for Stripe's prioritized solutions, and contribute measurable business impact. The team partners closely with global and regional Campaigns, Product Marketing, Field Marketing, Performance Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Sales Development, Sales, and Marketing Operations. Its work spans APAC markets, customer segments, and stages of the customer lifecycle.  
  
  
  
**What you'll do**  
  
  
  
  
Stripe works with startups from their earliest days through global scale. The APAC startup ecosystem is diverse and fast-moving, with founders building for multiple markets, adopting new business models, and making foundational financial-infrastructure decisions earlier than ever.  
  
  
  
  
  
The Demand Generation Manager, Startups, APAC will be the day-to-day demand generation lead for the Startup segment in the region. This person will translate global Startup priorities into an integrated APAC plan, build regionally relevant programs, and independently lead cross-functional execution across channels and markets. The role will connect regional market insight with global strategy and use data to improve how Stripe reaches, engages, and converts startups across their growth journey.  
  
  
  
  
  
This role reports to the APAC Platforms and Startups Demand Generation lead.  
  
  
  
  
  
**Responsibilities**

  
* Develop and execute an integrated, multi-channel demand generation plan for startups across APAC, aligned with regional business priorities and global Startup strategy.
  
  
* Translate global campaigns into relevant regional programs, identifying where messaging, audience strategy, content, channel mix, or execution should be adapted for APAC markets.
  
  
* Lead cross-channel programs spanning paid media, lifecycle and email, content distribution, online and in-person events, field marketing, partner and ecosystem channels, and Sales Development follow-up.
  
  
* Own the day-to-day performance of the APAC Startup campaign portfolio, using funnel and campaign data to identify opportunities, diagnose gaps, recommend changes, and improve results.
  
  
* Partner with regional Sales and Sales Development teams to align priorities, strengthen lead follow-up, and connect marketing activity to pipeline and activation outcomes.
  
  
* Build strong working relationships with global Campaigns, Startup Marketing, Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, Field Marketing, Startup Partnerships, and Marketing Operations.
  
  
* Represent APAC market needs and customer insights in global planning, and share regional results, learnings, and repeatable practices with global and regional partners.
  
  
* Develop programs that engage founders and startup decision-makers at different stages, from company formation and early product adoption through expansion and global growth.
  
  
* Work with campaign operations and instrumentation partners to establish clear measurement plans, maintain campaign hygiene, and ensure programs can be evaluated accurately.
  
  
* Independently manage multiple complex, cross-functional workstreams, setting clear goals, timelines, responsibilities, and dependencies while proactively resolving risks and blockers.
  
  
* Design and run experiments that improve audience engagement, conversion, channel effectiveness, and program scalability.
  
  

  
**Who you are**  
  
  
  
  
The successful candidate is an experienced demand generation marketer who combines strategic thinking with strong execution. This person is comfortable operating independently, leading through influence, and bringing structure to ambiguous problems. They understand how to build integrated programs across markets and channels and can turn performance data and customer insight into clear action.  
  
  
  
  
  
**Minimum requirements**  
  
  
  

  
* 8+ year experience developing and executing B2B demand generation, growth marketing, or integrated marketing programs in the technology industry.
  
  
* Experience owning multi-channel campaigns across multiple APAC markets, with a record of delivering measurable funnel, pipeline, activation, or revenue-related outcomes.
  
  
* Strong understanding of digital demand channels, including paid media, lifecycle and email marketing, content, online events, and lead management.
  
  
* Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex cross-functional programs, manage multiple workstreams, and anticipate and resolve execution risks.
  
  
* Strong analytical skills and experience defining KPIs, interpreting campaign and funnel performance, and translating findings into recommendations.
  
  
* Experience partnering closely with Sales and Sales Development teams on planning, execution, lead follow-up, and performance improvement.
  
  
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to align stakeholders across functions, markets, and levels of seniority.
  
  
* Strong judgment, curiosity, and a bias toward action in a fast-moving and evolving environment.
  
  

  
  
  
**Preferred qualifications**  
  
  
  

  
* Experience marketing to startups, founders, developers, or fast-growing technology companies.
  
  
* Familiarity with the APAC startup ecosystem, including accelerators, venture capital firms, technology communities, or other founder channels.
  
  
* Experience in payments, financial technology, SaaS, financial infrastructure, or an adjacent industry.
  
  
* Experience regionalizing global campaigns and balancing global consistency with meaningful local-market adaptation.
  
  
* Knowledge of account-based marketing, partner marketing, marketing automation, experimentation, and performance optimization.
  
  
* Experience working in a highly matrixed global organization.

title: Head of Growth Operations
description:
**First Circle** is an SME credit-centric, multi-product NeoBank in SE Asia which is **fast-growing (>100%), profitable, and internationalising** soon. We started life as an SME lender in the Philippines in 2016 to solve the SME credit gap by using technology to systemise underwriting, deliver exceptional UX, and automate away delivery costs. We’ve **delivered our clients the fastest, cheapest, most flexible credit line available to businesses** anywhere in Southeast Asia. We’ve been rewarded with both fast growth and exceptional unit economics, a rare combination in our space.

Over the past two years we’ve **expanded our product range** to include business bank accounts & payments, e-Invoices, corporate credit cards, rooftop solar, and most recently deposits catalysed by securing a full bank charter in the Philippines. In 2027, we’ll expand our geographical coverage to include at least two new markets in APAC.

**Our excellent track record results from our people & culture**. We combine high standards & intensity with a collegiate environment. Our barometers of success are the rate of personal growth of our people, how long high performers choose to stay, and ensuring we raise the bar with every hire.

### **About the Role**

We’re hiring a **Head of Growth Operations** to lead operations for our new products. This means **taking ownership** for doing whatever it takes to make these products successful. **The portfolio is growing** and responsibilities may expand over time. To start with the portfolio of new products may include corporate cards, invoice financing, business accounts and payments, and employee salary loans and payroll.

**A successful product is one that delivers great value for our customers and grows as a result**. You will be responsible for taking these new products from v1 and building them into something that our customers love and value. You will have an intimate focus on the user experience, working closely with our tech team to build and enhance our products. You will **define the processes and systems** that allow us to operate the product, trying to automate as much as possible. You will **work out the strategy to distribute the products**, working closely with our sales force. You will **build and shape a team of excellent operators**, taking on more responsibility and a broader portfolio of products as we launch more and more solutions for our customers.

The ideal candidate has **strong problem solving and analytical skills,** is a **proven operator** who knows how to make things happen, and knows what it is to build and manage a team of exceptional talent. You will be **comfortable working with data,** eager to tackle tricky problems in ambiguous circumstances, and able to partner with other people and work with senior stakeholders.

First Circle is changing small business banking in the Philippines. The sky is the limit for someone who wants to get stuck in and make a difference.

### **Role and responsibilities**

* You will **lead operations for “new products”**, including corporate cards, invoices, and payroll. More products may come under your ownership in the future. These are critical priorities for the business
* You will be the **ultimate owner for these products**, singularly focused on their successful growth. You will be responsible for delivering a great user experience, managing the day to day operations for the products, defining and executing the strategy for growth, and taking accountability for P&L
* You will **work closely with our tech and product teams,** and with all our other teams who can be a part of what it takes to grow your products (sales, marketing, finance, legal etc).
* The role will **ideally be located in the Philippines. Relocation and sponsorship is available. International remote setup is also possible**
* You will have a **high degree of exposure to leadership**, reporting directly to the Vice President of Operations

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree in **Business, Economics, Management, STEM or similar field**
* Ideal candidate likely has **5-10 years experience** - but we are much more interested in trajectory and potential than years of work experience.
* The candidate will know what it is to **operate inside a business** (ideally a tech company in a fast-paced environment). Ideally the candidate will have prior experience in consulting or finance.

### **Skills**

* **Ownership mindset.** Takes accountability for business objectives and does whatever it takes to get there.
* **Strong problem-solving** and analytical skills. Ideally has experience with data and analytics tools (e.g. SQL, Python). If you don’t already have experience with SQL then you are happy and eager to learn and you are the sort of analytical individual for whom this will be easy
* **Highly practical.** Can take a problem, find a solution, and then make things happen. Able to design efficient systems and processes, with a bias for automation where possible
* Ability to **manage multiple projects** and stakeholders in a fast-paced environment
* **Leadership**. Can build and shape a team, setting the bar for excellence and helping juniors grow and develop

  
**Benefits**  

* Work at a fast-growing fintech on **meaningful products** that reshape SME finance in Southeast Asia with plenty of growth opportunities
* Join a team with a **deeply collaborative culture**! Learn more here: https://www.firstcircle.ph/careers
* **Hybrid work set-up**: at least 2 days per week in our BGC (central Manila) office; remote the rest of the time.
* **Additional perks & benefits** including HMO coverage from month one, free catered lunches, MacBook Air provided, monthly fitness allowance, transportation & accommodation allowance, and more.
